title: Nurse Functional Assessor
description:
Are you a Registered Nurse, Paramedic, Occupational Therapist, OR Physiotherapist looking for a rewarding role that offers an excellent work/life balance?

We are currently recruiting for a Nurse Assessor to support the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) in delivering Functional Assessments

If you’re looking for a role that allows you to apply your clinical expertise, provides career progression, and offers a flexible working environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

What We’re Looking For:

- A minimum of 1-year post-qualification experience as a Registered Nurse (RGN, RMN, RNLD), Paramedic, Occupational Therapist, or Physiotherapist.

- Valid PIN and full registration on the NMC or HCPC, with no conditions or restrictions.

- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to listen, show empathy, and explore further when required.

- Strong time management skills with the ability to work to targets and maintain the quality of reports.

- A good level of computer literacy and to be comfortable with typing.

- A passion for working with and supporting people with both mental and physical health conditions.

- A strong knowledge of long term and chronic conditions, with experience across medical, chronic illness and acute settings.

Your Role as a Nurse Assessor:

You will be using your clinical expertise to assess and analyse medical evidence, assessing individuals online and face to face. Providing comprehensive, evidence-based reports.

- Produce detailed reports that justify your findings and recommendations to support the DWP in the decision-making process.

- Work closely with claimants to ensure they are fully informed during the assessment process, managing their expectations and being empathetic during a difficult situation.

If you are a Nurse (RGN, RMN, RNLD), Paramedic, Occupational Therapist, or Physiotherapist and you’re ready to take on a new challenge as a Nurse Assessor, we want to hear from you!

Apply today by submitting your CV, our team hold years of experience in PIP and will guide you through the process, supporting you as you go.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills — including pivot tables, advanced formulas, lookups, Power Query, and data visualisation.

title: CNC machinist operator/programmer
description:
We are seeking a skilled CNC Router Operator to set up, operate, and maintain our Biesse Rover K CNC Flatbed Router. In this role, you will leverage the machine’s advanced nesting capabilities to maximize material yield and efficiently process panels.

Key Responsibilities

- Machine Operation: Setup and run the Biesse Rover K flatbed CNC router daily.

- Nesting Optimization: Utilize nesting software to arrange parts efficiently, minimizing material waste.

- Program Loading: Import and execute cutting files using Biesse’s proprietary Biesse BSuite Software Suite or compatible CAM software.

- Tooling Management: Select, install, and calibrate appropriate router bits, drills.

- Quality Control: Inspect finished parts against technical drawings using tape measures.

- Material Handling: Load raw sheet goods onto the vacuum bed and unload finished parts.

- Labeling & Sorting: Apply identification labels to nested parts for subsequent assembly stages.

- Routine Maintenance: Clean vacuum filters, lubricate rails, and perform daily Biesse preventative maintenance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Experience: Minimum 2–3 years’ operating flatbed CNC routers, ideally Biesse Rover series machines.

- Software Literacy: Familiarity with BiesseWorks / bSolid, or industry CAM software like Vectric Aspire, Alphacam, or Cabinet Vision.

- Blueprint Reading: Ability to interpret technical drawings and manufacturing paperwork.

- Material Knowledge: Strong understanding of feed speeds and chip loads for MDF, Veneers, and solid wood.

- Precision: High attention to detail with the ability to maintain tight tolerances.

- Physical Stamina: Ability to lift heavy sheet goods (up to 25kg) and stand for extended periods.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with automated loading/unloading systems (sweeper arms or scissor lifts).

- Formal training or certification directly from a Biesse Training Academy.

- Basic fork-lift truck license for moving heavy material bunks.

- The candidate may be required to work on an overlapping shift from 10.30am to 8pm during busier times.

This role demands meticulous attention to detail, effective problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to work independently. The ideal candidate will possess a strong work ethic, reliability, and a dedication to delivering high-quality work. The role offers a rewarding environment for those passionate about precision engineering and manufacturing excellence. We welcome applications from motivated individuals eager to develop their skills within a supportive team.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
About the Role

Field Service Engineer

Locations: Birmingham
Reporting to: Equipment Operations Manager
Department: Equipment

About the Role

We are looking for a Field Service Engineer to help maintain Panda’s fleet of more than 600 items of recycling and waste-handling equipment located at customer sites across the UK.

Working primarily within a three-hour radius of your home, you will install, service and repair compactors, balers and other specialist equipment, ensuring it remains safe, efficient and available for our customers. Some UK-wide travel will also be required when needed.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Field Service Engineer, you will:

- Complete planned preventive maintenance on recycling and waste-handling equipment

- Inspect, test and diagnose mechanical, electrical and hydraulic faults

- Repair or replace defective parts using appropriate hand and power tools

- Install and repair electrical wiring, electronic components and hydraulic systems

- Reassemble and test equipment to confirm it is safe and operating correctly

- Assist with machinery installations, including three-phase electrical connections

- Provide repair estimates and technical updates where required

- Complete service reports, inspection records and supporting photographic evidence

- Train customer employees in the safe operation of equipment

- Provide customers with technical advice and support safe operating procedures

- Take ownership of engineering issues and work to minimise equipment downtime

- Plan your workload effectively to maximise productivity and customer service

- Work closely with the Equipment Operations Manager and technical support team

- Follow customer site rules and maintain high health and safety standards at all times

About You

We are looking for someone with:

- Experience servicing or repairing waste-handling equipment or machinery within a related industry

- Strong mechanical, electrical and hydraulic fault-finding skills

- The ability to read and understand electrical and hydraulic circuit diagrams

- Experience using electrical and hydraulic testing equipment

- Knowledge of single-phase and three-phase electrical systems

- The ability to carry out minor welding repairs

- A good understanding of relevant safety standards and safe working practices

- The confidence to work independently with minimal supervision

- Strong organisational and administrative skills

- A professional approach to customer service and communication

- The ability to manage priorities and take ownership of problems through to resolution

A City & Guilds qualification in electrical or mechanical engineering, or a similar relevant qualification, would be beneficial.

This Field Service Engineer role would suit an experienced service engineer from an electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, plant or industrial equipment background who enjoys working independently and delivering a reliable service to customers.

About Us

We are Panda. We value waste.

We’re in the business of waste management but that doesn’t just mean collecting bins. Behind every collection is a passionate team of people finding smarter, safer, and more sustainable ways to recycle and repurpose materials that would otherwise go to waste.

Over the past 30 years, Panda has grown into a leading resource recovery business, bringing together almost 3,000 people across multiple brands, united by a shared vision and strong values. While our operations are diverse, our purpose is clear: to protect our people, support our customers, and create positive impact for the communities and environments we serve.

At Panda, people are at the heart of everything we do. We work as one team, combining different skills, experiences, and perspectives to achieve shared goals. We care for each other’s wellbeing, encourage development, and support growth because we know we’re stronger together.

We expect excellence in how we operate. High standards, bold thinking, and continuous improvement drive our passion for innovation. We challenge the ordinary, put safety first, and embrace new ideas while delivering practical, cost-effective solutions that move our business forward.

We own what we do. From day-to-day tasks to major projects, we take pride in our work and responsibility for the outcome. We don’t walk past problems we address them together. Our expertise, reliability, and care reflect who we are and the difference we make.

And above all, we act with trust and integrity. Trust is built through open communication, honesty, and accountability. It allows us to move quickly, make confident decisions, and deliver results — knowing our people are empowered to do the right thing.

Our journey depends on talented, committed people who want to make an impact.

Take the first step and join us on the journey.

Panda is committed to attracting and retaining a skilled and diverse workforce that reflects the communities in which we operate and the people we serve.
(DE&I Policy Statement)

title: Client Services Manager
description:
About Us

Founded in 2008, Absolute Digital Media is a specialist UK digital marketing agency working in regulated and competitive industries including iGaming, financial services, legal, healthcare, adult content and cryptocurrency. We have won 175+ industry awards and maintain a 97% client retention rate.

We are not a generalist agency. We focus on sectors where compliance, technical expertise and aggressive competition demand specialist knowledge, and we are building our position in LLM optimisation and AI search as an agency built for where search is going, not where it has been.

The Role

As Client Services Manager, you own the relationship with our top-tier accounts. You are the person the client calls, the person who knows their business inside out, and the person accountable for whether they stay, grow and advocate for us.

This is not a reporting or note-taking role. You are expected to sit inside the client's world, understand how their business actually makes money, and make sure the work our SEO and paid media teams deliver is pointed squarely at the KPIs their team cares about.

You work across the whole agency, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, digital PR and development so that clients experience one joined-up team rather than a set of separate workstreams. You will be trusted with our most valuable relationships, and the commercial performance of that portfolio sits with you.

In a nutshell:

Retain and grow a portfolio of Absolute's highest-value accounts. The measure of success is a client base that renews and expands scope.

Key Responsibilities

Client Ownership and Communication

- Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of top-tier accounts, owning day-to-day communication and senior stakeholder relationships.

- Respond to all client communication and provide proactive updates before the client has to ask for them.

- Run client meetings with a clear agenda and a clear purpose, making sure every call leaves the client with something of value.

- Lead quarterly business reviews with senior client stakeholders, connecting performance to their commercial objectives rather than to channel metrics alone.

- Build relationships beyond your single day-to-day contact, so that the account is not dependent on one person on either side.

Project Management and Delivery

- Own the delivery plan across every service line on your accounts, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, digital PR and development into one coherent campaign.

- Hold internal teams to deadlines, chase what needs chasing, and make sure work leaves us at the standard we expect.

- Keep scope, hours and deliverables under control, flagging over-servicing before it happens rather than after.

- Make sure reports and deliverables land on time and read as commercial insight rather than data dumps.

- Manage escalations calmly and quickly, with a clear plan and a clear owner attached to every issue.

Retention and Risk

- Carry accountability for retention across your portfolio.

- Track account health continuously and identify risk early, using engagement signals, performance trends and stakeholder changes.

- Escalate at-risk accounts internally before they reach crisis point, with a documented plan to recover them.

- Run structured account planning for every top-tier client, covering objectives, risks, relationships and growth opportunities.

Commercial Growth

- Know Absolute's full service range well enough to recognise where a client has a need we can meet, and to make the case for it credibly.

- Identify and progress opportunities to increase scope, add service lines or extend contract terms across the portfolio.

- Work with the Managing Director and the Heads of department to shape and price proposals for existing clients.

Internal Leadership

- Act as the bridge between clients and delivery teams, protecting both the client outcome and the team's ability to do good work.

- Brief internal teams clearly, so specialists start with context rather than a forwarded email.

- Feed client insight back into the wider agency, including sector trends, competitor activity and recurring points of friction.

- Contribute to improving the client journey, from onboarding through to renewal.

- Maintain accurate records of account activity, strategy documents, commercial terms and client communication in agreed systems.

What We Are Looking For

- A track record of managing significant client relationships in a digital agency, consultancy or client-side marketing team, with retention and growth numbers you can speak to.

- Working knowledge of SEO and paid media. You do not need to run the campaigns, but you need to hold a credible conversation about strategy, performance and trade-offs without deferring every question to a specialist.

- Commercial literacy. You can read a client's business, understand where revenue and margin come from, and connect our work to it.

- The presence and confidence to hold a room with senior stakeholders, deliver difficult messages and keep trust intact.

- Strong project management instincts, with the organisation to run multiple accounts and multiple service lines at once without dropping detail.

- A relationship builder. Delivery teams should want to work on your accounts, and clients should want you in the room.

- Evidence of spotting and converting upsell or cross-sell opportunities within an existing client base.

- Comfortable with data. Confident in GA4, Search Console, Looker Studio and platform reporting, and able to turn numbers into a clear commercial story.

Highly Advantageous

- Experience with regulated sectors such as iGaming, financial services, legal or healthcare, and an understanding of what compliance means for marketing delivery.

- Experience managing accounts where both SEO and paid media sit under one retainer.

- Familiarity with how agencies are structured commercially, including where margin is made and lost on a retainer.

- Understanding of how AI search and LLM visibility are changing what clients expect from an agency.

- Experience of formal renewal or procurement processes with larger organisations.

Package and Structure

- Base salary: £35-£45k

- Performance-related bonus linked to retention and portfolio growth

- Remote working, with expected travel for client visits

What we offer in Return:

- Fully remote working in the UK (opportunities to work from anywhere within Europe – exceptions apply).

- Free Private Medical Health Insurance (with cash back option on Vision & Dental care & 40% off Nuffield Health gym Membership)

- Companywide Christmas shutdown - 3 additional paid days leave over the Christmas period.

- Company Pension Scheme.

We value attitude, capability, and experience. Relevant sector experience is preferred.

This is not for the faint-hearted. But for the right person, it’s one hell of a journey.

Indevor Group

Indevor Group is the UK’s leading Multi-Disciplinary Services Provider to the Housebuilding, Development and Property Industry. Indevor prides itself on providing innovative solutions to serve our clientele with an underlying, paramount focus on delivering vital ancillary services to assist housebuilders addressing the shortfall of new homes completions in the United Kingdom.

Our clients include some of the UK’s leading FTSE 100 companies and leading New Homes Warranty Providers including the National House Building Council, where we take pride in delivering solutions that drive real impact.

We’ve built a culture that balances ambition with support. Indevor is a place where people are challenged to achieve their best while being part of a team that celebrates success together. Our commitment to our people has earned us Gold accreditation from Investors in People, Construction News Best Place to Work 2026 Nomination and recognition in The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), underlining our belief that high performance and a fantastic workplace go hand in hand.

Indevor is not a place for someone simply looking to pick up a pay cheque or even just build a reasonable career. We are looking for people who want to become part of our evolving story and huge ambitions, want to work hard, embrace challenges, and help us deliver on our mission.

Values

At Indevor Group, everything we do is built around our five core values:

- Service Excellence

- Reliability

- Respect

- Innovation

- Results Based

All colleagues are expected to demonstrate these values in everything they do.

About Indevor Water

Indevor Water represents the realisation of a long-term exciting plan to expand the Indevor Estates Division and become the latest entry into the New Appointments & Variations (NAV) Market as introduced under the regime within the Water Industry Act (1991).

Indevor Water operates under a specially granted licence by Ofwat, recognising the Group’s unique standing and experience in unadopted infrastructure coupled with our proven long-term capital investment fund, 125-year Performance Bond facility and Operations Indemnification Facility. The Indevor Water Auto-Adoption model was shortlisted at the 2026 Water Industry Awards in both the 'Groundbreaker' and 'Asset Management Initiative Of The Year' categories.

Indevor Water is an alternative to the traditional sewer adoption route with Incumbent Water Companies, devised and introduced to address the development industry's longstanding problem of legacy sewer networks remaining unadopted.

Indevor Water has the ambition of being the best and most recognised Water Company in providing outstanding service and value to all Customers whilst enabling them to benefit from an effective, fit-for-purpose Wastewater System.

Indevor Water seeks to capitalise on the Group’s existing industry reputation and standing, to work with housebuilders across the industry to rapidly expand our portfolio of adopted Sewer Networks. Indevor Water is in the process of onboarding experienced, high-profile recruits to aid this expansion.

The Opportunity

To become one of the leading ambassadors of Indevor Water, representing the Company at the highest levels of the Housebuilding Industry, whilst developing strategic relationships with Regional Technical Directors, Managing Directors and Group PLC Board Members.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building upon the significant market profile and opportunities already established by Indevor Water, introducing and converting new enquiries, developing a sustainable pipeline of opportunities and long-term client partnerships, playing a pivotal role in the continued growth and success of the Company.

The successful candidate will be comfortable adopting a hands-on approach during the early stages of Indevor Water's growth, helping to refine and enhance existing systems, procedures and ways of working, whilst laying the foundations for a nationwide Developer Services function. As the business continues to expand, the role will evolve into building, leading and developing a high-performing team.

They will be responsible for making a significant contribution towards key performance indicators and ambitious growth targets, applying their industry knowledge, technical expertise and professional relationships to support and develop Indevor Water. We are seeking an individual who is looking to become a long-term part of the business and play a defining role in its future growth and success.

Key Responsibilities

- Support Indevor Water’s entry into the New Appointments & Variations (NAV) Market by expanding and strengthening Housebuilder relationships.

- Work closely and in alignment with the Indevor Group Board of Directors and Indevor Water Management Team to deliver the agreed strategy for identifying and developing prospect opportunities.

- Further develop Indevor Water’s profile and presence within the Housebuilding, Infrastructure, Utilities and Water Industries.

- Support the internal growth and establishment of Indevor Water, playing a key role in developing the Developer Services Department across various regions of the UK.

- Work closely and in alignment with the Stakeholder & Licensing Department to progress opportunities.

- Effectively manage all assigned clients, ensuring continued prompt and professional communication.

Role Specific Responsibilities

- Organise and attend nationwide face-to-face meetings with existing and prospective Developers.

- Secure Developers' commitment in principle for future sites.

- Issue formal application documentation and supporting information requests following commitment in principle.

- Pursue and obtain all technical and commercial information required to facilitate application review and pricing.

- Work with the Commercial and Technical Teams to review applications and prepare Auto-Adoption Quotations.

- Conduct quotation review meetings with Developers, obtaining meaningful feedback and, ideally, formal instruction.

- Liaise with the Licensing and Stakeholder Team to assist with processing applications through the Ofwat Application Process.

title: Treasury Accountant
description:
Treasury Accountant

Location: Chapeltown, Sheffield
Salary: £40,000–£50,000 per annum, depending on experience
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30am–5:00pm

About the role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Treasury Accountant to join our finance team at an established and growing business based in Chapeltown, Sheffield.

This is a hands-on treasury role with responsibility for the day-to-day management of the company's banking arrangements, cash position, funding and treasury processes. You will work closely with the Head of Finance and key stakeholders across the business, providing accurate and timely information to support financial decision-making.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership, is comfortable working with banks and lenders, and wants a role where their work has a genuine impact on the wider business.

Key responsibilities

- Manage the company's day-to-day banking activities, including bank accounts, payments, receipts and reconciliations.

- Monitor daily cash balances and manage short- and medium-term cash flow requirements.

- Prepare and maintain regular cash flow forecasts, highlighting risks, opportunities and funding requirements.

- Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions, acting as a key point of contact for treasury matters.

- Assist with the management and administration of loan facilities, finance agreements and associated repayments.

- Monitor loan balances, interest charges, covenants and repayment schedules, ensuring obligations are met accurately and on time.

- Work closely with the Head of Finance on funding requirements, banking facilities and treasury strategy.

- Prepare treasury reports and analysis for the Head of Finance and senior management.

- Investigate and resolve banking discrepancies and payment issues.

- Ensure appropriate controls are in place around payments, banking and cash management.

- Maintain accurate treasury records and ensure all transactions are correctly recorded in the accounting system.

- Work closely with the wider finance team to ensure accurate cash, debt and interest reporting.

- Support month-end and year-end processes, including treasury-related journals and reconciliations.

- Identify opportunities to improve treasury processes, controls and efficiency.

- Assist with audits and provide information and supporting documentation as required.

- Ensure compliance with internal policies, financial controls and relevant banking requirements.

About you

We are looking for someone with previous experience in treasury, financial accounting, management accounting or a similar finance role, ideally within a medium-to-large commercial organisation.

You will ideally have:

- Proven experience in treasury or cash management.

- Strong experience managing bank accounts and banking relationships.

- Experience with cash flow forecasting and liquidity management.

- A good understanding of loans, borrowing facilities, interest calculations and repayments.

- Experience working closely with a Head of Finance or senior finance team.

- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data and reconciliations.

- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to financial control.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- The ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines.

- Excellent communication skills and confidence liaising with banks and internal stakeholders.

- Experience working with an ERP or accounting system.

An AAT, ACCA, CIMA, ACA or similar qualification would be advantageous, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.

What we're looking for

This role would suit someone who is hands-on, organised and commercially aware, who enjoys being responsible for the detail while also understanding the bigger financial picture.

You will be comfortable taking ownership of treasury activities and working closely with the Head of Finance to ensure the business has effective control and visibility of its cash, banking and funding position.

If you're an experienced finance professional looking for a treasury role with real responsibility and the opportunity to work closely with senior finance leadership, we'd love to hear from you.

A Nurse Assessor role with ExamWorks could provide that new direction in your Healthcare career. We provide thorough and impartial assessments to assist claimants in being awarded the Personal Independent Payment benefit.

As a Nurse Assessor, you will join an established team of health professionals who conduct daily assessments to help the DWP (Department for Work and Pensions) to review and make important decisions. This role will allow you to move away from the hands-on patient care and the toll this can take on you physically. You will be utilising all your clinical knowledge and experience, exploring conditions and how they can impact on day-to-day life. It will enable you to improve your assessment skills, evaluate various situations and make important clinical recommendations. An ideal person for this challenging yet rewarding role will be compassionate and empathetic, have a wealth of knowledge in various medical conditions, possess great computer skills and good time management.

Extensive training will be provided to help you to transition into your new career. At ExamWorks we understand that this is a big change and put our full investment into teaching and supporting you. You’ll begin with a 5-week period (Mon – Friday 08:30 – 16:30) which will be conducted both remotely and onsite at our training centres. The training will consist of eLearning, classroom based, practical and mentorship. After the initial period, you will continue to work on your ongoing development whilst receiving full guidance and support.

We believe that progression is an important step in any career and the opportunities available once you are comfortable in the role can include Clinical Support Lead, Mentor, Trainer, Interviewer and more!

If you are looking for a better work/life balance, no evenings or weekends, a competitive salary, a range of benefits and a new way of working, this could be the perfect role for you.

What you can expect to be doing –

- Carrying out assessments – both via telephone from home and face to face from your closest assessment centre

- Using your clinical knowledge and experience to analyse information and supporting evidence.

- Collating all findings into a comprehensive report of 3,000 – 4,000 words, including justification and evidence, which will support the DWP in their decision making. 3 per day

- Developing any gaps in your clinical knowledge by learning about various other health conditions

- Attending additional training and CPD sessions

What we need from you –

- One year minimum post qualification experience as a Nurse, Paramedic, Physiotherapist or Occupational Therapist

- Valid PIN and fully registered member of your regulatory body – NMC or HCPC, with no conditions or restrictions

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to listen, explore further and be empathetic

- Good time management with the ability to work to targets whilst producing quality reports

- A good level of computer literacy and comfortable with typing

Working hours –

We offer both full and part time contracts (after the initial fulltime 6-week training period). You can choose 3 days (22.5 hours), 4 days (30 hours) or stick with 5 days (37.5 hours), Monday – Friday 08:30 – 16:30.

Who are ExamWorks?

We are part of ExamWorks and have supported the DWP on the delivery of PIP assessments for over a decade and pride ourselves on offering an excellent service as part of our wide and varied business.

We are all about health here and whether that is PIP, MedCo Legal, Accident Management, Occupational Health or Rehabilitation Services we go the extra mile.

What’s in it for you?

- A competitive basic salary

- A hybrid working model allowing for working from home a number of days pay week.

- The opportunity to take a paid day out of the office, volunteering for our charity partners or a cause of your choice

At Platform Property Care, we're looking for a Lead Engineer - Carpentry to join our team in Birmingham. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced multi skilled Carpenter to combine hands-on trade expertise supporting colleagues, driving quality standards and helping improve our service delivery.

Acting as the subject matter expert for carpentry, you'll spend around 70-80% of your time delivering repairs and maintenance work, while dedicating the remainder to coaching colleagues, assessing competence, supporting apprentices, and promoting best practice across our Property Care teams.

What could you be doing?

You'll be ensuring our customers' homes are maintained and repaired to a high standard while also helping to drive consistency, quality, and best practice across our Property Care teams.

As a Lead Engineer - Carpentry, you will:

- Carry out a wide range of carpentry repairs and maintenance work within customers' homes and communal areas.

- Manage jobs from inspection through to completion, ensuring excellent customer service throughout.

- Support colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and skills development.

- Assess and sign off colleagues against our multi-skill framework and support apprentices through their End Point Assessments (EPA).

- Promote consistent trade standards and best practice across Platform Property Care.

- Work alongside Learning & Development teams to support trade training and upskilling initiatives.

- Conduct trade audits, reviews, and quality assessments to ensure compliance and high standards.

- Act as a technical expert and escalation point for trade-related queries.

- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and help shape future ways of working.

No two days are the same. It's a challenging and rewarding role that offers the opportunity to combine practical trade expertise with developing others and improving services for our customers.

Who are we looking for?

You'll be a highly motivated and customer-focused professional who takes pride in delivering quality workmanship and supporting others to succeed.

You will be:

- A strong team player with a positive, can-do attitude.

- Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of your workload.

- Passionate about developing others and sharing your knowledge.

- Organised and focused on delivering right-first-time outcomes.

- Able to communicate effectively with customers, colleagues, and apprentices.

- Committed to maintaining excellent health and safety standards.

Some things we need from you:

- NVQ Level 2, City & Guilds Level 2, or equivalent qualification in Carpentry.

- Additional Trade qualifications

- Significant experience working as a Carpenter within the building trade.

- Experience working within occupied domestic properties.

- Strong knowledge of health and safety requirements.

- Experience of recording accurate job and repair information using mobile devices.

- Good IT and digital skills

- The ability to coach, support and develop colleagues.

- A commitment to delivering excellent customer service.

- Experience working within social housing, a local authority or housing association.

- Previous coaching, mentoring, or assessor experience.

- A full valid driving licence is essential as this is a mobile role.

- As you will be working within Customers' homes this role requires a DBS check.

- This role is for a team covering Birmingham. Ideally you will only have a maximum of an hour's commute to this area.

Working for Platform Property Care, you will benefit from

- Competitive salary of £41,800 plus opportunities for overtime and out-of-hours payments.

- 25 days annual leave, with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days.

- Pension scheme with employer contributions of up to 12% (inclusive of life assurance).

- Company van and fuel card for business use.

- Mobile phone, tablet, and lone worker device.

- Access to healthcare and wellbeing benefits through Medicash.

- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.

- The chance to play a key role in shaping trade excellence across our Property Care teams.

Why apply?

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced multi skilled Carpenter looking to take the next step in their career. As a Lead Engineer - Carpentry, you'll play a key role in driving technical excellence, developing colleagues, improving service quality, and delivering outstanding outcomes for customers.

Part of Platform Housing Group, Platform Property Care is a well-established property maintenance business. We value the contribution our colleagues make and are committed to developing a highly skilled and engaged workforce that delivers excellent services for our customers.

If this sounds like the place for you then we'd love to hear from you! To find out more about this role, please contact recruitment@platformhg.com.

This role is mobile, so it is essential that you hold a valid UK driving licence. Unfortunately, we cannot progress applications from candidates who do not hold this.

We do not require recruitment agency support at this time. All speculative CVs will be treated as direct applications.

description:
- Total Salary: £56,898 per annum. This comprises a base salary of £51,898 plus area weighting allowance

We are looking for an experienced, strategic leader to oversee the delivery of high-quality housing and support services within Nacro's Community Accommodation with Support Tier 2 (CAS-2) contract. This role combines operational leadership, people management, financial accountability and stakeholder engagement to ensure excellent outcomes for service users and commissioners.

We are Nacro,

We believe that everyone deserves a good education, a safe and secure place to live, the right to be heard, and the chance to start again, with support from someone on their side.

That's why our housing, education, justice, and health and wellbeing services work alongside people to give them the support and skills they need to succeed. And it's why we fight for their voices to be heard and campaign together to create lasting change.

We see your future, whatever the past.

This role sits within Nacro's Community Accommodation Support Service, (CAS-2) Contract which provides accommodation and support to people leaving custody or eligible for community-based alternatives to custody. As Regional Manager, you will have overall responsibility for service delivery, operational performance, safeguarding, property standards, financial management and stakeholder relationships across your region.

Key Responsibilities:

- Regional Leadership: Lead and inspire teams across a large geographical area, ensuring services deliver excellent support, achieve contractual requirements and maintain high standards of performance.

- Strategic Partnership Working: Build and maintain strong relationships with Ministry of Justice (MoJ), HMPPS, commissioners and key stakeholders, representing Nacro at a senior level.

- Operational Excellence: Ensure quality, safeguarding, risk management, incident management and service user involvement are embedded across all services.

- Financial Management: Hold accountability for regional budgets of up to £4m, ensuring income targets, budget management and financial recovery plans are delivered effectively.

- Property & Housing Oversight: Work closely with Asset Management and Housing Management teams to ensure compliance, property standards, tenancy management, void performance and rent collection targets are met.

- People Leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of Service Leads and regional teams, promoting a culture of accountability, wellbeing, continuous improvement and high performance.

- Service Development & Improvement: Drive innovation, growth and continuous improvement, contributing to service design and leading on specialist areas such as safeguarding, property, support planning or the female service offer.

About You:

- Experienced senior manager with responsibility for multi-site or geographically dispersed services.

- Strong background in housing, criminal justice, supported accommodation, social care or related services.

- Proven experience managing significant budgets and delivering operational performance.

- Knowledge of safeguarding, risk management, health and safety and regulatory compliance.

- Experience developing strategic partnerships with commissioners and external stakeholders.

- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, support and challenge teams to achieve excellent outcomes.

- Experience managing change, service improvement and organisational growth.

- Confident making decisions in complex environments and holding accountability for performance.

- Passionate about delivering person-centred services and improving outcomes for vulnerable people.

Essential Skills & Qualities:

- Degree qualification or equivalent experience.

- Strong financial and commercial awareness.

- Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

- Experience leading managers and developing high-performing teams.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities across a large operational area.

- Strong understanding of performance management, governance and compliance frameworks.

- Competent ICT skills, including Microsoft Office and case management systems.

- Ability to travel extensively across the region and nationally when required.

Success in This Role:

Success in this role means delivering safe, high-quality and compliant services that achieve positive outcomes for service users while meeting contractual and organisational targets. You will develop capable leaders, maintain strong stakeholder relationships, ensure excellent financial performance and create a culture of continuous improvement across your region.

Why Join Nacro?

This is an opportunity to play a key leadership role within one of the UK's leading social justice charities. You will directly influence the quality and direction of services that help people rebuild their lives, while leading talented teams and driving meaningful change across a significant operational area.

- Identify and resolve machining, tooling, and process issues

- Maintain a clean, safe, and organised working environment

- Comply with all company health, safety, and quality procedures

Skills & Experience Required

- Proven experience as a CNC Milling Programmer / Setter / Operator

- Strong working knowledge of Heidenhain CNC control systems

- Experience operating vertical milling machines

- Ability to program directly at the machine

- Experience machining exotic or hard-to-machine materials (e.g., Inconel, Nitronic)

- Confident in fixture setup, tooling selection, and work offset setting

- Strong understanding of cutting tools and advanced machining practices

- Ability to work accurately to tight tolerances

- Self-motivated with excellent attention to detail

- Able to work independently and collaboratively within a team

Desirable (but not essential):

- Experience with one-off, prototype, or small batch production

- Background in precision or high-integrity industries (aerospace, oil & gas, medical, motorsport)

- Knowledge of continuous improvement or lean manufacturing techniques

Benefits

- Competitive salary dependent on experience

- Stable day shift working pattern (38 hours per week)

- Early finish on Fridays

- Christmas period (approx. 5 days)

If you would like to speak to someone about booking a site visit, please contact Antony Brunn on 07881297172 for more information or send an email to abrunn@wftech.co.uk

With 12,000 colleagues, 30,000 couriers and drivers, 8,000 vehicles, and a nationwide network of hubs, depots and fulfilment centres, we combine over 50 years of expertise with the scale and flexibility to support everyone from casual senders to SMEs and major retailers. Driven by our friendly, ambitious and diverse people, we are passionate about delivering exceptional service and offer exciting opportunities across the Evri Group.

Position: Warehouse Operative

Contract Type: Permanent – 20 hours per week

Location: Glasgow

Shift: Evenings / Mon - Fri 3pm - 7pm

Hourly rate: £12.71 per hour

Join the UK’s premier parcel delivery company

At EVRi Premium, A network of DHL we lead the way in delivery, and always on the lookout for new talent! We’re market leaders and we invest to keep on growing. We’re more than just a logistics company—we’re a team driven by innovation, ambition, and a shared commitment to delivering excellence. If you're looking for a role where your contribution truly matters and your potential is supported, we’d love to welcome you aboard.

You might have seen the news that DHL eCommerce UK is now part of the Evri Group. This means there are lots of exciting opportunities for you to develop your career and make a real difference as part of the UK’s premier parcel delivery company.

You will be joining a new brand, Evri Premium, which is being launched in 2026. Please be aware that until that happens, your place of work and, if applicable to the role, uniform and vehicle will likely be DHL-branded. It’s also expected that the recruitment process will be with a colleague with a DHL.com email address.

What You’ll Do:

As a Warehouse Operative in our, you’ll play a vital part in keeping our operations running smoothly. Your responsibilities will include:

- Loading & Unloading: Handling parcels with care and efficiency.

- Sorting & Scanning: Using tech to sort parcels.

- Teamwork: Collaborating with a supportive team to get the job done.

What We Can Offer You:

We’re proud to offer a workplace where everyone can thrive. Here’s what you can expect:

- Annual Leave: At least 28 days of annual leave (including Bank Holidays).

- Career Progression: Opportunities to grow into depot management or train as an HGV Class 2 or Class 1 driver.

- Inclusive Benefits: Access to flexible perks including shopping vouchers, insurance, and healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. To succeed in this role, you’ll need:

- A commitment to health & safety.

- A team-focused attitude.

- Good attention to detail.

- The ability to stay physically active during your shift.

Everyone Belongs at Evri GroupWe're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to succeed.As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, a Silver-accredited Inclusive Employer, and through our partnership with Scope, we're working to make our workplace and recruitment process more accessible for everyone.We encourage candidates to request adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process and there are touchpoints through the application process to do so. Every application is reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team meaning that we don't use AI to screen candidates.At Evri Group, we're building an environment where everyone can be themselves and thrive.

title: Field Sales Representative
description:
Self-Employed Field Sales Representative

For over 60 years, Adjustamatic has been one of the UK's leading manufacturers of British-made therapeutic products, helping thousands of customers improve their comfort, mobility and quality of life.

Our product range includes adjustable beds, riser recliner chairs and our exclusive Cycloidal Therapy range, the UK's only medically certified Class IIa therapy of its kind. Our reputation has been built on quality, innovation and outstanding customer service, and we're looking for passionate sales professionals to join us on that journey.

Whether you're an experienced field sales representative or someone with the determination to succeed, we'll provide the training, support and qualified appointments to help you maximise your earning potential.

What you'll receive from us:

- Up to three enquiry a appointments a day, within a 2-hour radius of your home, booked by our dedicated in-house team.

- Sales commissions on all delivered orders, are paid weekly.

- Fantastic rewards with uncapped earning potential with an average across the company OTE of £75,000

- A unique range of products included patented technology.

- Initial fuel allowance for your start up in the field.

- Regular performance bonuses and year-round incentives and rewards are included.

- Opportunities to represent Adjustamatic at exhibitions and organised show stands

- Fully funded residential induction and sales training is provided.

- Ongoing coaching and support to help you succeed

What you'll be doing:

- Ideally previous direct sales experience with a proven track record in selling high end items.

Why Join Adjustamatic?

This is more than just a sales role—it's an opportunity to build a rewarding career where your effort directly influences your income.

You'll represent products that genuinely make a difference to people's everyday lives and their ailments while enjoying the freedom of self-employment, uncapped commission, and ongoing support from an experienced team.

If you're confident, motivated and ready to take control of your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and start your journey with Adjustamatic.

title: Project Engineer (MSP)
description:
About Tela Technology

Tela Technology is investing significantly in the growth of our Managed Services division, bringing together our technical expertise, customer-first focus and recent acquisitions to create a stronger, more capable MSP offering for businesses across the UK.

We’re looking for an experienced (MSP) Project Engineer to join our team at either our Hampton in Arden or Bromsgrove offices. As we continue to invest in our people, processes and technology, this is an exciting time to join our MSP team and play a key role.

The Role

This is a varied, hands-on role focused on technical project scoping and delivery.

Key Responsibilities include;

- Technical consultations: Acting as a trusted advisor to clients and prospects; explain technical options and trade-offs

- Designing and deploying IT solutions: Servers, networks, virtualisation, cloud infrastructure (Azure, M365), firewalls, backup systems

- Infrastructure delivery: Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, virtualisation (Hyper-V/VMware), storage and backup/DR

- Network configuration: Switches, firewalls (WatchGuard and Meraki; Cisco and SonicWall an advantage), VPNs, VLANs, wireless deployments

- Security implementations: Endpoint protection, patch management, DLP

- Security consultancy: Conduct and coordinate security assessments (Cyber Essentials, Microsoft Copilot, PCI-DSS; support penetration testing and vulnerability assessments)

- Scoping & planning: Collaborate with account managers to define scope, timelines and deliverables. Creating quotations

- Documentation: Creating/updating documentation (network diagrams, configuration notes)

- Time tracking & reporting: Log hours and update stakeholders

- Site visits: Perform installations or resolve complex issues that require physical presence

About You

We’re looking for an experienced Project Engineer (MSP environment) with 5+ years’ experience within a similar role, or a 3rd Line technician role (MSP environment) where project delivery has formed an integral part of responsibilities.

The successful candidate will have strong, hands-on networking experience, excellent knowledge of switching, routing, VLANs, trunking, LACP and STP, hands-on experience with WatchGuard and/or Meraki firewalls, experience with VPNs and wireless deployments, strong infrastructure experience across Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, virtualisation and backup/DR, experience with Microsoft 365 and Azure projects.

CompTIA Network+, WatchGuard/Meraki or Microsoft certifications would be advantageous, but practical hands-on experience, coupled with a service-focus is our priority.

Location & Working Pattern

This is a hybrid role, based at our Hampton in Arden Head Office, with travel to customer sites as needed. Remote working 1 day per week is available.

Salary & Benefits

- £40,000 – £45,000 basic salary

- Healthcare Plan

- Private Healthcare

- Employee Discount Scheme

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Life Assurance

Why Join Tela?

This is an opportunity to join a growing MSP at an exciting stage of its development, with significant investment behind the team, technology and services we provide.

You’ll have the opportunity to work on a broad range of customer projects, take ownership of technical solutions.

Please note this role is only being advertised directly. We are not inviting applications from recruitment agency candidates at this time.

Tela Technology are proud to be an Equal Opportunities employer. We encourage applications from all individuals regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and sexual orientation. Please get in touch for a full copy of our Equality and Diversity policy.

title: Sales Executive – TIA Wheels | £28–30k + Bonus, depending on experience| Telford
description:
Job Overview

The Company:

TIA Group is a successful family-run business that prides itself on building strong, long-lasting relationships with its customers.

As part of the TIA Group, TIA Wheels is a leading distributor of steel and aluminium wheels to the commercial truck industry across the UK and Ireland.

We are an established and growing business, supported by a team of passionate and experienced people with over 25 years of commercial sector experience. Our success has been built on developing an ever-growing and loyal customer base through high levels of customer service, product knowledge and a genuine understanding of our customers' needs.

Customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do, and maintaining strong relationships with our customers is fundamental to our continued success.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for ambitious people to join our team and play an important role in developing new customer relationships and further strengthening our existing ones.

About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying sales opportunities and developing a long-term career in sales.

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Telemarketing / Sales Executive to join our growing team at TIA Wheels.

This is a key role focused on outbound sales activity, lead generation and customer engagement, working closely with our established sales team to develop new business opportunities, strengthen customer relationships and identify potential commercial opportunities within the B2B market for steel and aluminium wheels.

This is not a traditional call-centre role.

You will be speaking directly with businesses, building relationships with potential and existing customers, understanding their requirements and creating genuine sales opportunities for the wider Sales team.

As an important first point of contact for prospective customers, you will represent the TIA Wheels brand and play a key role in creating a positive customer experience from the first conversation.

You will also maintain accurate customer information and activity through our CRM system, HubSpot, ensuring that opportunities are followed up effectively and passed to the appropriate member of the Sales team.

This opportunity would suit someone who is organised, confident, proactive, commercially aware and motivated by achieving results, with a genuine interest in developing a career within sales.

For the right person, this role offers a clear pathway to progress within sales, with the opportunity to develop your product knowledge, sales skills and customer portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Customer Service Support

- Manage incoming customer calls, emails, Teams messages, and correspondence promptly and professionally.

- Handle customer enquiries and process orders accurately and efficiently.

- Verify pricing, discounts, product codes, and customer requirements to ensure order accuracy.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to maximise account potential and support long-term retention.

- Act as a key liaison between customers and internal departments to enhance the overall customer experience.

- Understanding the commercial and basic technical elements of the wheels (products) to sell with confidence. Full training will be provided.

Account Management

- Take ownership of assigned customer accounts.

- Maintain regular customer contact through incoming and scheduled telephone calls and administrative follow-up/emails.

- Focus on relationship-building activities that encourage customer loyalty and business growth.

- Support sales targets centred around customer engagement and account development.

CRM & Administration

- Maintain and update customer records using the HUBSPOT CRM system.

- Manage daily CRM tasks, hot lists, and account activity efficiently.

- Support structured account management through organised administration and reporting.

- Work within “My Workday” processes to improve efficiency and account visibility.

Systems & Product Knowledge

- Develop a strong understanding of the company’s SAP system, products, and business operations.

- Participate fully in all training and development activities provided.

Team Support & Continuous Improvement

- Support operational projects and process improvement initiatives.

- Contribute ideas to improve customer service standards and team effectiveness.

- Work collaboratively across departments and provide support where needed.

- Demonstrate a positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Qualifications

- Proven experience in B2B sales or a similar role, demonstrating successful negotiation skills.

- Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

- Valid driving licence with the ability to travel as required for client meetings or events.

- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage time effectively across multiple clients and tasks.

- Proficiency in IT applications such as CRM systems, MS Office suite, and other relevant software.

- Demonstrated ability to build rapport with clients and deliver outstanding customer service.

- Knowledge of industry-specific products or services is advantageous but not essential. This position offers an engaging environment where proactive individuals can thrive by leveraging their sales expertise, organisational skills, and passion for customer engagement.

What We Offer

- Full training on SAP systems, CRM processes, and products.

- A supportive team environment with opportunities for development and progression.

- A varied and rewarding role combining customer service, account management, and sales support.

- The opportunity to become a valued member of a growing business.

- Performance related bonus

Pay: £28,000.00-£30,000.00 per year

Benefits:

- Casual dress

- Company events

- Cycle to work scheme

- Employee discount

- Free parking

- On-site parking

Installing Riser systems, Copper alternations and upgrades.

title: Senior Developer / Campaign Technologist
description:
All colleagues work a four-day week; colleagues receive 100% of salary for 80% of the typical working week.

Closing date: Monday 12th October at 9am

About the role

This is a technical leadership role, helping deliver the modernisation of the technology that lets our community of over a million people take action every day on the issues they care about. Our enterprise scale tools are being re-built into a modern, modular platform and you’ll be joining the team as a leader in this work

You’ll be the second senior engineer on the team, joining as an equal partner to our existing senior engineer. This role requires an experienced technology leader with a proven track record of delivering great product and engineering outcomes — someone who has already shaped product engineering strategy, architected and engineered great products, developed people and teams, and established engineering standards through the delivery of significant projects at this level.

For many years, we have maintained a spectrum of different in-house products and are now building a modular platform, and your experience of leading on projects or products like this will be extremely valuable to us.

AI first development is central to our operational and development model and this role will offer you the opportunity to work with a team who’ve already proven that we can use AI development tools to deliver for our organisation. We’re looking to you to help us explore and achieve even more.

We’re on a mission to create an elegant, stable and highly effective platform that sits at the core of our mission – to make our country a fairer, more respectful, more sustainable place, and we’re excited to learn how you’ll help with this.

You will have real agency and influence within a small, growing team to try new things and contribute to making a real-world impact. You will help deliver our product roadmap and identify areas for technological innovation that will continue an exciting new chapter of 38 Degrees. Day-to-day, we are working out how to deliver cutting-edge software development in the age of AI and we are excited for the successful candidate to be a core part of this process.

This is a rare opportunity to help redesign a tech stack, develop a best practice AI-enabled software development model with the highest technical standards and deliver a sector-leading set of tools for one of the biggest campaigning organisations in the UK.

There are no formal education requirements for this role. As long as you can show us that you have the skills we don’t mind where you got them from! To be successful in your application you must meet the requirements of this role and answer the questions below which are part of the selection criteria. Without completion of this task your application cannot be considered.

Your background and experience

We are looking for someone with experience leading development, teams, products and technical standards – you’ll be adept at setting direction and bringing others with you. You’re someone who’s accountable and takes ownership, delivering what they promise. You’re always striving to improve and effective at motivating others to follow the standards you set. You will have experience developing software using AI tools, and be brimming with ideas about how a small technology team can make the most of tools like Claude Code to multiply our impact and how you’ll use your influence in the team to make that happen.

You’re someone who understands the discipline around leading and maintaining a product, not just working across technologies. You are creative and curious when it comes to solving business problems, comfortable asking users “why” and understanding what they are trying to achieve, and you enjoy collaborating to identify and deliver the best technical solutions. You understand the non-profit campaigning domain we’re operating in, or you’re excited to learn. You demonstrate the specific technical expertise the role requires while also applying product-outcomes-thinking best practice to work effectively with end users.

You are a patient and clear communicator with non-technical stakeholders, and you’re motivated by achieving real lasting business impact and collaboratively solving business problems with users rather than simply delivering requested features. You’re driven by the opportunity to build best-in-class campaign tools and deliver professional, high-quality work that makes our tech products a joy for users and supporters to interact with.

You are flexible, as comfortable responding to short-notice reactive requests and staying cool-headed in a crisis as you are pushing forward longer-term product development work. You’re eagle-eyed when it comes to tackling technical debt and putting effective processes in place to maintain high-quality development. You’ll be keen to play a key part in shaping the culture and professional standards of our team.

And finally – you’ll need a passion for being part of our mission to make the country a fairer, more respectful, more sustainable place, and a hunger to give our supporters the power to help make that happen.

Full job description: Salary Scale F1 – Senior Developer _ Campaign Technologist

About us

38 Degrees is a community of more than a million people who – in a moment away from their busy days – take small actions on issues they care about, which all add up to something bigger, a movement for a better Britain for everyone who calls our country home.

A Britain where we all get a fair chance in life and where the place we were born, or the area we live in, doesn’t decide that chance. Where we protect our planet and hold those in power to account for doing the same, and where we are treated, and treat one another, with respect.

In the space of a week, millions of supporters could be campaigning on anything from protecting our NHS and stopping cuts to Universal Credit, to saving local green spaces and protecting our democracy.

38 Degrees is fiercely independent. We are primarily funded by small donations from hundreds of thousands of members of the public from all over the UK. This independence means we never have to hold ourselves back from taking on those with power and can truly listen to our supporters.

Benefits of working for 38 Degrees

38 Degrees’ approach to total rewards (salaries, rewards and benefits) is rooted in our Compensation Philosophy which defines our principles and the criteria to ascertain whether decisions on pay and reward meet those principles – our ultimate aim is to attract and retain a talented, driven team, and reward all of us for the impactful work we do in a way which is fair, equitable and sustainable, based on this philosophy and our vision to make the UK fairer, more respectful and more sustainable.

38 Degrees employee salaries, rewards and benefits are benchmarked against the UK Not For Profit sector.

38 Degrees’ culture is honest, kind, supportive, courageous, and respectful. We move fast, and frequently change plans to respond to events. We work hard but we also have fun.

We regularly enjoy team away days and social hours.

Additional Benefits (as per the statutory or enhanced qualifying conditions in the staff handbook)

Currently we provide:

- 38 Degrees operates a four-day working week. Our working days are Monday – Thursday. On rare occasions employees may work on a Friday to manage reactive work or communication with organisations that work a five-day week. If a bank holiday falls on a Monday, employees are required to work Tuesday – Friday

- For a four-day working week employees receive 24 days (pro rata) annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) pro rata. The office closes between Christmas and New Year, employees do not need to take this additional time from their annual leave allocation

- Employer pension contribution

- 24 hour employee assistance programme

- Family leave policies (some with enhancements)

- Employer paid annual flu vaccination

- Rental deposit loan

- Contribution to eye tests/glasses

- Learning and development budget

We are developing the following benefits which we will communicate when finalised:

- One month paid sabbatical leave as per policy terms after 5 years of service

- Cycle to work scheme

- IVF

- Menopause

- Religious leave

- Surrogacy

- Parental Bereavement Leave

- Global Remote working

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We’re especially keen to hear from people who’ll bring lived experience of the issues we work on and who’ll make our team more diverse as a result. So if you’re Black, Asian or from any other minority ethnic group, if you’re disabled, LGBTQIA+, or if you’re from a working class home, your application will be especially welcome. And thanks to our flexible home working approach and network of offices, we have a staff team that is increasingly based across the UK. A third of us live outside London. We’re keen to continue diversifying geographically, so that we’re rooted in our supporters’ communities.

To make sure that we are able to reach our goal of a diverse team we have equal opportunities monitoring requirements. Your application will not be complete without the equal opportunities monitoring form.

38 Degrees is committed to inclusive working practices, so during the application process we commit to:

- Paying for childcare whilst you’re at 38 Degrees interviews or tasks.

- Paying for your travel costs to the office and back – and for overnight accommodation if you’re travelling from a long distance for an interview although at present the majority of interviews are held online.

- Making any reasonable adjustments – for example ensuring we have a BSL interpreter organised in advance if you’d need one.

- If there is anything else you’re concerned about or think we could provide, please let us know.

To be successful in your application you must meet the essential requirements for this role and answer the questions below which are part of the selection criteria. Without completion of this task your application cannot be considered.

The successful candidate must have the right to work in the UK at the time of appointment.

Please see our Job Applicant Privacy Notice here: https://home.38degrees.org.uk/job-applicant-privacy-notice/

The recruitment process: In addition to your written application (details below), you will be required to complete a ‘live’ technical test and two rounds of interviews (all remotely). You can apply for this role by emailing your CV and the answers to the application questions below (of no more than 2 pages) to recruitment@38degrees.org.uk

Application Questions (max. word count: 2000 words across all questions)

How do you balance encouraging adoption with maintaining code quality and standards? description:

title: Head of Data & Analytics
description:
About the role

Head of Data & Analytics

Location: Middlewich, Cheshire (1 day per week)
Working from home: 4 days per week
Reports to: Director of Operations, Screening

Make data matter in healthcare

At InHealth, we deliver vital diagnostic and screening services on behalf of the NHS and private sector. We're looking for a Head of Data & Analytics to shape the future of data and analytics across our Diabetic Eye Screening Programme (DESP) and Child Health Information Services (CHIS).

This is an exciting opportunity to lead the transition from traditional reporting to a modern, data-driven analytics function, helping improve outcomes for colleagues, customers and patients.

The opportunity

InHealth is investing in a new cloud-based reporting environment and the Microsoft Fabric platform to modernise and enhance our analytics capability.

Working alongside Senior Developers, Data Engineers and an established Analytics team, you'll lead the development of scalable analytics solutions, data products and reporting capabilities, helping embed data-driven decision making across the organisation.

You will also play a key role in supporting data platform transformation and migration activities, helping assess readiness, identify dependencies and prepare workloads for transition into our modern analytics environment.

This role operates on a hybrid basis, with one day per week required in our Middlewich office. Applicants must be within a reasonable commuting distance.

What you'll do

- Define and deliver the data and analytics strategy and roadmap for DESP and CHIS

- Lead the adoption, development and governance of the Microsoft Fabric platform

- Design and implement analytics solutions using Lakehouses, Data Warehouses, Data Pipelines, Semantic Models and Power BI

- Develop data products, dashboards, KPI pipelines and reporting solutions that drive operational performance through analytics and automation

- Support and help shape data platform migration activities, including assessing readiness, identifying dependencies and preparing workloads for transition

- Champion data governance, data quality and best practice reporting

- Lead, coach and develop a high-performing analytics team

- Influence senior stakeholders and promote a data-driven culture across InHealth

- Act as the senior data and analytics lead for DESP and CHIS, providing strategic direction and expertise

Key responsibilities

- Lead the Data & Analytics function for DESP and CHIS

- Drive the ongoing development of InHealth's Microsoft Fabric and data platform capabilities

- Deliver management information, operational insight and statutory reporting

- Identify, develop and implement new analytics products and solutions

- Advocate for the effective use of data across the organisation

- Contribute as a key member of the wider leadership team

- Shape the long-term analytics vision and ensure alignment with business objectives

- Build strong relationships with operational, technology and executive stakeholders

What we're looking for

You'll be a passionate data leader who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, bringing technical expertise alongside the ability to engage and influence stakeholders.

Essential skills and experience

- Significant experience leading data, analytics or information services functions

- Demonstrable experience designing and delivering analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric

- Experience using Microsoft Fabric for data analytics, reporting and automation of KPI pipelines

- Experience with Lakehouses, Data Warehouses, Data Pipelines, Semantic Models and Power BI

- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets

- Experience of data modelling, data governance and enterprise reporting best practice

- Understanding of OneLake architecture and Medallion Architecture

- Hands-on experience supporting or planning data platform migrations, including assessing readiness, identifying dependencies and preparing workloads for transition

We employ a multi-disciplinary team of clinicians including GP’s, ACP’s, Home visiting Paramedic, Chronic disease nurses, Treatment Room nurses, Research Nurse, Pharmacists, HCA’s, phlebotomists, who are all supported by an incredible Admin team.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Research Nurse to join our friendly and supportive GP Surgery research team. We have been fortunate to see a lot of growth in our capacity for research, which is credited to our hardworking research team, and have a great reputation locally and nationally for delivering innovative research projects to our patients and the local community. We have recently used NIHR funding to create a bespoke Research hub within the surgery and are lucky to employ various clinicians in the current team.

Job Summary

- The post holder will be an experienced Research Nurse who, acting within their professional boundaries, will deliver high-quality care for patients taking part in Research. The main purpose of the job is to provide support for National Institute for Health Research (NIHR) portfolio adopted projects and commercial studies adopted by the practice. You will work across a range of studies which include observational research, novel drug therapy and clinical interventions. Under direction of the Research Lead Partner, and working alongside our current Research Team, you will participate in the recruitment and follow up of patients to research studies. The role will involve undertaking study related procedures as appropriate and the assessment, planning and on-going care of research participants throughout the duration of the study.

Key Responsibilities:

- Monitor participants throughout clinical trials.

- Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation.

- Promote participant safety, comfort and wellbeing throughout each study.

- Work closely with physicians, technicians and the wider multidisciplinary research team.

- Screening of potential trial participants demonstrating knowledge of specific study protocols as required.

- Perform study appointments and related procedures which typically include, vital signs, obtaining blood and urine samples, ECG recording, documenting medical history, administration of study medication (although this will vary per study).

- Data entry and safety reporting.

- Record keeping must be accurate and legible with great attention to detail.

- Maintain up to date record of training.

- Optimise participant retention by developing good rapport and displaying professionalism at all times.

- Ensuring trial related nursing activities related to a wide range of therapeutic areas are undertaken in accordance with NMC Code of Conduct, company SOPs, Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP) and GDPR compliant.

- Ability to work under own initiative but always as part of the wider research team, maintaining good working relationships.

- Attend study initiation, investigator and research team meetings as required.

- Maintain study databases, electronic systems and paper records where applicable.

- Assist with feasibility assessments and the implementation of new research studies within the practice.

- Support recruitment planning and monitor recruitment against study targets.

- Coordinate study appointments, investigations, samples and follow-up activities.

- Communicate effectively with study sponsors, Clinical Research Networks, Contract Research Organisations and other relevant organisations.

- Assist with the preparation and maintenance of study files and documentation.

- Manage competing study requirements effectively and prioritise workload appropriately.

If you would be interested in joining our team or finding out more about the role, please forward a CV to abbie.rickwood@nhs.net or apply within by 30th September 2026.

title: Management Accountant
description:
Management Accountant

£40,000 – £45,000 per annum | Full-time | Permanent | On-site
Location: Sheffield

Important: Initial Training in Poole

Please note: the successful candidate will be required to travel to our Poole site up to 3 days per week for the first few months of the role.
