Candidates must be comfortable with this travel requirement before applying.

Following the initial training period, the role will be primarily based at our Sheffield site.

About the Role

We are recruiting an experienced and commercially focused Management Accountant to join our finance team within a growing food manufacturing business.

This is a key role within the finance function, providing accurate financial reporting, insightful analysis and commercial support to help drive business performance.

You will work closely with operational and departmental managers, providing financial guidance, challenging performance and identifying opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency and cost control.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can do more than simply produce the numbers. You will be expected to understand the story behind the figures, understand what is happening across the operation and translate financial information into practical business insight.

Manufacturing Experience is Essential

Previous experience within a manufacturing environment is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in food manufacturing, FMCG or another operationally focused production environment.

You should understand how manufacturing activity impacts financial performance, including production costs, product costing, stock, margins, labour, overheads and operational KPIs.

Experience working directly with production, operations or supply chain teams will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare accurate monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis.

- Produce P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reporting.

- Analyse financial performance against budget and forecast, identifying trends, risks and opportunities.

- Prepare and post monthly journals, accruals and prepayments.

- Complete accurate and timely balance sheet reconciliations.

- Lead and support the annual budgeting and forecasting process.

- Prepare financial models and scenario analysis to support business planning.

- Monitor business performance against budgets and provide clear, actionable financial insight.

- Work closely with department managers as a finance business partner.

- Provide financial guidance and constructive challenge to operational stakeholders.

- Translate financial information into meaningful business insights.

- Analyse revenue, costs, margins and operational performance.

- Analyse production costs, stock and product profitability.

- Identify opportunities to improve profitability and cost control.

- Prepare ad-hoc reports and management information as required.

- Support business cases, investment appraisals and capital expenditure reviews.

- Identify financial risks and opportunities that may impact business performance.

- Maintain robust financial controls and processes.

- Support internal and external audit requirements.

- Assist with statutory reporting and tax compliance activities where required.

- Review and improve financial processes, reporting systems and controls.

- Drive efficiencies through automation and process improvement.

- Support finance transformation projects and implementation of new systems.

About You

You will be an experienced Management Accountant with a strong understanding of management accounting, financial reporting and commercial analysis.

Most importantly, you will have hands-on manufacturing experience and understand the relationship between finance and day-to-day operational performance.

You will be confident working with production, operations and supply chain teams and comfortable challenging performance, investigating variances and identifying opportunities for improvement.

You will also be able to communicate financial information clearly to non-financial stakeholders and turn analysis into practical recommendations.

Essential Experience & Qualifications

- Fully qualified accountant (CIMA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent) or qualified by experience.

- Proven experience in a Management Accountant role.

- Previous manufacturing experience is essential.

- Strong experience preparing monthly management accounts.

- Experience with budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.

- Strong understanding of financial reporting and management accounting principles.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- Experience using Microsoft Dynamics, an ERP system or accounting software.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet tight deadlines.

- A proactive, commercially focused approach.

- Willingness and ability to travel to Poole up to 3 days per week during the initial training period.

Desirable Experience

- Food manufacturing or FMCG experience.

- Experience working closely with production, operations or supply chain teams.

- Understanding of product costing, stock, margins and production costs.

- Experience working with manufacturing and operational KPIs.

- Experience with Power BI or other reporting and data visualisation tools.

- Previous finance business partnering experience.

- Project accounting experience.

- Experience leading process improvement or finance transformation initiatives.

- Experience with Microsoft Dynamics or a similar ERP system.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a Management Accountant who can connect the numbers with the operation.

You will need to understand not only what the financial results are, but why they are happening and what can be done to improve performance.

You will be commercially minded, proactive and confident working with stakeholders across the business. You will be comfortable challenging assumptions, investigating variances and using financial information to support better business decisions.

Given the nature of the business, manufacturing experience is a key requirement. Candidates should have a genuine understanding of the pace and demands of a production environment and the financial impact of operational decisions.

Initial Training & Travel

The successful candidate will be required to travel to our Poole site up to 3 days per week for the first few months.

The purpose of this initial period is to provide comprehensive training, onboarding and familiarisation with the wider business, finance function and operational processes.

This will allow you to build relationships with key stakeholders and develop a detailed understanding of the business before transitioning to your primary base in Sheffield.

Please only apply if you are able and willing to commit to this travel requirement during the initial training period.

After the initial training period, the position will be primarily Sheffield-based.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take a key role within a food manufacturing business, working closely with senior stakeholders and operational teams and making a genuine contribution to business performance.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to use their financial expertise to influence decision-making, improve processes and support continued business development.

If you are an experienced Management Accountant with strong manufacturing experience, excellent analytical skills and a commercial approach — and you are comfortable with the initial travel to Poole — we would like to hear from you.

Get through to beyond Christmas and the New Year with a salary / income sorted....AND your permanent job search is unaffected too by taking up this role.

The last quarter of the year is strange. Interviews slow down, decisions slide into January, and the bills carry on regardless.

This is a three-month interim role designed for exactly that gap. You could start within a week, be paid c £230 - £250 a day, and finish around the time the permanent market picks up again.

Keep interviewing for your next role while this one covers the rent. No career move to explain, no job to untangle yourself from.

A large, well-known UK brand who have a transformation/modernisation programme under way. It is a name that is easy to talk about in interviews, and a story worth telling: you helped a team through change.

The job title says, assistant. The rate says otherwise. They would rather pay for someone who can start quickly and needs very little hand-holding, so you will be supporting three areas at once:

- Assist Financial reporting and month-end: schedules, prepayments, accruals, journals and balance sheet reconciliations

- Assist Management accounts and commercial finance: data prep and analysis, cost centre reporting, weekly and monthly reporting, budget support

This is a hands-on support role priced as a senior one. You will be getting stuck into schedules and reporting rather than leading month-end, and some tasks will be routine. title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer/ CNC Programmer
description:
About Midland Pressure Diecasting

Midland Pressure Diecasting is a leading UK manufacturer of precision aluminium and zinc die-cast components, supplying engineered solutions to a diverse range of industries. Through continued investment in advanced manufacturing technologies and ongoing business growth, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Manufacturing Engineer / CNC Programmer to join our engineering team.

This is a hands-on technical role combining CNC programming, manufacturing engineering, process development, quality engineering, and continuous improvement activities. The successful candidate will play a key role in optimising manufacturing processes, supporting new product introduction, developing inspection strategies, and driving operational excellence throughout the business.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious engineer to make a genuine impact within a growing UK manufacturer. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to influence manufacturing strategy, develop new machining processes, support automation projects, and play a key role in the company's continued growth.

You will work closely with production, quality, and commercial teams to improve manufacturing performance, increase efficiency, reduce costs, and support the introduction of new products and technologies.

Key Skills & Technologies

CNC Programming | Fanuc Controls | CNC Milling | CNC Turning | CAD/CAM | Creo | Fusion 360 | Manufacturing Engineering | Process Engineering | Lean Manufacturing |

Continuous Improvement | DFM | GD&T | Tooling Design | Fixture Design | Precision Engineering | NPI | Process Optimisation |Die Casting | Production Engineering | OEE Improvement | Hexagon CMM | PC-DMIS | APQP | ISO 9001

Key Responsibilities

CNC Programming & Process Development

- Program, set, prove out, and optimise CNC machining and turning centres using Fanuc controls.

- Develop efficient machining strategies to maximise productivity, machine utilisation, tool life, and process capability.

- Select cutting tools, work-holding methods, feeds, speeds, and machining parameters for a range of precision-machined components.

- Create and maintain setup sheets, tooling documentation, process instructions, and standard operating procedures.

- Analyse machining performance and implement improvements to reduce cycle times and manufacturing costs.

- Support production teams in troubleshooting machining and process-related issues.

Manufacturing Engineering

- Develop, implement, and continuously improve manufacturing processes.

- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) from quotation through to full production release.

- Review customer drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications to assess manufacturability.

- Provide Design for Manufacture (DFM) recommendations to customers.

- Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.

- Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives focused on waste reduction, process standardisation, setup reduction, and productivity improvements.

- Support automation and manufacturing technology improvement projects.

CAD/CAM & Tooling

- Generate and optimise CNC programs using CAD/CAM software.

- Create and modify CAD models and manufacturing data where required.

- Design and develop fixtures, jigs, and tooling solutions to improve quality, repeatability, and efficiency.

- Verify machining strategies through simulation and process validation activities.

Quality & Inspection

- Develop and support inspection methodologies for machined and die-cast components.

- Program and operate Hexagon CMM

- Utilise PC-DMIS software to create inspection routines, measurement reports, and dimensional validation programs.

- Support First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR), PPAP submissions, capability studies, and customer validation requirements.

- Investigate dimensional non-conformances and implement corrective actions to improve process capability and product quality.

- Ensure compliance with customer quality requirements and internal quality management systems.

Commercial & Technical Support

- Support the Technical and Sales Team with manufacturing cost estimates, cycle time calculations, tooling requirements, and technical feasibility reviews.

- Participate in customer discussions regarding manufacturing methods, quality requirements, and process capability.

- Collaborate with production, quality, tooling, and engineering departments to ensure successful project delivery.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

- Provide technical support and mentoring to CNC setters, operators, apprentices, and junior engineers.

- Lead and participate in continuous improvement projects across the manufacturing operation.

- Promote best practices in quality, safety, and engineering excellence.

- Support preventative maintenance activities and machine capability improvements.

Equipment & Technology

- The successful candidate will work with a range of modern manufacturing equipment and technologies, including:

- Doosan CNC Machines

- Brother CNC Machining Centres

- Feeler CNC Machines

- Fanuc Control Systems

- Hexagon CMM -PC-DMIS Inspection Software

- CAD/CAM Software (Creo and Fusion 360 preferred)

Essential Requirements

- Proven CNC programming experience using Fanuc controls.

- Experience setting and optimising CNC milling and turning operations.

- Strong understanding of machining principles, tooling technology, and manufacturing processes.

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and GD&T.

- Manufacturing engineering experience within a precision engineering environment.

- CAD/CAM programming experience.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Experience identifying and implementing process improvements.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

- Self-motivated with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

Desirable Skills & Experience

- Experience using Creo and/or Fusion 360.

- Experience operating and programming Hexagon CMM equipment.

- Experience using PC-DMIS for dimensional inspection and reporting.

- Knowledge of PPAP, APQP, PFMEA, SPC, and Control Plans.

- Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement experience.

- Experience within aluminium or zinc die-casting environments.

- Tooling, fixture, and jig design experience.

- Experience supporting customer quotations and manufacturing cost estimation.

- Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality systems.

- Experience supporting automation or advanced manufacturing projects.

- Career progression opportunities

- Opportunity to influence manufacturing strategy and business growth

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Controls engineering roles in industrial automation and manufacturing environments could involve designing, developing and optimizing control systems that enhance operational efficiency and product quality. This is an opportunity to register your interest in future Controls Engineer positions where you could apply your expertise in control systems design, PLC programming and systems integration to support complex manufacturing or process automation projects.

Please note the content of this advert does not represent a live vacancy.

About the opportunity

Roles of this type may sit within engineering teams delivering automation solutions across manufacturing, process control and industrial systems. The work could involve collaborating with mechanical and electrical engineering colleagues to specify, design and commission control systems that meet performance, safety and regulatory requirements. You could contribute to projects ranging from plant upgrades to new facility deployments, with scope to take ownership of defined control system workstreams and see your solutions implemented in live operational environments.

Typical role overview

- Location: Birmingham, West Midlands, England

- Type: Contract · Full-time

- Rate: £250–280 per day

- Domain: Industrial automation · Control systems engineering

What you would do

Typical responsibilities could include:

- Designing and developing control logic for PLCs, industrial controllers and supervisory systems

- Specifying control system architecture, I/O requirements and communication protocols for automation projects

- Programming and configuring control systems using industry-standard languages and platforms

- Collaborating with mechanical and electrical teams to integrate control solutions into larger systems

- Commissioning, testing and troubleshooting control systems in manufacturing and process environments

- Documenting control system design, logic and operational procedures

- Contributing to continuous improvement of control system performance and reliability

What you could bring

Most roles of this type require the following:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline

- Demonstrated experience designing and programming industrial control systems and PLCs

- Working knowledge of control system architecture, real-time systems and industrial communication protocols

- Proficiency with industry-standard control programming languages and development tools

- Experience working with mechanical and electrical teams in multi-disciplinary engineering environments

- Familiarity with ISO 9001 and relevant quality management standards in manufacturing

- Strong technical documentation and communication skills

Nice-to-have experience could include:

- Exposure to SCADA, HMI or distributed control system design

- Knowledge of industrial safety standards and functional safety principles

- Experience with data acquisition, signal processing or advanced control techniques

- Familiarity with cloud-based or edge computing approaches to industrial automation

What roles of this type could offer

Most roles of this type offer the following, dependent on the industry and seniority of the role:

- Opportunity to work on diverse automation and control system projects across different manufacturing sectors

- Exposure to emerging control technologies and industrial automation trends

- Potential to develop deeper expertise in specialized control domains such as motion control, process optimization or safety systems

- Collaborative engineering environment with scope to contribute technical solutions and learn from experienced colleagues

- Contract flexibility with the potential for extension based on project requirements and performance

title: Veterinary Nurse
description:
Make a difference every day with PDSA

About Us

Join us to help keep even more people and pets together when times are tough. For over a century, PDSA have provided vital veterinary care for the pets of people in financial hardship.

We’re now on a journey to expand our reach to support even more people and their beloved pets. To achieve this ambitious goal, we need passionate and driven individuals who are ready to embrace change and help shape a future-focused PDSA. Together, we'll build a stronger organisation to ensure our services help those who need us most for the next hundred years.

If you're ready to make a real difference and be part of a team that's creating positive change, we want you to join us. Let's build a brighter future for pets and their owners, together.

About you

We’re looking for a Qualified Registered Veterinary Nurse to join our friendly team at PDSA Bristol. You’ll be up for a challenge and ready to adapt to the wide variety of cases we see at PDSA, no two days are ever quite the same. You’ll be confident communicating with a wide range of colleagues and clients, and you’ll enjoy sharing your skills, supporting others and leading by example in a busy, purpose-led environment.

You’ll play a key role across the hospital, getting involved in nurse consultations, inpatient care, dispensing medications and assisting in theatre, including Schedule 3 surgery. You’ll take pride in delivering high standards of nursing care while keeping pets calm and owners informed, and you’ll be comfortable working as part of a close-knit team to keep things running smoothly.

Your passion for animal welfare will drive you to champion the charity, promote client contributions and keep an eye on how we use our resources, suggesting improvements and efficiencies where you can. The work is fast-paced and rewarding, so we want you to have the work–life balance that suits your needs as well as helping us deliver an outstanding service.

PDSA Bristol is a highly collaborative, effective hospital, a great place for teamwork, case discussion and shared learning. Our teams have varied clinical interests, giving you access to a wide pool of knowledge and experience when discussing cases and treatment plans.

Our Pet Hospitals are modern and well-equipped and include separate dog and cat kennelling facilities, in-house radiography, ultrasound, endoscopy, piped gases and extensive orthopaedic equipment.

Rewards, support and benefits

We’re really passionate about being a great place to work, somewhere people feel proud of what they do, connected to a meaningful purpose, and able to make a genuine difference every day. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, and we encourage everyone to bring their ideas, individuality and passion for pets to work with them.

Flexible working options to support your work–life balance and individual circumstances.

CPD allowance of three days and £500 per year for development. Payment of your full RCVS fees, so you’re never out of pocket.

25 days’ holiday plus Bank Holidays, with option to buy or sell an extra five days.

Retail, holiday and lifestyle discounts available through our staff Fetch benefits platform.

description:
Are you a Registered Nurse, RMN, RNLD, Paramedic, Physiotherapist or Occupational Therapist and looking for a change? A Nurse Assessor role with ExamWorks could provide that new direction in your Healthcare career. We provide thorough and impartial assessments to assist claimants in being awarded the Personal Independent Payment benefit.

As a Nurse Assessor, you will join an established team of health professionals who conduct daily assessments to help the DWP (Department for Work and Pensions) to review and make important decisions. This role will allow you to move away from the hands-on patient care and the toll this can take on you physically. You will be utilising all your clinical knowledge and experience, exploring conditions and how they can impact on day-to-day life. It will enable you to improve your assessment skills, evaluate various situations and make important clinical recommendations. An ideal person for this challenging yet rewarding role will be compassionate and empathetic, have a wealth of knowledge in various medical conditions, possess great computer skills and good time management.

Extensive training will be provided to help you to transition into your new career. At ExamWorks we understand that this is a big change and put our full investment into teaching and supporting you. You’ll begin with a 5-week period (Mon – Friday 08:30 – 16:30) which will be conducted both remotely and onsite at our training centres. The training will consist of eLearning, classroom based, practical and mentorship. After the initial period, you will continue to work on your ongoing development whilst receiving full guidance and support.

We believe that progression is an important step in any career and the opportunities available once you are comfortable in the role can include Clinical Support Lead, Mentor, Trainer, Interviewer and more!

If you are looking for a better work/life balance, no evenings or weekends, a competitive salary, a range of benefits and a new way of working, this could be the perfect role for you.

What you can expect to be doing –

- Carrying out assessments – both via telephone from home and face to face from your closest assessment centre

- Using your clinical knowledge and experience to analyse information and supporting evidence.

- Collating all findings into a comprehensive report of 3,000 – 4,000 words, including justification and evidence, which will support the DWP in their decision making. 3 per day

- Developing any gaps in your clinical knowledge by learning about various other health conditions

- Attending additional training and CPD sessions

What we need from you –

- One year minimum post qualification experience as a Nurse, Paramedic, Physiotherapist or Occupational Therapist

- Valid PIN and fully registered member of your regulatory body – NMC or HCPC, with no conditions or restrictions

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to listen, explore further and be empathetic

- Good time management with the ability to work to targets whilst producing quality reports

- A good level of computer literacy and comfortable with typing

Working hours –

We offer both full and part time contracts (after the initial fulltime 6-week training period). You can choose 3 days (22.5 hours), 4 days (30 hours) or stick with 5 days (37.5 hours), Monday – Friday 08:30 – 16:30.

Who are ExamWorks?

We are part of ExamWorks and have supported the DWP on the delivery of PIP assessments for over a decade and pride ourselves on offering an excellent service as part of our wide and varied business.

We are all about health here and whether that is PIP, MedCo Legal, Accident Management, Occupational Health or Rehabilitation Services we go the extra mile.

What’s in it for you?

title: Sous Chef

Sous Chef – French Cuisine & Patisserie

MARIAGE FRÈRES | Covent Garden, London | Full-Time

Founded in Paris in 1854, MARIAGE FRÈRES is one of the world’s most prestigious luxury tea houses, internationally recognised for its exceptional teas, French heritage and distinctive approach to tea gastronomy.

Our landmark Covent Garden flagship is the largest MARIAGE FRÈRES Tea Emporium in the world, bringing together our Tea Boutique, Tea Room, Terrace and Private Dining within one exceptional London destination.

As we continue the development of our London Hospitality operation, we are looking for an experienced, talented and highly hands-on Sous Chef to take a leading role in our Covent Garden kitchen.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional Sous Chef position within a large brigade.

Working with a small kitchen team, you will have genuine responsibility for the day-to-day organisation and performance of the kitchen, with the opportunity to shape the operation, develop the team and establish consistently high standards across French cuisine, Afternoon Tea and patisserie.

Working closely with UK Management and in collaboration with the MARIAGE FRÈRES culinary team and F&B leadership in Paris, you will be the senior day-to-day culinary presence within our London kitchen.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will lead from the kitchen, actively participating in preparation, production and service while bringing structure, consistency, energy and strong professional standards to the operation.

What You’ll Do

- Lead the day-to-day organisation of our London kitchen.

- Work hands-on throughout preparation, production and service.

- Organise mise en place, production, sections and daily kitchen priorities.

- Lead, train, coach and develop the kitchen team.

- Establish clear standards, responsibilities and ways of working.

- Deliver consistently high standards across French cuisine, Afternoon Tea and patisserie.

- Ensure dishes are prepared and presented according to MARIAGE FRÈRES recipes and specifications.

- Maintain excellent standards of flavour, presentation, portioning and consistency.

- Work closely with Front of House to ensure smooth and coordinated service.

- Support menu development, seasonal changes, tastings and culinary projects with UK Management and Paris.

- Help develop appropriate London-based savoury and patisserie production.

- Manage production planning, ordering and stock control.

- Monitor food cost, yields, portioning and wastage and contribute to improved kitchen efficiency.

- Maintain excellent food safety, HACCP, allergen-management, hygiene and Health & Safety standards.

- Support Private Dining, events, launches and seasonal activity.

- Identify opportunities for improvement and bring practical, solution-oriented ideas to the operation.

French Cuisine, Afternoon Tea & Patisserie

Our culinary offer combines French gastronomic heritage with the distinctive world of MARIAGE FRÈRES tea.

Strong professional experience in French cuisine is particularly important, together with excellent technical foundations and a genuine commitment to quality, consistency and presentation.

Afternoon Tea is an important part of our London Hospitality offer, and experience within a premium Afternoon Tea, luxury hotel or comparable operation would be a significant advantage.

We are also particularly interested in chefs with professional patisserie knowledge and practical pastry skills.

You do not need to come exclusively from a pastry background, but you should be comfortable working across savoury and pastry production and interested in developing both areas further.

Kitchen Leadership & Team Development

This role requires more than strong culinary skills.

title: Software Development Apprenticeship
description:

You’ll join a friendly and supportive team where collaboration, learning and development are encouraged. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you’ll gain practical experience, contribute to real projects and develop your confidence as part of the team.

Alongside your role at Just Accounts, you’ll receive structured training through Baltic Apprenticeships, attending two-day training blocks every 6–8 weeks. This will give you dedicated time to develop your technical skills and work towards your apprenticeship qualification while putting your learning into practice in the workplace.

If you’re passionate about software, enjoy finding solutions and are excited to start building a career in development, this could be the opportunity for you.

In this role, you’ll work towards your Level 4 Software Development Technician qualification, delivered by our expert training team at Baltic Apprenticeships.

A Typical Day in the Job:

- Develop and maintain code using C#/.NET and contribute to Angular development.

- Write and optimise SQL Server queries and database changes, with exposure to PostgreSQL

- Write and run unit, integration and regression tests, using tools such as Mabl and Playwright.

- Investigate and fix bugs across frontend, backend and database areas.

- Working alongside the development team using Azure DevOps and Git to push and pull code, keeping work up to date.

Full training and support will be provided by your workplace mentor and from the team at Baltic Apprenticeships.

Desired Qualities, Skills and Knowledge

- A passion for software development, with exposure to C#, Angular and Microsoft SQL.

- Good problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Good communication and team work skills.

- Proactive attitude with willingness to learn.

- Strong attention to detail.

- A Grade 4 in GCSE Maths & Grade 4 in GCSE English.

Salary, Hours & Benefits:

- £20,000 per annum.

- Monday- Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm

- First 3 months office based, with the opportunity to move to hybrid working, dependant upon development.

- 25 days of annual leave plus birthday (increases over years of service).

- Cycle to work scheme.

- Private medical insurance.

This apprenticeship programme will provide you with everything you need to launch and develop your career in software development. Afterwards, we’ll support you to take the next steps, including further training.

Your Training with Baltic Apprenticeships

Learn to create, test, and implement code as part of a professional software development team.

With our unique apprenticeship programme, you'll build an impressive range of coding skills – and learn to thrive as a junior developer.

You’ll be based full time with an employer and will quickly become an important part of the team. Our training is 100% online, including real-time classes with our expert trainers and self-paced courses created by industry specialists.

To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the role and what you hope to gain from an apprenticeship with JustAccounts. If your application is then successful, one of our recruitment consultants will be in touch to discuss your application further.

Eligibility Criteria

You must have the right to work in the UK, and valid residency status to apply for this apprenticeship.

description:
At SIG Insulation & Drylining, we are one of the UK’s leading suppliers of specialist building materials, focused on interiors, insulation, and construction solutions. With decades of expertise, a vast branch network, and a commitment to outstanding customer service, we’re more than a distributor we’re a trusted partner helping our customers deliver successful projects, every time.

Warehouse Operative

We are looking for a reliable and efficient Warehouse Operative to join our team, helping us maintain our high standards of service, accuracy, and safety.

What's the role?

As a Warehouse Operative you will be a key part of the day-to-day operations of the branch. Your role will focus on ensuring the receiving, storage, picking, and loading of stock is completed efficiently and accurately, contributing to the smooth running of the branch. You will work within a supportive and safety-focused environment, helping our team provide the best possible service to our customers.

What you'll be doing:

- Assisting with deliveries in unloading and loading of vehicles at the branch

- Receive and store goods accurately in the correct locations within the warehouse/yard.

- Prepare customer orders according to sales requirements and load them onto vehicles.

- Sign for deliveries, report stock breakages, and maintain accurate stock records.

- Maintain a clean, organised, and safe warehouse environment.

- Carry out daily checks and maintain forklifts and other mechanical handling equipment in a safe working condition.

- Promote a “Everyone Safe, Every Day,” culture by ensuring the safety of yourself and colleagues.

- Be flexible and assist with stocktaking and overtime as required.

What you’ll bring:

- A valid Forklift Licence Desirable

- Good data accuracy, numeracy, and basic IT skills.

- Strong knowledge of health and safety procedures.

- Previous experience in a warehouse or yard role is advantageous.

- A flexible and adaptable approach with a can-do attitude.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well as part of a team.

- A customer-oriented mindset and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

What we offer:

- Great salary with annual pay award and staff recognition schemes

- 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays. Company closed during Christmas period

- A great pension, with SIG contributing up to 7.5% and up to 4x life insurance

- Money saving with retail discounts via colleague portal

title: Sales Development Coordinator
description:
The Indasol Group is a growing UK-based supplier of specialist adhesives, tapes and associated products to customers across a wide range of industries.

From woodworking and joinery to shopfitting, furniture manufacturing, signage, panel production and general manufacturing, we work closely with our customers to provide the right products, technical support and service they need to keep their businesses moving.

We are now looking for a Sales Development Coordinator to join our office team in Smethwick.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, looking after customers and finding opportunities to grow existing accounts.

The Role

As a Sales Development Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing and developing a portfolio of existing customers.

Rather than focusing purely on generating new business, your role will be about making our existing customers more valuable and more loyal.

You will build strong relationships with customers, understand their businesses and requirements, identify opportunities to introduce additional products and ensure they receive an excellent level of service.

You will work closely with our wider sales, administration and production teams to make sure customers receive the right products at the right time.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage and develop a portfolio of existing customer accounts.

- Build strong, long-term relationships with customers.

- Regularly contact customers to understand their requirements and upcoming needs.

- Identify opportunities to increase sales within existing accounts.

- Introduce customers to relevant products and alternative solutions.

- Follow up on quotations and previous enquiries.

- Monitor customer purchasing patterns and identify opportunities for additional sales.

- Re-engage customers who have reduced or stopped purchasing.

- Maintain accurate customer and sales information within our systems.

- Process customer orders and enquiries accurately and efficiently.

- Work closely with the sales and administration team to ensure orders are dealt with promptly.

- Liaise with production, purchasing and warehouse teams where required.

- Provide a high level of customer service from initial enquiry through to delivery.

- Help develop customers from occasional purchasers into long-term trading partners.

- Support the wider sales team with account management and sales activity.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, organised and naturally good with people.

You don't necessarily need years of experience in the adhesives industry. Product knowledge can be learned. What matters more to us is your ability to build relationships, communicate confidently and spot opportunities.

Ideally, you will have:

- Previous experience in sales, account management, sales administration or customer service.

- Excellent communication skills, both over the phone and by email.

- A confident and professional telephone manner.

- Strong organisational and administrative skills.

- Good attention to detail.

- A proactive approach to customer relationships.

- The ability to identify sales opportunities rather than simply process orders.

This is not a developmental position. We need a fully qualified accountant with a strong track record in group accounting, consolidation and financial reporting who is comfortable working independently within a large, complex organisation.

Based within our Central Group Finance team, you will manage the monthly consolidation process, fixed assets and VAT returns while supporting statutory reporting, acquisition accounting and the year-end audit. Managing the monthly Group consolidation process, including consolidation adjustments.

Driving a timely, controlled and accurate period-end close.

Managing the Group’s fixed assets and reviewing the associated reconciliations.

Ensuring central accounting transactions relating to tax, insurance, professional fees and investments are recorded accurately.

Completing or reviewing assigned balance sheet reconciliations.

-
Preparing and submitting VAT returns.

-
Supporting technical accounting matters and the implementation of the Group accounting manual.

Assisting with acquisition accounting as new businesses join the Group.

Acting as a key contact for the external audit and supporting the preparation of two sets of consolidated accounts.

Assisting with unaudited statutory accounts across the Group.

Working with professional advisers on consolidated corporation tax calculations.

Reviewing and improving accounting processes and financial controls.

-
Identifying opportunities to improve the use of Sage and other finance systems.

-
Supporting wider finance projects and process improvements.

What we’re looking for

This position requires someone who can operate confidently from the outset and take responsibility for complex Group accounting activities with limited supervision.

You will need:

-
A recognised accounting qualification – ACA, ACCA or CIMA.

-
A strong track record in group accounting within a large, multi-entity organisation or centralised Group finance function.

-
Hands-on responsibility for monthly consolidations and Group reporting.

-
Strong technical accounting knowledge and the ability to apply it in practice.

-
A sound understanding of balance sheet controls, statutory reporting and audit requirements.

-
The ability to establish and improve accounting processes and controls.

-
The confidence to work independently, manage competing deadlines and challenge existing practices when necessary.

Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with finance teams across multiple businesses.

Salary of £60,000–£70,000.

Hybrid working, with up to two days per week from home.

25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays.

Life assurance at three times your salary.

Salary sacrifice pension scheme.

24/7 online GP service.

Discounts on shopping, technology, holidays, meals out, gyms and more.

Free on-site parking.

title: Controls Engineer
description:

About the opportunity

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer – AI
description:
We’re Auros—the leader in human insight. Our mission is to help organizations craft exceptional customer experiences through fast, actionable feedback.

We empower teams to build the best products and experiences by embedding real human perspectives into every stage of the development process—from ideation to launch. With the world’s strongest participant network, AI-powered analysis, expert services, and seamless integrations, we help companies eliminate guesswork, align stakeholders, and bring customer needs into sharp focus.

Trusted by more than 3,000 organizations worldwide—including 75 of the Fortune 100— Auros delivers measurable business outcomes, reduces risk, and helps teams deliver with confidence. Joining our team means being part of a passionate group focused on transforming how companies understand and connect with their customers.

Let’s build experiences people love—together.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive IT Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in cloud and DevOps practices and a strong working knowledge of AI tooling and infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of modern cloud infrastructure engineering and the rapidly evolving AI enablement space. You will play a hands-on IC role in deploying and maintaining the AI tools, agents, hosting environments, and cloud infrastructure that support Auros' broader AI initiatives, along with other infrastructure and IT responsibilities. Target ratio is an 80/20 split of AI “building” vs traditional cloud infrastructure/IT work.

Key Responsibilities

AI Enablement & Infrastructure

- Set up, configure, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that connect AI systems to internal tools and data sources, including scoping access, managing credentials, and troubleshooting integrations.

- Design, provision, and support hosting environments for internally built AI applications ranging from lightweight PaaS deployments to full cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP (VPCs, compute, containers, load balancing) depending on the app’s complexity and scale requirements.

- Familiarity with AI features within existing SaaS platforms (e.g., Atlassian Rovo, Slack AI, Okta AI, ChatGPT, Google Gemini)

- Provision and support AI agent / application infrastructure: service accounts, API key management, permissions scoping, rate limit monitoring, and access auditing for agents operating across internal systems and cloud environments.

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to support repeatable, secure deployment of AI-hosted applications and supporting services.

- Maintain documentation for all AI integrations and hosted environments, including architecture diagrams, access maps, runbooks, cost/usage tracking, and troubleshooting guides.Stay current on the AI tooling and cloud ecosystem and proactively identify tools, platforms, or integrations that could benefit the IT team or the broader organization.

Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps

- Support the administration of Auros' IT cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) and DevOps toolset across the organization as it relates to IT’s AI Infrastructure.

- Become a subject matter expert for AI-hosted platforms, cloud integrations, and supporting infrastructure.

- Monitor uptime, performance, and cost of hosted AI applications; implement alerting and observability (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, GCO) to catch issues before they affect users.

- Identify, prioritize, and address technical debt across cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and integrations.Partner with other IT System Admins and Engineering/ Security teams to improve reliability, automation, documentation, and supportability of hosted environments.

Support & Collaboration

- Act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure and hosting issues for the IT support team.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Security, Engineering, People Ops, etc.) to improve cloud governance, security posture, and AI tool/app hosting adoption.

- Stakeholder management, this role will act (at times) as a project lead in some capacity. The ability to interact, demo and collaborate with non technical counterparts is critical.Document procedures, system changes, and troubleshooting workflows.

Job Description

The IT team at Auros manages company-wide systems and serves as an integration, automation, and support layer for the company’s many technology initiatives. This role extends that mission into the AI space, with a particular focus on cloud infrastructure. An ideal candidate is someone who can transition between managing our cloud infrastructure and configuring AI tools and systems like custom MCPs, complex agent-based solutions, and hosting environments for internally built AI applications.

The person in this role won't operate like a traditional software developer (In house IT focus vs public app focus), but must be comfortable working in technical, cloud-native environments with all that entails from an infrastructure and connectivity standpoint and thinking critically about how IT, AI tools, and hosted applications interact with the rest of the company’s tech stack. This role also has the need for communication skills and doing project and stake holder management work for AI Build / support work with non technical / non IT stakeholders and business owners.

Role Requirements

- Able to work Monday through Friday in the UK / Spain (Barcelona) timezones

- 5+ years of experience with cloud infrastructure and/or DevOps engineering, ideally with direct AWS and/or GCP experience (compute, networking/VPCs, IAM, storage).

- Practical experience deploying and hosting applications across cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)

- Hands-on experience with AI Concepts like MCP, AI Agents, and other AI related technologies

- Strong scripting & automation skills in Python and/or Bash, working knowledge of Git for version control, and comfort with JSON/YAML for config and API work.

- Experience with containerization (Docker / Podman) and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, ECS, or Cloud Run), including running and troubleshooting containerized services experience with MCP servers or similar tooling a plus.

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).

- Familiarity with API-based integrations managing keys, scoping permissions, reading docs, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.

- Ability to train and mentor IT staff on infrastructure and DevOps practices as they apply to your role and function.

- Familiarity with IDP tools like Okta, as well as the concepts of OAuth and SSO from an infrastructure/security perspective.

- Certifications in cloud or AI platforms are a plus (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Anthropic), but demonstrated hands-on experience is valued more highly and be prepared to explain this experience with real world examples.Ability to learn in a constantly shifting environment. We will do our best to manage processes, but the field of AI (and its infrastructure demands) is new and growing. Change is unavoidable.

#hp

Don’t meet every single requirement but excited about the role? We encourage you to apply. Research shows that some candidates are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications—but you may be exactly who we’re looking for. Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we’re committed to building a team with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

Application Process

- Meet with a Recruiter

- Meet the Hiring Manager

- Participate in a Panel Interview

- Final Interview (if applicable)Offer Stage

Accommodations

At Auros, we’re committed to creating inclusive and accessible experiences for all candidates. We believe diverse perspectives are essential to building exceptional products and experiences. If you require accommodations or would like us to tailor the interview process to better meet your needs, please contact us at talentexperience@usertesting.com .

Auros is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Auros will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, as applicable.

About Bragan

Bragan is a growing Irish vehicle accessories business, selling across multiple eCommerce channels and international marketplaces. Product development sits at the centre of what we do: we design our own range of stainless steel truck and van accessories in-house, using 3D design and 3D scanning equipment, and manufacture it in our own factories in Asia. We've also developed our own brand of vehicle lighting and safety lighting, designed specifically for industry needs and built under our own branding. On top of our own ranges, we're the Irish distributor for several specialist European accessory brands, including a high-quality range of truck alloy wheels and a premium Scandinavian sunvisor brand. We also hold a stake in an international product-sourcing business, which gives us direct routes into new ranges and new markets.

We're still a small company. That means whoever takes this role gets real influence over how it grows, not a fixed lane inside something already built. The product ranges, the manufacturing relationships and the sourcing partnership are in place. What's missing is the core team to build the structure around them and take the opportunity further.

The Role

This is a hands-on leadership position, reporting directly to senior management. A lot of our systems, processes and warehouse structure have grown as we've grown, rather than being designed from the outset — and that's the actual opportunity here. You won't be maintaining someone else's finished system. You'll be building one, hiring the team to run it, and then working alongside that team to deliver it, not just directing from the side.

We want someone who treats this as a chance to build something real and be rewarded as it grows, not as a caretaker role. If you're looking for a well-defined job with clear boundaries, this isn't it. If you want scope to shape a business and the upside that comes with getting it right, it is.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead business improvement and operational efficiency projects

- Review, document and improve company processes and SOPs

- Manage and implement software, systems, automation and AI initiatives

- Oversee business technology infrastructure — software, hardware, networks and IT suppliers

- Work with developers and technology partners on internal projects

- Bring structure to warehouse layout, inventory and stock processes as the operation scales

- Support customer service and day-to-day operational teams

- Support finance, accounts, HR and recruitment projects, including building out formal HR processes as we grow

- Coordinate cross-departmental projects and see them through to delivery

- Recruit, build and lead the core team this role depends on

- Help build a culture of accountability and getting things done

What We're Looking For

- Serious and dedicated, with a genuine read on this as an opportunity to build something and be rewarded for it

- A straight talker — someone who says what they mean and expects the same back

- A get-things-done attitude, not a report-on-progress one

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with machinery, building customer relationships and identifying sales opportunities. You'll play a key role in managing machinery stock, supporting equipment sales and proactively generating new business through customer engagement and canvassing activities.

​

The Role

As an Groundscare Machinery Sales Specialist, you'll support the day-to-day management, marketing and sale of groundscare equipment while helping to drive the continued growth of the business.

Working closely with our sales, service and workshop teams, you'll help ensure machinery is prepared to the highest standards, accurately valued and effectively promoted to customers.

Sales & Customer Development

- Proactively promote and sell groundscare equipment to new and existing customers.

- Generate sales opportunities through canvassing, prospecting, customer visits and telephone outreach.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, identifying opportunities for repeat business and referrals.

- Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery and equipment solutions.

- Prepare quotations and sales proposals and support machinery demonstrations.

- Attend trade shows, customer events and industry exhibitions to represent Burgess Tractors and generate new business leads.

- Maintain an active pipeline of prospects and follow up opportunities to maximise sales performance.

​

Stock & Equipment Management

- Assist in the assessment, valuation and management of machinery stock.

- Maintain accurate stock records, condition reports and pricing information.

- Work closely with workshop and service teams to ensure machinery is prepared to a high standard.

- Coordinate refurbishment, servicing and repair work to ensure equipment is retail-ready.

​

Marketing & Customer Engagement

- Create and maintain machinery advertisements and online listings.

- Respond promptly to customer enquiries, providing excellent product knowledge and support.

- Support marketing activities that increase machinery visibility and generate sales enquiries.

- Ensure customer and sales information is accurately maintained within company systems.

​

Market Awareness & Business Development

- Monitor machinery market trends and identify buying and selling opportunities.

- Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the groundscare sector.

- Maintain and develop a pipeline of prospective customers through proactive prospecting and canvassing.

- Monitor competitor activity and market conditions to support purchasing and pricing decisions.

- Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to support wider business objectives.

​

What We're Looking For

Essential

- Full UK driving licence.

- Strong communication and customer service skills.

- A proactive, self-motivated approach with a passion for sales.

- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Confidence in building customer relationships and developing new business opportunities.

- Previous experience in machinery sales, business development, stock management or a customer-facing role.

- Understanding of equipment valuations and market pricing.

​

Ready to grow with us?

Full-time | Permanent

Come and cook somewhere a little different.

We're looking for a professionally trained Chef de Partie – or an ambitious, experienced Commis Chef ready to take the next step – to join our kitchen team at Niche.

This is a hands-on cooking role for someone with good culinary foundations who wants to develop their skills, take responsibility for their own section and become a better chef.

About Niche

Niche is an award-winning independent restaurant in the heart of Angel, London, just moments from Sadler's Wells Theatre.

For more than 13 years we've built a reputation that reaches far beyond our restaurant. We were London's first 100% gluten-free restaurant and today we're one of the UK's best-known destinations for free-from and allergy dining.

But we are a restaurant first.

We make almost everything from scratch using fresh ingredients, and flavour, technique, consistency and presentation matter enormously to us.

Our menu is entirely gluten-free, tree nut-free, peanut-free and sesame-free, with dairy-free, vegan and low-FODMAP dishes alongside our core menu.

Working at Niche isn't about limitations. It's about producing exceptional food that every guest can enjoy with confidence.

The role

As Chef de Partie, you'll be responsible for running your own section confidently and efficiently during preparation and service.

You'll work closely with our Head Chef, Sous Chef and the rest of the kitchen team, producing dishes to our recipes and specifications while maintaining consistently high standards.

You'll be expected to:

- Prepare and cook fresh ingredients confidently

- Take responsibility for your own section

- Complete mise en place accurately and on time

- Produce dishes consistently to recipe and specification

- Maintain high standards of seasoning, cooking and presentation

- Follow portion-control standards

- Keep your section clean, organised and ready for service

- Check and rotate stock correctly

- Minimise food waste

- Follow our food hygiene, health & safety and allergen-control procedures

- Communicate effectively with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house teams

- Support Commis Chefs and less experienced members of the kitchen

- Take feedback positively and continue developing your skills

We are a relatively small independent restaurant with a busy kitchen. Everyone contributes and everyone takes responsibility for the standard of food leaving the kitchen.

About you

We're looking for someone who has been properly trained in professional cookery and understands the foundations of being a chef.

You should have completed recognised professional chef training, such as NVQ Level 1 and/or Level 2 in Professional Cookery, City & Guilds, a recognised culinary diploma, professional chef apprenticeship or an equivalent UK or international qualification.

You may already be working as a Chef de Partie, or you could be a strong, experienced Commis Chef with the training, ability and ambition to take the next step.

We're looking for someone who:

Nulectrics Ltd is a growing electrical company based in Chippenham, Wiltshire, and we are looking for an experienced electrician to join our friendly and hardworking team.

We carry out a wide range of electrical work across domestic, commercial and industrial environments, so the work is varied and no two days are necessarily the same.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
Title: Supplier Quality Engineer

Reports to: Quality Engineering Lead

Position: Full time /Onsite /Plus local travel

Contract: Permanent

About the Company:

Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As a member of our team, you'll dive into an environment that encourages learning and boundary-pushing every day. You'll be part of an agile and dynamic workplace where today's solutions are built for tomorrow's challenges.

In this role, The Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) plays a vital role in supporting and developing Armstrong’s supply chain to achieve world-class performance. Responsible for auditing, verifying, and qualifying new and existing suppliers, the SQE ensures compliance with relevant industry and regulatory standards, while driving continuous improvement across supplier operations.

Key Accountabilities

Supplier Qualification and Auditing

- Lead and execute supplier audits (initial, process, and surveillance) to verify compliance with Armstrong’s quality, safety, and delivery requirements.

- Conduct detailed assessments based on ISO 9001, ISO 3834, and the Pressure Equipment Directive (PED).

- Qualify and onboard new suppliers through structured screening and capability assessments.

- Monitor supplier approvals, certifications, and performance against contractual and regulatory obligations.

Supplier Development and Performance Management

- Identify opportunities to improve supplier quality, delivery, and process capability.

- Drive and support root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (8D), and performance recovery plans.

- Collaborate closely with Procurement, Engineering, and Production teams to align supplier capabilities with Armstrong’s product and manufacturing needs.

- Maintain and communicate supplier quality metrics, scorecards, and risk profiles.

Technical Quality Support

- Review supplier documentation including weld procedures, inspection reports, material certificates, and quality plans.

- Support the introduction and validation of new or modified components or subassemblies from suppliers.

- Participate in PPAP, FAIR, or equivalent product validation and approval processes.

- Ensure compliance with pressure vessel and safety regulations relevant to supplied components.

Continuous Improvement

- Promote best practices in lean manufacturing, process control, defect reduction, and first-time-right culture among suppliers.

- Contribute to cross-functional quality and improvement projects related to cost reduction, risk mitigation, or product launch readiness.

What We’re Looking For

To thrive in this role, you should bring:

- Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing engineering, Quality Engineering or Management, or a related field.

- Significant experience as a Supplier Quality Engineer within a manufacturing, HVAC, or engineered products environment.

- Strong auditing skills with demonstrable knowledge of: ISO 9001, ISO 3834 (welding quality requirements), Pressure Equipment Directive (PED)

- Technical knowledge of fabrication, welding, CNC machining, assembly, and related quality inspection techniques.

- Full UK Drivers Licence

- Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams.

- Willingness to travel to supplier sites in the UK and occasionally in Europe – approximately 60% travel requirement.

- Formal qualifications in Engineering, Metallurgy, or Manufacturing Technology.

- Certified Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor (e.g. IRCA certified).

- Knowledge of materials (e.g. carbon steel, stainless steel, brass, copper) and their processing in industrial products.

- Experience using APQP, PPAP, 8D, FMEA, or other structured quality tools.

Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?

By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Nurse Assessor
description:
Are you a Registered Nurse, RMN, RNLD, Paramedic, Physiotherapist or Occupational Therapist and looking for a change? A Nurse Assessor role with ExamWorks could provide that new direction in your Healthcare career. We provide thorough and impartial assessments to assist claimants in being awarded the Personal Independent Payment benefit.

As a Nurse Assessor, you will join an established team of health professionals who conduct daily assessments to help the DWP (Department for Work and Pensions) to review and make important decisions. This role will allow you to move away from the hands-on patient care and the toll this can take on you physically. You will be utilising all your clinical knowledge and experience, exploring conditions and how they can impact on day-to-day life. It will enable you to improve your assessment skills, evaluate various situations and make important clinical recommendations. An ideal person for this challenging yet rewarding role will be compassionate and empathetic, have a wealth of knowledge in various medical conditions, possess great computer skills and good time management.

Extensive training will be provided to help you to transition into your new career. At ExamWorks we understand that this is a big change and put our full investment into teaching and supporting you. You’ll begin with a 5-week period (Mon – Friday 08:30 – 16:30) which will be conducted both remotely and onsite at our training centres. The training will consist of eLearning, classroom based, practical and mentorship. After the initial period, you will continue to work on your ongoing development whilst receiving full guidance and support.

We believe that progression is an important step in any career and the opportunities available once you are comfortable in the role can include Clinical Support Lead, Mentor, Trainer, Interviewer and more!

If you are looking for a better work/life balance, no evenings or weekends, a competitive salary, a range of benefits and a new way of working, this could be the perfect role for you.

What you can expect to be doing –

- Carrying out assessments – both via telephone from home and face to face from your closest assessment centre

- Using your clinical knowledge and experience to analyse information and supporting evidence.

- Collating all findings into a comprehensive report of 3,000 – 4,000 words, including justification and evidence, which will support the DWP in their decision making. 3 per day

- Developing any gaps in your clinical knowledge by learning about various other health conditions

- Attending additional training and CPD sessions

What we need from you –

- One year minimum post qualification experience as a Nurse, Paramedic, Physiotherapist or Occupational Therapist

- Valid PIN and fully registered member of your regulatory body – NMC or HCPC, with no conditions or restrictions

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to listen, explore further and be empathetic

- Good time management with the ability to work to targets whilst producing quality reports

- A good level of computer literacy and comfortable with typing

Working hours –

We offer both full and part time contracts (after the initial fulltime 6-week training period). You can choose 3 days (22.5 hours), 4 days (30 hours) or stick with 5 days (37.5 hours), Monday – Friday 08:30 – 16:30.

Who are ExamWorks?

We are part of ExamWorks and have supported the DWP on the delivery of PIP assessments for over a decade and pride ourselves on offering an excellent service as part of our wide and varied business.

We are all about health here and whether that is PIP, MedCo Legal, Accident Management, Occupational Health or Rehabilitation Services we go the extra mile.

What’s in it for you?

- A competitive basic salary

- A hybrid working model allowing for working from home a number of days pay week.

- 23 days’ holiday

- Annual professional registration fee reimbursed and supported revalidation with all the CPD you need

- The opportunity to take a paid day out of the office, volunteering for our charity partners or a cause of your choice

- Company pension, Health screening bi-annually, private health care

- Discounts on retail and socialising, to health & wellbeing, travel and technology

- Refer a friend reward scheme

- Access to Employee Assistance programmes including wills, mortgages, counselling and Mental Health Support

We’re proud to share that ExamWorks UK has once again achieved Level 3 Disability Confident Leader status, reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and accessibility.

As a Disability Confident Leader, we:

Promote accessibility and inclusion

Ensure inclusive recruitment and development

Share best practice across the industry

Continue to lead the way in supporting disabled people at work.

ExamWorks UK will continue to provide Functional Assessments until 2029

We have various training dates, through out the year and are always looking for those with a variety of clinical experience, in mental health, physical health and learning disabilities. We will coach you and support you in adapting your skills, into a non-clinical environment.

Our internal recruitment team are here to answer any questions and support you through the recruitment and onboarding process. Apply today and one of the team will be in touch shortly

Role Description

Title: Control System Design Engineer

Reports to: EMEA Engineering Lead

Position: Permanent Placement - Full time onsite

Base Location: Droitwich Spa

Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As a member of our team, you'll dive into an environment that encourages learning and boundary-pushing every day. You'll be part of an agile and dynamic workplace where today's solutions are built for tomorrow's challenges.

Role Purpose

The Control System Design Engineer will manage engineering design drawing revision control and work closely with customers to update drawings, review P&ID, block diagrams, and schematics, ensuring all technical files are accurately uploaded to the database.

The role includes overseeing the engineering change control process and maintaining up-to-date documentation of all process modifications, changes, and improvements within the BOM structure and routing system to ensure full traceability.

The engineer will also develop and implement structured methodologies for New Product Introduction (NPI) to support a seamless transition from design to full-scale production and actively participate in DFMA workshops to support value engineering (VA/VE) and the standardization of products.

We invite applications from experienced Control System Design Engineers with a background in building services or industrial control systems.

Key Responsibilities

- Act as the Design Authority for controls engineering projects, promoting shared standards, design consistency, and continuous improvement.

- Design and develop control panel hardware, electrical schematics, and control system software using industry-standard design tools.

- Produce and review Sequences of Operation, specifications, schematics, BOMs, and technical documentation.

- Manage design revisions, engineering change control, and maintain accurate documentation and traceability.

- Attend client and internal design review meetings, providing technical support throughout the project lifecycle.

- Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and support Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and commissioning activities as required.

- Support New Product Introduction (NPI), DFMA workshops, value engineering (VA/VE), and product standardisation initiatives.

- Collaborate with manufacturing, project management, and customers to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions.

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced engineering environment.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of all process modifications, changes, and improvements within the BOM structure and routing system, ensuring full traceability.

Production & Process Support

Production Support:

- Provide proactive technical support to production teams to ensure seamless execution of build plans, minimizing downtime and ensuring smooth operations.

- Collaborate with production personnel to troubleshoot issues and develop robust, timely solutions.

- Collaborate with production personnel to troubleshoot problems and develop solutions.

- Manage the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) process to address defects and implement corrective and preventive actions.

- Ensure full compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations, embedding best practices within production processes to uphold workplace safety and operational integrity.

- Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation of all process modifications, changes, and improvements within BOM structure and routing system, maintaining full traceability.

What We’re Looking For

To thrive in this role, you should bring:

Education:

- Degree qualified in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Experience in industrial control systems, control panel design, and automation solutions.

- Strong understanding of electrical control systems, schematics, PLCs, HMIs, and associated technologies.

- Experience with engineering change control, BOM management, and manufacturing documentation.

- Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

- Full UK Driving Licence (essential).

- Permanent UK Residency or equivalent

Skills:

- In-depth expertise in manufacturing processes and materials, encompassing fabrication, welding, structural steel, building construction, and associated trade disciplines, with proven experience in modular build environments and compliance with standards such as EN BS 1090.

- Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks Electrical) and other engineering tools

- Extensive experience with lean manufacturing and continuous process improvement methodologies in a low-volume, high-value manufacturing environment.

- Expertise in defining manufacturing and quality-related standards, originating visual standards, SOPs, and work instructions, and delivering training to skilled personnel.

- Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) (e.g., ISO 9001).

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Effective communication and teamwork abilities.

Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?

- By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

This role isn’t just internal support - it’s part of how we deliver nationally important work. If we do our job right, the UK’s manufacturers can do theirs better.
