title: Warehouse Supervisor
description:
Warehouse Manager

A busy and fast-paced business with great benefits, opportunities for career progression and a friendly, hard-working team. Join BSS as Warehouse Manager and take overall responsibility for the safe, efficient and well-organised running of our Glasgow warehouse, transport and delivery operation.

The Role

As Warehouse Manager, you'll have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operation of our busy Glasgow warehouse, ensuring we maintain the high standards of safety, service, accuracy and efficiency our customers expect.

You'll lead and support the warehouse team, working closely with the Warehouse Supervisor, Sales Team and Drivers to ensure customer orders are picked, checked, loaded and dispatched accurately and on time.

You'll also take responsibility for transport compliance and administration within the branch, ensuring relevant processes, records and documentation are maintained and that our delivery operation operates safely and compliantly.

The role will involve overseeing the wider operation and coordinating people, processes and priorities, but you'll also need to be comfortable getting hands-on when required. Whether that's supporting the team during a busy period, helping resolve an operational issue or stepping in to ensure customer commitments are met, you'll lead by example and understand the importance of being visible and involved in the operation.

You'll also head up health and safety for the branch, working with colleagues to maintain high standards, identify risks, investigate incidents and near misses, and ensure agreed processes and controls are consistently followed.

Key Responsibilities

- Take overall responsibility for the day-to-day running of the warehouse and delivery operation, ensuring it operates safely, efficiently and in line with company standards.
- Lead, manage and develop the warehouse team, providing clear direction, support and accountability.
- Work closely with the Warehouse Supervisor to coordinate workloads, order control and logistics planning across the warehouse and delivery operation.
- Ensure customer orders are picked, checked, prepared and dispatched accurately and on time.
- Oversee order control, ensuring outstanding, priority and problem orders are identified, monitored and resolved promptly.
- Work closely with the Sales Team to clarify order requirements, manage expectations and resolve operational issues.
- Coordinate with drivers and the delivery team to ensure vehicles are loaded correctly, paperwork is accurate and deliveries are dispatched safely and on schedule.
- Oversee the receipt, checking and storage of incoming goods and maintain effective stock control and warehouse organisation.
- Take responsibility for transport compliance and administration within the branch, ensuring relevant records, checks, documentation and processes are completed accurately and on time.
- Support the Warehouse Supervisor with logistics planning, including delivery priorities, vehicle utilisation, workload planning and resolving operational issues.
- Investigate and resolve issues relating to missing, damaged or incorrect products, escalating significant issues where appropriate.
- Maintain high standards of housekeeping, stock accuracy and warehouse organisation.
- Take overall responsibility for health and safety within the branch, promoting a positive safety culture and ensuring safe working practices are followed.
- Ensure hazards, near misses and incidents are reported, investigated and followed up appropriately.
- Carry out relevant safety checks, inspections and audits and ensure actions are completed within agreed timescales.
- Identify operational risks and implement practical measures to improve safety and efficiency.
- Support the training, development and performance management of warehouse colleagues.
- Lead by example and be prepared to work hands-on within the warehouse when operational requirements demand it.
- Identify opportunities to improve warehouse processes, order accuracy, stock control and delivery efficiency.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure relevant warehouse, transport and compliance systems are kept up to date.
- Work collaboratively with the wider branch management team to deliver excellent customer service and branch performance.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an organised, practical and confident leader who enjoys working in a busy operational environment and can take ownership of a warehouse and delivery operation.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

- Previous management or supervisory experience within a warehouse, distribution, logistics or transport environment.
- Experience of managing a warehouse team and taking responsibility for the performance and day-to-day operation of a warehouse.
- Strong experience of warehouse operations, order control and logistics planning.
- Experience coordinating deliveries, drivers or transport operations.
- A good understanding of transport compliance, administration and operational record keeping.
- A strong understanding of warehouse processes, goods-in, picking, dispatch and stock control.
- A strong understanding of health and safety requirements and experience of promoting and maintaining high safety standards.
- Experience investigating or managing workplace incidents, near misses and safety issues would be advantageous.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with warehouse colleagues, drivers, Sales and the wider branch team.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to make practical decisions when issues arise.
- Good attention to detail, particularly when dealing with customer orders, stock, transport documentation and compliance.
- The ability to remain calm and effective when priorities change.
- Good general IT skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
- A willingness to be hands-on and get involved when the operation requires it.

Experience within builders' merchants, plumbing and heating, industrial distribution, wholesale or a similar environment would be advantageous. Experience with ERP, warehouse management, transport or order control systems would also be beneficial, although full training will be provided on BSS systems and processes.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be someone who can step back and manage the overall operation while knowing when to step in and get involved.

You'll be confident managing people, setting standards and holding colleagues accountable, while also being approachable and willing to support the team when things get busy.

You'll be comfortable balancing competing priorities across the warehouse, transport and Sales teams and will understand the importance of clear communication and effective planning.

You'll have a customer-first mindset and recognise that a well-run warehouse and delivery operation is fundamental to delivering the service our customers expect.

Most importantly, you'll take ownership of the operation and lead by example, understanding that safety, compliance, accuracy, efficiency and teamwork are essential to a successful branch.

About Us

BSS Industrial is one of the UK's leading distributors of heating, pipeline, process and mechanical services equipment, supplying customers across the Building Services and Industrial sectors.

Established over 110 years ago, BSS became part of the Travis Perkins Group in 2010. Today, we have more than 60 BSS branches across the UK, supported by a National Distribution Centre at Lutterworth and a National Tube Distribution Centre in Coventry.

We have a wealth of experience across our business, from technical support and customer care to product engineering and design, alongside our market-leading own brand, BOSS.

At BSS, our people are at the heart of what we do. We work hard, support each other and take pride in delivering an excellent service to our customers. As part of the wider Travis Perkins Group, there are also plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career within a large and growing organisation.

What We Offer

In return for your hard work and commitment, you'll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive team and a well-established business.

You'll also have access to a range of benefits, which may include:

- Competitive salary.
- Annual colleague bonus.
- Contributory pension.
- Life assurance.
- Sharesave scheme.
- Colleague discounts across the Travis Perkins Group, including Toolstation.
- Access to a wide range of online discounts covering everything from travel and airport parking to restaurants, cinemas and days out.
- Opportunities for career development and progression across the wider Travis Perkins Group.

We're driving to become a truly inclusive employer. We want everyone to be at their best, and it's our ambition that everyone within our Group feels safe, welcome and confident to be their authentic selves.

You be you, it makes us, us.

title: Lead Power System Engineer (Protection & Control)
description:
Job Description Summary

The Power System Engineer will have prior knowledge and expertise in Electrical Protection & Control, Systems for grid-based substations and power generation and distribution equipment, or islanded grids including commercial &/or marine, naval power and propulsion systems, with deep domain expertise in protection relay configuration, development, test and commissioning.

You will provide technical guidance & leadership across tendering, design, and delivery of AIS & GIS substation projects (up to 400 kV), as well as asset level protection for (15 kV range), generation protection, and LV protection and will contribute to the overall protection & control strategy with a safety critical mindset.

This is a technical role involving close collaboration with multi-disciplinary teams (design & simulation, HV & MV Plant, Civil, Cable, CAD, FAT, and Commissioning) to specify, design, and validate Control & Relay Panels for MVAC / LVAC / LVDC systems, and Excitation & Synchronization systems for Energy, Marine, Defence and Industrial applications.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Have prior expertise in electrical protection, control panel engineering, and excitation systems for substations and power generation and distribution equipment.
- Provide guidance & technical ownership of projects, producing detailed specifications, site visit reports, FDSs, circuit diagrams, relay configurations, setting reports, equipment schedules, I/O lists, cabling, and MVAC/LVAC/LVDC load calculations, fault level & arc flash.
- Undertake relay setting calculations, CT/VT sizing, and configuration/testing of numerical relays (e.g., GE MiCOM, Siemens Siprotec, ABB Rex)
- Design and review Protection SLDs, Key Line Diagrams, General Arrangements, and Control & Protection schematics for transformers, overheads lines, ground cables, busbars, bus sections, bus couplers, and feeder bays
- Provide project technical leadership for design reviews, tender support, man-hour estimation, and risk management across multi-region projects.
- Support FAT, SAT, and site commissioning activities for control, relay, and excitation panels, including synchronization of synchronous generators with national grids.
- Ensure designs comply with relevant health & safety, national/international standards (as example IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-103, Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP/IP), and contract specifications.
- Support on-time delivery, cost, and quality targets, coordinating with HV Plant, Civil, Cable, CAD, FAT, and Commissioning teams.
- Provide technical support to Project Managers Application and Lead Engineers in managing project deliverables and variations.
- Mentor and develop graduate and junior engineers through structured technical guidance in protection design, relay configuration, testing, and commissioning.

Required Qualifications

- Able to achieve UK security clearance, and willing to travel for short term working.
- Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Power Systems or related technical subject.
- Experience with eTAP or similar to perform protection co-ordination studies, AC/DC load flow, fault level, arc flash etc.
- Hands-on experience with relay testing kits (e.g., OMICRON CMC) and panel design tools (EPLAN Electric P8 and/or AutoCAD).

Desired Characteristics

- Working to or achieved CEng accreditation.
- Knowledge of protection and control system design, testing, and commissioning for synchronous machines.
- Experience with communication protocol to ensure design comply with IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-103, Modbus RTU/TCP.
- Strong commercial and contractual awareness: scope definition, tender support, budgeting, on-site/remote support for Field Service Engineers and contract close-out.
- Demonstrated leadership, and the ability to multi-task across a variety of projects, adapting to changing circumstances and ambiguity.
- Well organised, good time management and excellent communication and report-writing skills, tailored to technical and commercial audiences.

You can expect from us

- Flexible working arrangements and an attractive overall compensation package
- Company pension contribution; income protection; private health insurance; life assurance, healthy lifestyle account
- Flexible benefits you can personalise and 34 days’ vacation including national holidays.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Nurse Case Manager
description:
Job Description

Location: Three Temple Quay, Temple Back East

Are you a Registered Nurse or Allied Health Professional looking for a rewarding role where you can combine your clinical expertise with case management and member support?

At Healix Health, we're looking for a Nurse Case Manager to join our experienced team, supporting members through their healthcare journeys while ensuring access to high-quality, clinically appropriate and cost-effective care. This is an opportunity to make a real difference by guiding individuals through treatment pathways, liaising with leading healthcare providers, and delivering exceptional customer outcomes.

Working closely with members, families, clinicians, healthcare providers, clients and internal teams, you will manage a varied caseload and play a key role in delivering a first-class healthcare funding and case management service.

About The Role

What You'll Be Doing

As a Nurse Case Manager, You Will

- Manage your own caseload, taking a proactive and member-focused approach to case management.
- Liaise with healthcare providers, consultants and treating clinicians to coordinate appropriate treatment and care.
- Monitor treatment plans and progress, ensuring care remains clinically appropriate and aligned to members' needs.

- Review healthcare costs and treatment pathways to ensure value and effective financial oversight.

- Conduct Health Needs Assessments and provide wellbeing guidance, support and signposting where appropriate.
- Offer clinical expertise and advice to internal stakeholders and non-clinical teams.
- Contribute to service development, process improvement initiatives and clinical training activities.

What We're Looking For

Essential

- Registered Nurse (RN/RMN) with current professional registration and a minimum of two years' clinical experience; or
- Allied Health Professional with current HCPC registration and a minimum of two years' experience.
- Strong clinical assessment and decision-making skills.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise effectively.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering excellent service.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and digital case management systems.

Desirable

- Experience within case management, healthcare funding or healthcare claims.
- Knowledge of private medical insurance and claims processes.
- Understanding of healthcare funding pathways and provider networks.

You'll thrive in this role if you're clinically credible, commercially aware and passionate about helping people navigate complex healthcare journeys. You'll enjoy building relationships, solving problems and working collaboratively to deliver outstanding outcomes for members and clients alike.

About The Company

We offer UK employee healthcare benefits, and travel, medical and security assistance in every corner of the globe. Our purpose is to help people in difficult situations – whether that’s a cancer diagnosis, a need for medical assistance when they’re far from home, or being caught up in conflict or natural disaster. We talk to them, support them, and make sure they get the help they need. If necessary, we’ll pull them out and bring them home.

We’re co-ordinators and problem-solvers: experts at navigating the global health and security landscape. Our teams of doctors, nurses, travel and medical co-ordinators and security experts make sure that your people will be looked after, whatever happens supported by technology designed help individuals, not slot them into a predetermined solution.

We work with governments, broadcasters, NGOs, international corporations, major insurers and more. No two clients are the same: we adapt our services to their needs.

More importantly, we adapt to the practical and human needs of the individuals we protect. Most of us are on the front line; we keep our back office lean. We don’t use scripts, and we don’t time calls. We never lose sight of the fact that we’re dealing with real people.

Company Culture

Instead, we focus on ensuring our highly trained specialists have the space and time they need to be effective. We let them use their initiative to get the job done, because the situations they face often throw up unexpected challenges – and no protocol survives contact with the real world.

Our clients have thousands of employees and customers, at home and abroad, so they need a business big enough to handle any situation. But they chose Healix because they also need an organisation that’s personal enough to care.

Our people are driven to do things in the best way, not the way they have always been done. We work hard, and our efforts are rewarded with great development opportunities and a supportive team spirit.

We want to nurture this friendly and dynamic company culture so that we can continue to attract diverse talent with a breadth of knowledge and world-class skills. As a part of Healix, you can expect a range of excellent benefits and an environment where people really do care.

Required Criteria

- Registered Nurse or Paramedic

Desired Criteria

- Case Management Experience
- Good understanding and previous experience of the private medical insurance industry and claims processing

title: Procurement Manager – Heat Exchangers
description:
Rolls Royce SMR is on a mission to deliver clean, affordable energy for all. As the UK’s flagship Small Modular Reactor programme, we are building a British solution to a global energy challenge and shaping one of the country’s most significant green export opportunities.

Our Procurement function is essential in establishing the commercial and supply chain foundations required to deliver our first SMR and future fleet. To support this, we’re looking for a Procurement Manager to lead high value sourcing activity, shape Heat Exchanger, Tank & Accumulator category strategies and manage deeply technical and strategically significant supplier relationships.

Reporting to a Senior Category Manager, you’ll influence commercial strategy, drive long term value and help build a high performance procurement capability for one of the UK’s most advanced engineering programmes.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Manage procurement activities and lead the development of complex, high value manufacturing and engineering contracts across these categories.
- Manage, coach and develop a team of Buyers and Senior Buyers, building a high performing, engineering aligned procurement function.
- Establish and lead cross functional sourcing teams, ensuring collaboration and alignment with Engineering, Programme Delivery, Safety, Quality and Operations.
- Run end-to-end procurement activity including sourcing, tendering, evaluation, negotiation, contract development, award and mobilisation.
- Manage supplier relationships and performance, ensuring capability, compliance, on time delivery and continuous improvement across a highly regulated supply base.
- Lead commercial negotiations for long term manufacturing frameworks, MSAs, SoWs and complex technical contracts.
- Act as category subject matter expert, providing market insight, cost analysis, supplier capability assessments and strategic direction.
- Contribute to and lead initiatives such as supplier consolidation, design for manufacture improvements, value engineering, risk reduction and sustainability.

What You’ll Bring

- Experience managing complex engineered procurement, ideally in power generation, nuclear, energy, aerospace, defence or heavy manufacturing.
- Strong commercial acumen with a track record of strategic sourcing, complex negotiations and measurable value delivery.
- Ability to interpret technical, commercial and financial information to present clear recommendations.
- Experience working in regulated or highly technical supply chains.
- Strong planning, organisation and project management capability.

Location & Ways of Working

This role can be based from our Derby, Manchester or Warrington office.

We operate hybrid working, with regular weekly office attendance expected.

Some travel may be required depending on supplier or programme needs.

What’s in it for you?

We offer a starting base salary from £63,750 to £78,750 depending on experience and benefits include:

- Performance related bonus (12.5% target)
- £2,200 flexible benefits allowance
- 12% employer pension / 6% employee
- 28 days holiday + public holidays (option to buy/sell up to 4 days)
- Private Medical Insurance (BUPA)
- Life Assurance – 6× pensionable pay
- £250 home office setup payment

You’ll join a forward thinking organisation that values transparency, fairness and innovation, offering:

- A flexible, inclusive and supportive working environment
- Opportunities for development and career growth in a scaling business
- A culture built on diversity, collaboration and continuous learning

You’ll be joining a forward-thinking organisation that values transparency, fairness, and innovation. We offer:

- A flexible, inclusive, and supportive working environment.
- Opportunities for career growth in a rapidly scaling business.
- A culture that values diversity, innovation, and continuous learning.

title: HGV Class 2 Tipper Driver - Nights
description:
FM Conway is currently seeking a HGV Class 2 Tipper Driver - Nights to join our Aggregates and Asphalt Division based from our Erith depot. As our HGV Class 2 Tipper Driver - Nights, you will drive an allocated tipper vehicle to transport asphalt and aggregate to various sites. You will join us on a full time, permanent basis, working nights 18:00 - 04:00.

The duties of the HGV Class 2 Tipper Driver - Nights role will include:

- Driving and operating Class 2 HGV to/from site
- Transporting asphalt to our customers in a safe and professional manner
- Working in conjunction with your supervisor’s instructions
- Maintaining vehicle and equipment in line with established company standards
- Completing and submitting the required daily defect sheet
- Acting in accordance with company policies and procedures

What skills and experience do you need?

Our ideal candidate will hold a full UK driving license, a HGV Class 2 license as well as a full CPC and Digital Tachograph card. Tipper driver and asphalt experience is essential.

What benefits will you receive?

As our HGV Class 2 Tipper Driver - Nights we will offer you a range of fantastic benefits including career and professional development, 21 days holiday plus bank holidays, rising to 23 days after 1 years service and a wide range of shopping discounts though our Rewarding Great People platform. We also offer a range of health and well-being benefits including a 24-hour advice line and support from our mental health first aiders.

FM Conway is a business of families with over 60 years’ experience of creating sustainable and innovative transportation solutions. We pride ourselves on our core values, creating a culture around Care, Innovation, Integrity and Excellence. As a family business, the heart of FM Conway has, and always will be, its great people and we are always searching for talented individuals to join our family.

So if you would like to Join our Family as our HGV Class 2 Tipper - Nights then please click ‘apply’ today.

We're deliberately keeping an open mind on job titles and qualifications. What matters most is that you have good hands-on personal tax experience gained within accountancy practice and are comfortable dealing directly with clients.

The role

You'll take responsibility for a varied portfolio of personal tax clients, including individuals, company directors and clients of the wider accounts team.
A large part of the role is personal tax compliance. You'll manage the Self Assessment process from start to finish, obtaining information from clients, preparing accurate returns, dealing with queries and making sure deadlines are met.

You'll have support from experienced senior colleagues when you need it, while having the autonomy to manage your own clients and workload.

Depending on your existing experience, you'll also have the opportunity to become involved in trusts, estates, partnerships, Capital Gains Tax and more complex tax matters.

There is an element of advisory work within the team too. You don't need to arrive as an advisory tax specialist – the important thing is having strong compliance foundations and the ability to recognise when a client's circumstances may require further tax advice.

What you'll be doing

- Managing your own portfolio of personal tax clients
- Preparing and submitting Self Assessment tax returns
- Taking ownership of the tax return process from start to finish
- Liaising directly with clients and HMRC
- Reviewing tax calculations, coding notices, statements and repayments
- Dealing with Capital Gains Tax matters where appropriate
- Preparing trust, estate and partnership returns depending on your experience
- Identifying potential tax issues and opportunities for further advice
- Working alongside the Tax Manager and Tax Partners on more complex matters
- Building strong, long-term client relationships
- Supporting more junior members of the team where appropriate
- Managing deadlines and your own workload effectively
- Assisting with new client onboarding and relevant AML requirements

What we're looking for

We're interested in speaking to people with solid personal tax experience gained within an accountancy practice.

You don't necessarily need to be CTA qualified and we're not looking for somebody who already knows absolutely everything.

You could be a strong Personal Tax Senior looking for your next move, an experienced Tax Adviser wanting more responsibility, an Assistant Manager who still enjoys hands-on client work, or a practice accountant whose experience has included significant responsibility for personal tax.

Ideally, you'll have:

- Several years' personal tax experience within accountancy practice
- Good practical knowledge of Self Assessment and personal tax compliance
- Experience managing your own clients or taking significant responsibility for a portfolio
- Confidence communicating directly with clients
- The ability to organise your workload and work to tax deadlines
- A proactive and professional approach

Experience of trusts, estates, partnerships, CGT or tax planning would be useful, but we don't expect every candidate to have experience across every area.

ACA, ACCA, CTA, ATT or similar qualifications would be welcomed, but relevant practical experience is equally important.

What's on offer?

- Salary up to £50,000 depending on experience
- One day per week working from home
- Free on-site parking
- Established and supportive tax team
- Direct client responsibility and genuine autonomy
- Opportunity to broaden your technical tax experience
- Exposure to advisory work alongside experienced Tax Managers and Partners
- Ongoing professional development
- Friendly, independent practice environment

Location: Leeds, within easy reach of the city centre
Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

If you've built good personal tax experience in practice but aren't sure whether you tick every box, we'd still be very happy to have a conversation.

description:

Working within the Record to Report team, you will take ownership of key accounting activities, strengthen financial controls and build trusted partnerships with regional and Group Finance stakeholders. - Prepare and review manual journals and Record to Report information for internal, external and statutory reporting requirements.
- Partner with regional commercial teams, Group Finance and external auditors to resolve queries, coordinate reporting activities and gather supporting evidence.
- Maintain effective financial controls and Group policy compliance while using insight and feedback to improve end-to-end accounting processes.

- Studying towards, or qualified in, a professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or an equivalent.

- Practical knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP, with the ability to apply accounting principles in a complex business environment.

- Careful attention to detail, sound judgement and an improvement-focused mindset; exposure to SAP, BPC, multicurrency accounting, retail, FMCG or a shared service environment would be beneficial.

title: Mechanical Engineer – Nuclear
description:
Overview

Are you an experienced Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about making the world a better place? Would you be excited to play a part in supporting the fight against climate change? Do you thrive in collaborative, creative environments? Are you looking for a challenging role that allows flexible working and work‑life balance? If this sounds like you, then we'd love to hear from you. We are looking for Mechanical Engineers to expand and grow our Derby office to meet increasing client demand in the region. As a member of our team, you will work on a diverse and challenging range of complex projects for our clients, with opportunities to work within AtkinsRéalis design teams or directly with our clients by being embedded into their major programmes. Whether you possess a breadth of experience from working across different markets or industries, or you already have a depth of experience working in Nuclear, we have the pipeline of opportunities to ignite your career and take your skills and experience to the next level. The variety and scale of projects we work on means that there is something for everybody, and we work hard to make sure that all of our staff have fulfilling and rewarding careers. Whatever our individual roles, we approach everything we do with a sense of curiosity, care, courage and community.

You will have the opportunity to apply your existing skills and develop new skills across a wide range projects across the full UK nuclear industry. In Reactor Operations, your core work will involve leading the design and substantiation of mechanical equipment to the highest standards of safety, quality, and efficiency, to enable the continued operation and life extension of our UK fleet of nuclear power stations and nuclear‑powered submarines. Our team also work closely with our Power New Build business, supporting Hinkley Point C, Sizewell C, and the development of Small Modular Reactors and Fusion Energy reactors, as well as our Decommissioning business, supporting the safe dismantling, processing and packaging of nuclear waste at the UK's nuclear estate at Sellafield and across the UK's decommissioning power stations and nuclear‑powered submarines.

Your role

- Whether you work in our offices or at client sites, you will be part of a team delivering a wide range of complex and exciting mechanical engineering and multi-disciplinary projects.
- Whether it's managing timescales, solving problems, or providing guidance to junior engineers, you'll bring energy and focus – helping the team stay calm, connected and focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our clients.
- You will enjoy drawing upon your strengths to deliver design and substantiation projects at all stages of the lifecycle, from providing technical input to bids, budgets and schedules, working with clients to explore feasibility and optioneer engineering solutions, to detailed design and construction.
- You will be able to confidently liaise with, present to, and influence stakeholders at all levels both internally and externally, in understanding their issues, goals, and processes and to build strong, lasting relationships.

About You

- You are someone who brings calm to complexity.
- You enjoy working in fast-paced environments and get a real sense of satisfaction from helping people stay organised and focused.
- You're naturally collaborative – someone who builds strong relationships and keeps communication flowing.
- You're comfortable juggling priorities, solving problems as they arise, and keeping things moving.
- You've worked with a range of engineering tools to design and substantiate mechanical equipment such as mechanical handling systems, machinery, test rigs, or mechanical components.
- You will understand how to deliver complex engineering projects through a structured design process, ensuring we deliver right-first-time solutions to our clients to time, cost and quality.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Rewards and benefits – Careers at AtkinsRéalis

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional information

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability. If you would like to be considered under this commitment, please let us know at the application stage.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description:
We’re On the Beach! Since 2003, we've been rewriting the rules of how people discover, book, and experience their perfect getaway. What started as connecting people to short-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger - premium beach destinations, long-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks – and that’s just the beginning of our story.

We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing.

Powered by our deep-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating - delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.

Ready to build the future of travel with us?

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you’ll design and build scalable applications, services and platforms across On the Beach.

This is a full-stack engineering position with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering, distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

Our backend engineers solve a wide variety of problems. You could be working on systems responsible for communicating with external travel suppliers, processing large volumes of hotel inventory and pricing information, powering customer search experiences, or ensuring bookings move reliably through complex transactional workflows.

You’ll work across the development lifecycle and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other technical specialists to design, build, deploy and operate reliable software at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing Day To Day

- Designing and building scalable backend applications and services
- Developing APIs used by customer-facing applications and internal systems
- Integrating with external suppliers and third-party platforms
- Building systems that process high volumes of requests and data
- Designing distributed and event-driven architectures
- Working with asynchronous messaging and streaming technologies
- Solving problems around performance, latency, resilience and availability
- Improving caching and data-access strategies
- Building reliable transactional workflows
- Developing applications and services within AWS
- Deploying and operating containerised applications
- Improving monitoring, alerting and observability
- Exploring AI-assisted engineering and modern development tooling

At Senior level, you’ll be expected to understand the wider system rather than only the individual service you are working on.

You should be comfortable considering how systems behave in production, identifying failure scenarios and balancing scalability, resilience, maintainability and delivery speed.

We’re looking for strong full-stack engineers whose experience leans towards backend and platform engineering.

You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience

- Strong commercial backend software engineering
- C# and .NET or comparable experience building modern backend applications
- Designing and developing APIs
- Building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures
- Developing cloud-native applications, ideally within AWS
- Working with messaging, asynchronous processing or event-driven architecture
- Designing reliable integrations with external or internal systems
- SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
- Building scalable systems handling significant traffic or data volumes
- Performance optimisation, caching and latency reduction
- Designing for resilience and failure
- Containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
- Observability, monitoring and operating production systems
- Automated testing and modern engineering practices

We don’t expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of solving comparable problems at scale are more important than matching every individual tool.

What We’re Looking For At Senior Level

Beyond the technologies themselves, we’re looking for someone who:

- Can independently solve complex engineering problems
- Thinks about the customer and commercial impact of technical decisions
- Understands the trade-offs between speed, quality and long-term maintainability
- Can contribute meaningfully to technical and architectural discussions
- Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues
- Raises engineering standards through collaboration rather than hierarchy
- Helps less experienced engineers develop
- Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities and problems can change quickly

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process all on Microsoft Teams, Which will consist of:

Hiring Manager meet & greet - 30 Minutes

Behavioural & ways of working - 60 Minutes

Tech Pairing & System Design - 120 Minutes, broken down into two parts (50 minutes each) with a short break and time for your questions at the end.

We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.

Ways of working

Our full time hours are 37.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you. We have core working hours between 10am - 4pm, so we can collaborate and enjoy the social side of work.

We also have hybrid working so we all work from home and from our Aeroworks office in Manchester City Centre. We operate a remote-first working model, with colleagues meeting in our Manchester office one day every two weeks. Please note that all applicants must be eligible to work full-time in the UK

Our Benefits

We might be biased but we think our colleagues are pretty great. They're the people that have made On the Beach what it is today and continue to make it vibrant and successful tomorrow. That's why we offer a competitive benefits package, known as our Beach Perks, to all On the Beach colleagues.

These Include

- 25 days holiday plus your birthday off
- Generous discount on holidays, plus you will receive 2 extra days annual leave on top of your holiday allowance to use whilst you're away on your On the Beach package holiday
- Access to Learnerbly learning platform, plus workshops, courses and professional qualifications
- Enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental leave and adoption pay, plus other family friendly support
- Employee Assistance Programme and free access to counselling
- Simplyhealth Optimise Health Plan
- Company Sick Pay scheme
- Regular wellbeing events
- Gym discount
- Share Incentive Plan (SIP)
- Death in Service cover
- Onsite subsidised coffee shop
- The Sandbox (our very own bar)
- Food and drink discounts across a number of venues in Manchester City Centre
- Regular social events
- Cycle to Work scheme

We're On the Beach! One of the UK's largest online package holiday specialists, with significant opportunities for growth.

title: Warehouse Operative (Monday to Friday)
description:

title: Customer Support Agent
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Lektronix is a Rockwell Automation Business, a complete solutions provider for industrial automation needs. Providing the very best in technical excellence and customer service from anywhere in the world. We invest and continuously develop within the market.

We are looking for for Customer Support Agent.

As Customer Support Agent you will focus on managing relationships with existing customers while it supports the external sales team in expanding the customer base. You will act as the main point of contact for customers. You will deliver excellent service through phone and email communication, handling enquiries, providing updates on ongoing orders and repairs. - Achieve sales targets and manage a geographical area to maximise its sales potential.
- Maintain customer relationships.
- Maintain relationships across Lektronix' key accounts.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- Experience providing detailed troubleshooting and resolutions to users
- Administrative skills.

We Offer

- Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm

- Employee Assistance Program
- Personalised wellbeing programmes through our OnTrack programme
- On-demand digital course library for professional development

- IT literate, with good Microsoft Office skills
- Experience in dealing with both internal and external stakeholders (preferred not essential)

Individual Competencies

- Demonstrable experience in an administrative or customer service position
- Fluent English Language skills, able to communicate with stakeholders on a day to day basis, via telephone, email and face to face in a clear, caring, courteous and professional manner

- Able to demonstrate prioritisation skills when multi-tasking

- A positive enthusiastic approach to solving problems
- Proven ability to make logical and solid decisions
- Flexible and adaptable to meet the needs of the business and our customers.

description:

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices.

Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.

Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant.
About The Business Unit
We help conceive, drive, and implement transport solutions for cities, regions, and asset owners/operators around the globe. From preparing the business case and advising on related issues - such as revenue, procurement, and environmental legislation - to delivering the completed infrastructure and helping maintain it. Our planning, engineering, environmental and management skills cover the whole project cycle. We play a major role in developing and delivering the Global Transport Sector Strategy.

Overview Of The Role
We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated individual to support the growth and development of our Tunnel Systems MEP team.

As Principal Mechanical Engineer (Public Health), you will oversee technical quality, ensure engineering outputs meet project requirements, and lead public health design across the full project lifecycle. This includes detailed calculations, equipment selection, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards. You will also lead the design of tunnel drainage, pumped drainage, fire mains, and fixed firefighting systems.

You will join an established team with a broad range of experience, from principal engineers to apprentices. Knowledge sharing and supporting junior colleagues are fundamental aspects of our team culture.

Key Responsibilities:

- Leading teams of engineers and technicians
- Managing and coordinating multi‑disciplinary project teams
- Producing reliable design solutions, reports, specifications, and drawings
- Presenting technical solutions to clients and external stakeholders
- Actively participating in design team meetings and ensuring adherence to agreed principles
- Coordinating with other engineering disciplines to integrate mechanical/public health systems within the overall design
- Contributing to bid management and business development activities
- Supporting the mentoring, management, and technical development of engineers

Qualifications:

- Degree‑qualified with membership of a relevant professional body (e.g., IMechE, CIBSE)
- Chartered Engineer (or equivalent relevant experience)

Essential:
You will have experience as a public health engineer in a similar engineering and construction environment, including major project delivery. You should be able to demonstrate capability in the design and specification of:

- Foul water ejector systems
- Surface water pumped systems
- Above‑ground soil and waste systems
- Hot and cold‑water systems
- Gas detection systems
- Compressed air systems
- Fire main/hydrant systems
- Sprinkler/hose reel systems
- Hydraulic calculations and system sizing

Desirable:

- Experience delivering large engineering and construction projects, including transport infrastructure
- Experienced in the design of road and rail tunnel projects
- Understanding of multidisciplinary design and build processes
- Knowledge of CDM Regulations 2015.
- Strong verbal, written, analytical, and organisational skills
- Ability to work to tight deadlines and use initiative
- Proactive, adaptable, and able to apply skills to new challenges
- Ability to build strong relationships in a multi disciplinary environment
- Familiarity with common data environments
- Experience using Bluebeam, Hevacomp, MicroDrainage, Revit, ProjectWise, and MS Office
- Experience developing engineering designs within a BIM environment

The role will be based out of one of our Rail offices, with occasional travel within the UK or overseas depending on project requirements.

UK Immigration
Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

Agile working
At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion

We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute.

Financial wellbeing

- Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
- Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury.
- Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.

Employee Ownership

- As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution.
- Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.

Health and wellbeing

- A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
- Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.

Lifestyle

- Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
- Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high-street retailers.

Enhanced family and carers leave

Learning and development

Networks, communities, and social outcomes

title: Graduate / Chartered Accountant or Chartered Tax Adviser
description:
Department: Audit

Location: Leeds

Description

About Us

Build something exceptional, with us...

Our ambition is clear and openly bold.

Armstrong Watson is on a journey to more than double our turnover by 2030, through disciplined organic growth, the attraction of outstanding talent, and the selective acquisition of like‑minded firms.

But growth alone is not the goal.

Reputation is.

And reputation is earned, not inherited.

Our strategic intent is simple to say and hard to deliver.

To become the most respected adviser to privately owned businesses in the North and the UK.

The firm business owners talk about.

The firm lawyers and bankers recommend without hesitation.

To achieve this, we are building the best Accounting and Financial Advisory firm to deal with, not just in the North, but across the UK. Exceptional service, deep expertise, trusted relationships, and absolute reliability define everything we do. These are not slogans; they are standards we hold ourselves to every day.

At our core, we exist for one reason, to help our clients achieve prosperity, a secure future, and peace of mind.

This strategy sets the direction.

Our people, our values‑led culture, and our standards will deliver it.

We are looking for people who want more than the next job. People who care deeply about:

- Standards and professionalism
- Doing work they are proud to put their name to
- Building long‑term client relationships
- Being part of a firm with real momentum and intent

If you want to grow with a business that is ambitious, values‑driven, and serious about excellence, Armstrong Watson offers opportunity and expectation in equal measure.

What You Will Find Here

- A firm with clear direction and momentum
- Clients who value advice and relationships
- Colleagues who care about doing things properly
- A culture built on Passion, Trust, Humanity and Honesty
- Genuine opportunity to shape your career as the firm grows

This is our moment, and our vision is clear, to build something genuinely remarkable.

The Role

Start your professional services career with one of the UK's leading independent accountancy firms. From day one, you'll work with real clients, gain professional qualifications and receive the support needed to become a professional business adviser.

We are currently looking for our next promising cohort of Chartered Accountants and Chartered Tax Advisers to start with us in September 2027. We have positions available across our Carlisle, Glasgow, Newcastle, Leeds, Skipton & Manchester offices.

Throughout our three-year programme, you'll gain hands-on experience working with a diverse range of clients while developing the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to become a trusted business adviser. It's a challenging and rewarding journey that combines practical experience, professional qualifications and structured development to build a strong foundation for your future career.

With full study support for the ACA or ATT/CTA qualification, you'll balance professional studies with real client work, applying your learning in practice from day one.

You'll join either our Audit and Assurance (ACA) or Tax (ATT/CTA) team, working alongside experienced colleagues and supporting clients across a variety of sectors. As your confidence and expertise grow, you'll build strong professional relationships and take on increasing levels of responsibility.

Successfully completing our training programme can open the door to a wide range of career opportunities across the firm. Whether your interests lie in Restructuring & Insolvency, Corporate Finance, Business Services or another specialist area, you'll have the opportunity to explore different career paths and continue developing your expertise as your career progresses.

The Candidate

We're looking for motivated individuals who enjoy working collaboratively, are eager to learn and are ready to take on new challenges. In return, you'll gain valuable experience, professional qualifications and access to rewarding opportunities that will help you build a successful long-term career.

- Candidates must possess either a 2:1 degree or above (achieved or predicted) in any discipline or the full AAT Level 4 qualification. A 2:2 degree may be considered depending on degree subject.
- Candidates must also hold at least 7 GCSEs at Grade 5 (C) or above (including Maths, English, and at least one Science) or a minimum of 6 National Fives (including Maths, English, and at least one Science) at Grade C or above.
- A minimum of 96 UCAS points obtained from A Levels or equivalent Level 3 qualifications across a maximum of three subjects, or from Scottish Highers / Advanced Highers across a maximum of five subjects
- You must also possess a full and valid UK Drivers Licence by September 2027 and own a vehicle which can be used for business travel to client sites that are not always accessible via public transport. There will be a short grace period permitted for acquiring a vehicle, if required.

Successful candidates must meet the eligibility criteria for levy funding.

How To Apply

If you think this is the right opportunity for you and your career, apply online with our simple application form, where you will also be asked to upload a copy of your current CV.

Please ensure that you clearly list subjects studied and grades achieved for all GCSEs and A Levels on your CV, as well as ensuring that you provide confirmation of your achieved or predicted degree result. All questions on our application form must be answered fully or this could affect your application being progressed.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Stora

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.

We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.

Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.

The Role

This is a genuine people leadership role.

You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.

Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves.

This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

What Else You’ll Own

Engineering Management

- Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.
- Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.
- Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.
- Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.
- Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.

Performance & Progression

- Own the engineering performance and progression approach.
- Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.
- Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.
- Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.

Hiring & Team Development

- Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.
- Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.
- Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.
- Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.

Team Health

- Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.
- Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.
- Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.

Technical Context

- Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.
- Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.
- Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.

What Success Looks Like

After your first year, we’d expect:

- Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.
- Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.
- Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.
- A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.
- Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.
- The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.

You’ll ideally have:

- Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.
- A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.
- Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.
- Experience making promotion and progression decisions.
- Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.
- Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.
- An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.
- The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.
- A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.

Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

We’re much more interested in whether you can lead engineers well.

What This Role Isn’t

It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:

- a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;
- a delivery or project management position;
- a Product Manager role;
- a hands-on engineering role where you’ll spend most of your week writing production code;
- a first Engineering Manager opportunity.

Technical leadership already exists within the product teams.

We’re hiring you because engineering management itself deserves dedicated ownership.

Our Technology

You won’t be expected to spend most of your time writing production code, but you should be comfortable working around our stack.

Backend: Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB

Frontend: Turbo, React, ViewComponents, Sass

Testing: Minitest, Playwright

Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

Salary & Benefits

- Salary: Highly competitive and depending on experience
- Location: Fully remote within the UK or Ireland
- Belfast office: Available for anyone who wants to use it
- Private health insurance for you and your family
- Company pension
- 35 days’ annual leave inclusive of applicable public/statutory holidays, depending on location
- Learning and development support
- Share options
- Work-from-home budget

Our Hiring Process

We’re reviewing applications as they arrive rather than waiting for a closing date.

If your experience looks like a strong match, we’ll explain the process clearly from the outset and move quickly.

Equal Opportunities at Stora

Stora is an equal opportunities employer.c

We want to build a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect, and where different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are valued.

We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment and employment decisions are based on merit, competence and business need, and we promote equality of opportunity and fair participation in line with our responsibilities under Northern Ireland equality legislation.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Senior FPGA Engineer
description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Senior FPGA Engineer with experience in VHDL (or Verilog) to join our growing team at our Gloucester site. This exciting opportunity allows you to work on a variety of Defence, Cyber, and Intelligence programmes, contributing to the design, development, and deployment of cutting-edge RF systems. If you have hands-on experience with HDL development – especially in the context of software defined radio applications – and are eager to advance your career in a high-impact, innovative environment, we want to hear from you!

At Lockheed Martin, we value work-life balance, providing flexible work schedules and hybrid work options where possible. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package to help you lead a fulfilling and healthy life inside and outside of work. This role offers opportunities for continuous professional development, allowing you to grow your skills while contributing to mission-critical projects.

As an FPGA Engineer you will work within a multi-skilled team, using the OpenCPI framework to build, test, and optimize software-defined radio systems and RF applications. You’ll work closely with peers, Delivery Managers and Technical Leads to ensure that the customer mission requirements are achieved in efficient and innovative ways.

Key Responsibilities

- Component and Worker Development – Undertake the development and integration of DSP and SDR functions in VHDL which will be incorporated into a wider OpenCPI application.
- System Design & Integration – Operate within a cross-functional team designing and integrating RF communication systems, ensuring seamless operation within complex mission environments.
- Test & Measurement – Engage in test driven development strategies and consider testing throughout the development lifecycle of an application, implementing test harnesses and simulations for effective system verification and validation.
- Software Optimization – Optimize the performance of OpenCPI-based systems, ensuring maximum efficiency and reliability on an exciting variety of hardware platforms.
- Innovation – Embrace the use of the latest AI/ML tooling and hybrid cloud compute environments to deliver results that continually outpace and challenge the status quo.
- Collaboration & Reporting – Use Agile principles and strong communication to work with peers and leaders to ensure that our delivery is providing the right solution on time.

This position offers a unique opportunity to work on innovative solutions for both Lockheed Martin and our customers, delivering cutting-edge technology in the realm of RF communications and SDR systems.

If you are passionate about FPGA development and want to leverage your expertise to contribute to innovative defence and cyber projects, we encourage you to apply. Join Lockheed Martin and help us shape the future of software-defined communication systems.

Security clearance

This role requires you to be able to obtain and maintain eDV security clearance.

You don’t need to hold eDV clearance when you apply. If you don’t currently have it, we’ll support you through the application process.

Apply now and become a developer within our team to deliver impactful, innovative solutions that will shape the future of RF Cyber.

Required Skills, Qualifications, And Experience

It is expected that you can evidence prior experience and an ability to continue to grow in one of the following:

- Using VHDL to implement efficient solutions on resource constrained embedded devices
- Working with RF communications and software-defined radio technologies & architectures
- Working knowledge of digital signal processing, algorithm or payload development, and embedded system design
- Competent in VHDL (or Verilog) for embedded applications

Desired Skills

- EW or SIGINT capability development (including RF waveform and protocol vulnerability analysis)
- Familiarity with GnuRadio, MatLab, AMD EDF or other SDR development tools
- Commercial and Military communications stacks and modem development (e.g IEEE 802.x, COFDM, Satcoms, or Link 16)
- Working in AWS and CICD pipelined environments, especially with GitLab and Linux
- Real-time test and measurement, using tools such as vector signal analyzers

- Continuously develop your sales, negotiation, and commercial skills
- Work towards clear individual targets and KPIs

Who We’re Looking For

We’re more interested in your attitude, ambition, and potential than your previous job title.

You might already have experience in sales, recruitment, customer service, business development, hospitality, retail, or another target-driven environment, or you might be looking to break into sales for the first time.

We’re looking for people who are:

- Ambitious and motivated to build a long-term career
- Confident communicators who enjoy speaking to people
- Competitive and target-driven
- Motivated by uncapped earning potential
- Proactive and comfortable taking initiative
- Organised, resilient, and able to manage a busy pipeline
- Comfortable communicating through phone, email, and LinkedIn
- Commercially curious and eager to learn
- Interested in business, entrepreneurship, and live events
- Excited by progression and personal development

Previous sales experience is beneficial, but absolutely not essential.

We’ll provide the training, coaching, and support. What we need from you is the drive to succeed.

UK & Netherlands Market Teams

We’re currently hiring Business Development Executives across two key market teams:

UK Market Team

Working with businesses across the UK to identify potential exhibitors, sponsors, and commercial partners for our events.

Netherlands Market Team

Working with businesses across the Netherlands and developing relationships with internationally focused companies.

You’ll become an expert in your market, understand your target audience, and develop the commercial skills needed to build a high-performing sales career.

What We Offer

- £26,000 – £30,000 base salary, depending on experience
- Uncapped commission
- Year 1 OTE: £50,000 – £60,000
- Year 2 OTE: £75,000 – £100,000+
- Full, structured sales training
- Ongoing coaching and professional development
- Clear and achievable progression opportunities
- The opportunity to move into closing and senior sales positions
- Long-term pathway into sales management and leadership
- Opportunities to attend major UK and international business events
- Regular incentives, competitions, rewards, and team socials
- A high-energy, ambitious office environment
- The opportunity to work alongside experienced sales professionals and learn from the best

Where Can This Role Take You?

We’re building careers, not just filling vacancies.

A typical progression pathway could look like:

Business Development Executive → Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Sales Director

For high performers, there is the opportunity to progress into senior commercial roles, including Event Sales Director.

As your responsibility grows, so does your earning potential — with our Year 2 OTE reaching £75,000 – £100,000+ for successful performers.

Ready to Build Your Career?

If you’re ambitious, competitive, commercially minded, and want a role where your effort, development, and results are rewarded, we want to hear from you.

Whether you’re an experienced salesperson or looking to start your career in business development, we’ll give you the training and platform to succeed.

Join Business Show Media. Build your sales career. Grow with us.

AECOM is looking for a talented and motivated graduate to join our Road Drainage team. You’ll work on a diverse range of projects, supporting the development of safe, resilient and sustainable solutions for managing surface water and drainage. title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Purpose of Job

Maintain electrical equipment, machinery and services, auxiliary instruments/gauges, improve reliability and comply with safety requirements across the Plant. Develop plans for replacing or updating old and obsolete equipment, the attitude to fix faults and offer continuous improvement across all areas.

Principal Accountabilities

- Complete and record all electrical installation and modification work on machines and equipment to ensure compliance with Health and Safety legislation.
- Conduct risk assessment and write Safe System of Work for various tasks and equipment, and assist in PUWER assessment of plant and equipment.
- To plan and implement updates and replacement of obsolete equipment.
- To support the maintenance strategy for old and new equipment, develop schedules on the computerised maintenance management system to improve reliability, including power plant, PLC and control systems, plant instrumentation and any servicing or calibration.
- Monitor faults or breakdowns logged and associated losses and implement reliability improvements.
- Mentor site electrical resource and support with logical fault-finding techniques to resolve issues, and to follow up with corrective actions, write up ‘one-point lessons’ and appropriate roll out to other plant and equipment.
- Design and draw up circuit diagrams using a CAD system; write up relevant PLC programmes with an updated Control Synopsis.
- Install hardware for improvements to the line, which can include conduit, sensors, relays, range of PLCs, logic systems, level equipment, instrumentation, motors, control equipment etc.
- Complete and record maintenance checks and repairs on machines and equipment in line with maintenance schedules. Monitor and report on completion. Develop schedules on the computerised maintenance management system to improve reliability.
- Utilise logical fault-finding techniques to resolve issues, consulting drawings, PLC programs and test equipment e.g. multimeter, oscilloscope, logic probe etc.
- Install or commission new equipment in conjunction with group personnel, external contractors and suppliers. Liaison with sub-contractors and service suppliers.
- Adhere to quality and food initiatives regarding Food Safety.

H&S & Environment

- Comply with Sonoco EHS policy and statutory requirements at all times.
- Lead by example on all matters of Health & Safety.
- Encouragement of others to engage in safety discussions and projects.
- Ensure that all activities are carried out in accordance with all applicable safety procedures.
- Completion of all mandatory Convergence training and refreshers as required in a timely manner.
- Practice safe working techniques in all that you do.
- Support the business with any safety related initiatives and programs.
- Development of safety-related skills, including attending any safety-related training as and when required.
- Support the business by carrying out safety observations and discussions with others, finding any fixes or improvements which can be proposed to the site.
- Effective waste management control within the relevant area of responsibility, to control, reduce and eliminate waste within anything that we do.
- Adhere to high levels of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) and ensure 5S is carried out at all times.
- Any additional role-specific H&S responsibilities.
- Any additional role-specific Environmental responsibilities.

Knowledge & Experience

Minimum Job Requirements

Preferably experience of Allen Bradley/Rockwell PLC in high-speed manufacturing, using computerised maintenance systems, and hands-on experience of electrical installation projects would be advantageous.

Time served Electrical Engineering Apprentice and have an awareness of 18th Edition as well as competency and experience in working to requirements set in BS7671, BS2391 and other legislation.

Have knowledge of Electricity at Work Regulations and of Safe Working Practices including Lock Off and Tag Out.

Personal Characteristics

- Strong Safety mindset.
- Organised, methodical approach to problems, able to achieve deadlines.
- Strong and effective communication skills to all levels within the business.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work on your own or within a team.
- Positive “hands on” attitude.
- Proactive Team player who is self-motivated to continuously improve and learn in the workplace.
- Open minded approach.
- Resilient, strong character who is willing to challenge in a positive professional manner.
- The ability to adapt to changes within the workplace.
- Methodical and logical approach to problem solving and with the ability to understand and find the root cause of problems.
- Able to work to deadlines and targets.
- The ability to lead by example.

We offer a competitive salary, shift premium, 9% Company Pension contribution, Cash Health Plan, 25 days of holiday plus Bank Holidays (for employees working shifts this is mainly contained in the shift pattern) as well as on site parking and subsidised restaurant.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any legally protected characteristic.
