title: Chef
description:
Impact Food Group (IFG) is one of England’s fastest-growing school food providers, serving around one million students every day across more than 1,500 schools. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality, nutritious meals that support student wellbeing and enjoyment.

Our brands include Innovate, Cucina, Chapter One (Independent Schools), Hutchison, and Dolce, reflecting our breadth of experience and reach across the school catering sector.

About The Role

Job Title: Chef

School Location: Lampton , Hounslow, Hounslow, TW3 4EP

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Shifts & Working hours: 6:30am-3:30pm (45 hours per week)

Working Weeks: 38 weeks per year (term time plus inset days)

Pay Details: £32,000 per annum

What will I be doing?

As a Chef, you’ll support the onsite Chef Manager in delivering high-quality, freshly prepared meals for students and staff.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Assisting with the preparation of main meals and snacks
- Cooking with fresh, seasonal ingredients for high-volume service (200+ covers)
- Supporting with occasional counter service and till work
- Maintaining a clean, safe, and organised kitchen and dining environment at all times

What are we looking for?

We’re not going to overload you with buzzwords - we’re simply looking for great chefs who care about food.

- Experience as a chef, ideally within a school or contract catering environment (but not essential)
- A passion for cooking with fresh ingredients and delivering quality food
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume kitchen
- Strong teamwork and communication skills
- A positive, can-do attitude and willingness to learn
- Good understanding of food hygiene and safety standards
- Reliability and pride in maintaining high standards

We welcome people from all backgrounds, and we’re proud to have chefs with restaurant-quality experience working in our schools. If you’re passionate about food and want to make a difference, we want to hear from you.

We’re not in the business of making school food, we’re here to make great food. That’s why our customers love us.

What’s in it for you?

This role offers a fantastic work-life balance:

- No evenings or weekends
- School holidays off
- No late nights or split shifts

Plus, you’ll benefit from:

- Free meals on shift
- Ongoing training, development, and career progression opportunities
- Access to free qualifications
- A staff discount scheme across 850+ retailers

You’ll also have the chance to build meaningful relationships with students, helping them explore new cuisines and develop a positive relationship with food that lasts a lifetime.

Interested?

If you think you’ve got what it takes, we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: A trade test will be required as part of the recruitment process.

IFG are committed to the safeguarding of children and our employees share this commitment. Successful candidates are required to undergo an enhanced DBS check, which IFG supply the cost for.

We are a committed equal opportunities employer - if you require any assistance for the interview process, please detail within your application. All information is kept confidential and in compliance with GDPR requirements.

Great pay + tronc

Let’s start with the good stuff. This is a big role in a fast-growing business — and we make sure you feel the benefit of that.

This is it. The big one. Your chance to step into a role with real impact in a business that’s growing faster than you might expect.

The role

As a Restaurant Manager, you’ll run your restaurant like you own it. You’ll lead from the front, build a high-performing team, and create a place where people love to work — and customers love to come back to.

You’ll

- Lead, coach and develop your management team and crew
- Own your P&L and drive sales and profitability
- Deliver brilliant standards, every shift, every day
- Control costs, hit targets and keep things moving fast
- Create an energetic, inclusive culture where people can be their best

Restaurant management isn’t easy — and you already know that. You’ve got experience running a busy operation, making smart commercial decisions, and stepping in when it really counts.

You’re confident, people-focused and not afraid to roll your sleeves up. You bring positivity, pace and a can-do attitude, and you genuinely enjoy helping others grow. If you know how to put the fun into functional, you’ll fit right in.

Ready to join us?

If you’re looking for a role with real responsibility, proper progression and rewards that actually mean something — it might be time to swap crews and join ours.

Have it your way. Apply now.

title: Fertility Nurse
description:
About Us

JD Healthcare Group is one of the UK's leading fertility and reproductive healthcare providers, operating brands including London Women's Clinic, London Egg Bank, London Sperm Bank, KindIVF, Surrey Park Women's Clinic and Elective Egg Freezing across the United Kingdom. Since 1985, we have been supporting individuals and families through some of the most significant journeys of their lives — combining world-class clinical expertise with genuine human care. Everything we do is driven by a shared purpose: helping people build the families they dream of.

About The Role

As a Fertility Nurse at JD Healthcare, you'll deliver compassionate, high-quality nursing care to patients at every stage of their fertility treatment journey. Working as part of a close-knit multidisciplinary team, you'll support patients through consultations, procedures and treatment cycles — always ensuring care is delivered safely, professionally and in line with the highest clinical and regulatory standards. This is a specialist nursing role with real breadth — from follicular tracking scans to post-sedation recovery — and one where your clinical skill and empathy will make a genuine difference. If you're a registered nurse or midwife with a passion for women's health and fertility, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do

- Deliver individualised, evidence-based nursing care across all stages of the fertility treatment pathway, maintaining accurate records on the clinic's fertility management system
- Assess, admit and safely discharge patients following sedation, and assist or scrub for egg collection procedures and post-procedure recovery
- Intrauterine insemination (IUI) and endometrial scratching following completion of in-house training
- Educate patients on treatment and medication schedules, demonstrating injectable medication techniques to support patient self-administration
- Perform phlebotomy (at satellite and selected clinics), and maintain and audit resuscitation equipment stocks
- Communicate with patients with clarity and compassion via telephone, email and video consultation throughout their treatment journey
- Participate in regular service audits, consent auditing and pre-treatment screening reviews, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement

What We Are Looking For

Essential

- Registered Nurse and/or Midwife with a current, valid NMC registration
- Degree-level qualification in nursing or a related field
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a patient-centred approach
- Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a varied caseload
- Commitment to evidence-based practice and accurate clinical record-keeping
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
- Solid IT proficiency and a current ILS certification (or willingness to train to this standard)

Desirable

- Previous experience in a fertility or women's healthcare setting
- Knowledge of audit processes and quality improvement
- Willingness to complete in-house and BFS training for IUI and scanning

What We Offer

- 32 days annual leave including bank holidays
- Life assurance
- Pension plan

title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer
description:
Join Our Team

PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027

Our Building Services teams at Cundall play a key role in making buildings more energy efficient, cost effective to run and, ultimately, more sustainable. To do this, we’re looking for graduates who have a desire and enthusiasm to make a difference: in our homes, offices, projects, industry and community.

Working across a variety of sectors, our building services engineers are a source of world leading expertise, producing innovative and award-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project.

With 29 locations globally, we offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, professional excellence and knowledge sharing.

Our Building Services teams have worked on a range of amazing projects, from data centres for large tech companies to headquarters of companies such as Deutsche Bank and Diageo. As a graduate in the team, you could play a key part in our next big project.

The Role You'll Play

As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, you’ll join a team who specialise in the design of some of the most exciting construction projects in the UK and worldwide.

Working closely with colleagues across our multi-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors including education, healthcare, workplace, retail and critical systems (data centres).

Under the guidance of our team of experienced engineers, we’ll equip you to undertake detailed mechanical building services engineering design and analysis, define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, facilities and services (ventilation, cooling and air conditioning, heating systems and more) - all with sustainability at the forefront of the design.

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop and with accredited professional development programmes from CIBSE and IMechE you’ll be fully supported towards achieving chartership.

The Skills You'll Bring

- On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
- Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Mechanical or Building Services Engineering.
- Have a passion about innovative and sustainable mechanical engineering for the built environment.
- Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C#, VB).
- You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
- Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can-do attitude.

What’s in it for you?

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

- A one-off joining bonus of £1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
- A £2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
- 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
- A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.

At Amegreen, you may work with a variety of Special Needs, ranging from, learning difficulties such as dyslexia, conditions such as autism, social, emotional and mental health needs, or have a combination of these difficulties.

You may also work with gifted and talented individuals who need to be challenged further than the standard curriculum allows.

A key aspect of working in this field is identifying individual needs and adapting to that particular student. Working towards Educational, Health Care Plans is key to progress.

As a secondary teacher within Amegreen Education you will have a responsibility for creating a safe, stimulating and supportive learning environment.

LINE MANAGEMENT DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

You will be part of the Amegreen Education team and be line managed through Senior Management and by the Director of Education.

Main Duties And Responsibilities

- Teach either individuals or small groups of pupils within, or outside, the class.
- Delivering creative and engaging lessons
- Adapting and differentiating the curriculum for individual needs
- To contribute to the delivery and development of the curriculum, having regard to the educational, physical and social needs of the students within a learning environment.
- To oversee provision maps, adding to use short-, medium- and long-term plans in delivering adaption and intervention in the school curriculum.
- To set, monitor and review personalised targets that will optimise learning for each individual.
- To organise the review of EHC plans, PEP and LAC reviews.
- Prepare and delegate intervention, lessons and resources to teachers and SENCO assistant.
- Mark and assess work.
- Develop and adapt conventional teaching methods to meet the individual needs of pupils.
- Use special equipment and facilities, such as audiovisual materials and computers to stimulate interest in learning and aid concentration and understanding.
- Use specialist skills, in interventions, monitoring and reviewing EHCPs.
- Formalise procedures towards pupils gaining accreditation or examination- access arrangements.
- Collaborate with the wider staff to define appropriate theme activities for the pupils in relation to the curriculum.
- Assess children who have long or short-term learning difficulties and work with colleagues to identify individual plans to address the need or gap.
- Work with the head teacher and governing body to ensure that the requirements of the Equality Act (2010) are met in terms of reasonable adjustments and access arrangements.
- Liaise with other professionals, such as social workers, speech and language therapists, physiotherapists and educational psychologists.
- Work closely with parents, carers and guardians.
- Organise learning outside the classroom in activities such as community visits, school outings or sporting events.
- Assist in pupils' personal and individual care/medical needs.
- Carry out administrative tasks, including updating and maintaining records of pupils' progress.
- Attend statutory annual reviews or other related meetings, such as Looked After Child (LAC) reviews, regarding students with an SEN, which may involve reviewing education, health and care (EHC) plans.
- Attend in-service training.
- Manage behaviour according to policy.

Qualifications

This role requires a teaching qualification - to qualify as a teacher in a maintained school in England and Wales, you must have a degree and achieve qualified teacher status (QTS) by completing a period of initial teaching training (ITT), (Initial teacher education (ITE) in Wales).

SENCO Qualification Is Essential.

Salary offered will be based on experience and hours of work.

In the Manufacturing team at JLR’s Electric Propulsion Manufacturing Centre (EPMC), you’ll help power iconic electric cars. You will be working alongside incredible technicians and leaders to drive our commitment to shape a future we truly believe in, together. Use your expertise, cutting-edge technology, and problem-solving skills to ensure efficient, sustainable and high-quality production. Fuel the exceptional.

Play a central role in shaping the future of electrified powertrain manufacturing. You’ll develop advanced welding processes that underpin quality, innovation, and performance across our next-generation products.

As a Welding Engineer, you’ll help bring cutting-edge battery and electric drive systems to life. Working at the forefront of innovation, you’ll refine processes, elevate manufacturing standards, and build expertise that will accelerate both your growth and our shared future.

What To Expect

You’ll join a collaborative engineering environment where curiosity is encouraged and new ideas are welcomed. With a strong focus on electrification and Modern Luxury, this role connects you with experienced teams across manufacturing, product development, and quality to deliver meaningful impact.

- Developing and optimising welding processes across battery, EDU and sub-assembly manufacturing to ensure quality and repeatability
- Leading root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions to resolve welding-related issues and drive continuous improvement
- Creating and maintaining welding standards, procedures and validation plans to support new product introduction and production
- Supporting weld inspection strategies, including destructive and non-destructive testing, ensuring compliance and product integrity
- Collaborating across engineering, operations and quality teams to deliver robust, high-performing manufacturing solutions

What You’ll Need

Along with your ambition to push boundaries and embrace change, there are several skills and experiences you’ll need to succeed here, including:

- Demonstrating strong expertise in welding processes such as MIG, TIG, resistance spot and laser welding within a manufacturing environment
- Applying knowledge of automated and robotic welding systems and understanding of welding metallurgy, defects and inspection methods
- Understanding quality tools and standards such as PFMEA, control plans and relevant ISO or industry compliance frameworks
- Interpreting engineering drawings, GD&T and CAD data to support process development and validation
- Holding a degree in Engineering, Materials Science or a relevant discipline, or equivalent experience, with professional welding qualifications advantageous

At JLR, you’ll find more than a role, you’ll discover a place to grow. A place where your curiosity is valued, your individuality is celebrated, and your ideas can shape the future of Modern Luxury. With tailored benefits, a culture of creativity, and opportunities to learn from the brightest minds, you’ll have everything you need to maximise your potential and make a meaningful difference.

- Discounted car purchase (open to family members, too)
- A 52 week maternity leave policy and a 4 week paternity leave policy. Other parental leave policies are available

title: LV Cable Jointer
description:
Bauer Media Outdoor is one of the world's leading Out of Home media owners with more than 40,000 sites nationwide. A few years ago, we brought the construction of our advertising sutes in house. - Installation of electrical feeder pillars and cutouts

- SHEA Power qualification
- First Aid at work and Power Add on
- Working knowledge of HSG 47
- Working Knowledge of COSHH
- EUSR’s LV 1&2 is preferred but training will be given

What's In It For You

💰 Up to £60,000 + 8% bonus
🚐 Company van for business use, saving on commuting costs
🏖️ 25 paid holidays including bank holidays
🏠 Company Pension Scheme paid up to 8%
🩺 Healthcare Cash Plan
🛡️ Life Insurance and group income protection scheme
🚲 Cycle to work scheme
🤱🏻 Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Cover
⚽ Season ticket loans and exclusive discounts with hundreds of retailers

title: Maintenance Electrician
description:
Heidelberg Materials UK (formerly Hanson UK) is one of the UK’s largest suppliers of construction materials, employing over 4,000 people and operating around 300 manufacturing sites in the UK.

We are committed to building a more sustainable future and recognise that a diverse workforce is vital to our growth and advancement. We aim to promote a culture that values openness, transparency and individual achievement.

At the centre of our actions lies the responsibility for the environment. As the front runner on the path to carbon neutrality and circular economy in the building materials industry, we are working on sustainable building materials and solutions for the future. We enable new opportunities for our customers through digitalisation.

Maintenance Electrician

Location: Whatley

Hours: Full Time | Permanent

Salary: £55,000pa plus paid Over time

Powering Performance. Keeping Operations Running.

Are you an experienced Electrical Maintenance Engineer or Electrician looking for a challenging role within a busy industrial environment?

At Heidelberg Materials, we're looking for a skilled Maintenance Electrician to help maximise the reliability, availability, and performance of our plant and equipment. Working as part of an experienced maintenance team, you'll play a key role in ensuring our operations run safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive individual who enjoys fault finding, problem-solving, and working with a wide range of electrical systems and technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Maintenance Electrician, you will be responsible for carrying out planned and reactive maintenance activities across site, helping to minimise downtime and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:

- Diagnosing faults and carrying out electrical repairs on plant and equipment.
- Performing preventative and corrective maintenance to maximise operational reliability.
- Supporting plant inspections, maintenance shutdowns, and improvement projects.
- Assisting with the implementation and commissioning of capital projects.
- Maintaining compliance with Health & Safety, IMS, and site procedures.
- Liaising with supervisors and operational teams on technical and safety matters.
- Supporting the development and management of critical spare parts strategies.
- Recording maintenance activities using SAP PM systems.
- Participating in occasional weekend and night working during planned and emergency maintenance activities.

Technical Expertise Required

Electrical Installation & Power Distribution

- Working knowledge of LV and HV electrical systems.
- Experience inspecting, testing, and maintaining switchgear, transformers, and cable systems.
- Understanding of electrical protection systems, fault-level analysis, and earth fault protection.
- Experience working to current electrical regulations and industry standards.

Motors, Drives & Controls

- Installation, maintenance, and fault-finding on AC/DC motors.
- Experience with soft starters, slip-ring motors, squirrel cage motors, and liquid starters.
- Knowledge of variable speed drives (VSDs) and motor control systems.
- Understanding of motor vibration analysis and bearing systems.

Instrumentation & Automation

- Experience with process instrumentation and calibration activities.
- Knowledge of weigh systems, load cells, level control devices, gas analysers, and PID controllers.
- Fault finding on PLC-controlled systems and associated SCADA platforms.
- Experience with Allen Bradley, Siemens, Modicon, or similar control systems would be advantageous.

Safety & Compliance

- Experience working with safety-critical systems and interlocks.
- Understanding of PUWER and electrical safety regulations.
- Commitment to maintaining the highest safety standards in an industrial environment.

What We're Looking For

You will be a practical, self-motivated individual with strong troubleshooting skills and a commitment to safe working practices.

Essential Requirements

- Recognised electrical qualification.
- Strong fault-finding and diagnostic experience gained within an industrial, manufacturing, quarrying, or heavy engineering environment.
- Computer literacy and experience using maintenance management systems.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
- Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions.
- Flexible approach to working hours when operational requirements demand.

Desirable

- SAP PM experience.
- EPIC certification for mobile plant operation.
- NVQ Level 2 in Mobile Plant Operations.
- Knowledge of industrial gases.
- Practical welding and burning experience.
- Experience within the aggregates, cement, quarrying, recycling, or heavy industrial sectors.

Why Join Heidelberg Materials?

At Heidelberg Materials, we are committed to investing in our people, maintaining world-class operations, and building a sustainable future.

In return, we offer:

- Competitive salary
- Pension scheme
- Generous holiday entitlement
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- Employee benefits platform
- Career progression opportunities
- A supportive and safety-focused working environment

Apply Today

If you're an experienced electrician who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to work in a dynamic industrial environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help keep our operations running at their best

Details on changes to the machinery of government

title: Forklift / Warehouse Operator PM
description:
Warehouse / Forklift Operator – PM Shift (Bothwell Site)

Join the Team at Bullet Express – We’re Hiring!

PM Shift: 13:00 – 22:00

Are you a hardworking team player who thrives in a fast-paced warehouse environment? Do you have a strong eye for detail and take pride in working safely, accurately and efficiently?

Bullet Express is looking for an experienced Warehouse / Forklift Operator to join our busy PM team at our Bothwell site.

This is a key role within our operation. The PM shift is responsible for processing, sorting and preparing freight for onward movement, and we are looking for someone who understands that Health & Safety, attention to detail and teamwork are essential in keeping the operation running smoothly.

Why Join Bullet Express?

At Bullet Express, you’re more than just part of the workforce — you’re an important part of the team.

You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues and managers, playing a vital role in ensuring freight is handled safely, accurately and efficiently while helping us keep freight moving across the UK and Europe.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your responsibilities will include:

- Loading and unloading lorries safely and efficiently.
- Moving and stacking pallets and freight using a forklift and other warehouse equipment.
- Sorting and allocating freight to the correct routes, trunks and vehicles.
- Checking freight carefully to ensure it is in the correct location before loading.
- Carrying out accurate scanning and data capture.
- Checking labels, pallet quantities and freight information to ensure accuracy.
- Identifying and reporting damaged, incorrectly labelled or misallocated freight.
- Preparing and organising freight for onward trunk movements.
- Ensuring vehicles are loaded correctly and ready to depart on schedule.
- Maintaining high standards of warehouse and yard cleanliness.
- Carrying out equipment checks and reporting faults or defects promptly.
- Following all site Health & Safety procedures at all times.
- Working closely with colleagues to ensure the PM operation runs safely and efficiently.

Health & Safety

Health & Safety is a major focus of this role.

Working safely is not optional. You will be expected to follow all site procedures, operate forklifts and warehouse equipment responsibly and remain aware of colleagues, vehicles and other activity around you at all times.

You must be confident reporting hazards, damaged equipment, unsafe practices or anything else that could compromise the safety of yourself or others.

Attention to Detail

Accuracy is extremely important within our PM warehouse operation.

Freight must be scanned, checked, sorted and loaded correctly. Small mistakes can result in freight being misrouted, delayed or loaded onto the wrong trunk or vehicle.

We are therefore looking for someone who takes pride in getting things right first time and understands the importance of carrying out checks thoroughly, even when working under pressure.

Who You’ll Work With

You will work closely with:

- Drivers
- Shift Supervisors and Managers
- Office Support Teams
- Warehouse Colleagues
- Customers, suppliers and subcontractors when required

What You’ll Bring

A Valid Forklift Licence Is Essential For This Position.

You should also have:

- Previous hands-on forklift experience.
- Experience working within a busy warehouse environment.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- A strong understanding of Health & Safety.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- A reliable, hardworking and positive attitude.
- Good communication and time-management skills.
- The ability to work under pressure without compromising safety or accuracy.
- A willingness to support colleagues and the wider operation when required.
- A responsible approach to equipment and freight handling.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

- Freight is handled, sorted and loaded safely and correctly.
- Scanning and freight information is accurate.
- Freight is allocated to the correct routes, trunks and vehicles.
- Vehicles are loaded correctly and ready to depart on time.
- Health & Safety procedures are followed consistently.
- The warehouse and yard remain clean, safe and organised.
- Equipment is used responsibly and defects are reported promptly.
- You work as part of the team to keep the PM operation running smoothly and efficiently.

Ready to Join Us?

If you have a valid Forklift Licence, enjoy working as part of a busy team and take pride in working safely, accurately and efficiently, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the Bullet Express team at Bothwell.

This is a key role within our operation, and we are looking for someone who understands that Health & Safety, attention to detail and teamwork are essential when working in a busy warehouse environment.

Why Join Bullet Express?

At Bullet Express, you’re more than just part of the workforce — you’re an important part of the team.

You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues and managers, playing a vital role in ensuring freight is handled safely, accurately and efficiently while helping us keep our operation moving across the UK and Europe.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your responsibilities will include:

- Loading and unloading lorries safely and efficiently.
- Moving and stacking pallets and freight using a forklift and other warehouse equipment.
- Checking freight carefully and allocating it to the correct routes and vehicles.
- Carrying out accurate scanning and data capture.
- Checking labels, pallet quantities and freight information to ensure accuracy.
- Identifying and reporting damaged, incorrectly labelled or misallocated freight.
- Receiving and processing shipments accurately.
- Maintaining high standards of warehouse and yard cleanliness.
- Carrying out equipment checks and reporting faults or defects promptly.
- Following all site Health & Safety procedures at all times.
- Working closely with colleagues to ensure the AM operation runs safely and efficiently.

Health & Safety

Health & Safety is a major focus of this role.

Working safely is not optional. You will be expected to follow all site procedures, operate forklifts and warehouse equipment responsibly and remain aware of colleagues, vehicles and other activity around you at all times.

You must be confident reporting hazards, damaged equipment, unsafe practices or anything else that could compromise the safety of yourself or others.

Attention to Detail

Accuracy is extremely important within our warehouse operation.

Freight must be scanned, checked, handled and allocated correctly. Small mistakes can result in freight being delayed, misrouted or loaded onto the wrong vehicle.

We are therefore looking for someone who takes pride in getting things right first time and who will carry out checks thoroughly rather than simply rushing to complete a task.

Who You’ll Work With

You will work closely with:

- Drivers
- Shift Supervisors and Managers
- Office Support Teams
- Warehouse Colleagues
- Customers, suppliers and subcontractors when required

What You’ll Bring

A Valid Forklift Licence Is Essential For This Position.

You should also have:

- Previous hands-on forklift experience.
- Experience working within a busy warehouse environment.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- A strong understanding of Health & Safety.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- A reliable, hardworking and positive attitude.
- Good communication and time-management skills.
- The ability to work under pressure without compromising safety or accuracy.
- A willingness to support colleagues and the wider operation when required.
- A responsible approach to equipment and freight handling.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

- Freight is handled and loaded safely and correctly.
- Scanning and freight information is accurate.
- Health & Safety procedures are followed consistently.
- Freight is allocated to the correct routes and vehicles.
- The warehouse and yard remain clean, safe and organised.
- Equipment is used responsibly and defects are reported.
- You work as part of the team to keep the operation running smoothly and efficiently.

Ready to Join Us?

If you have a valid Forklift Licence, enjoy working as part of a team and take pride in working safely, accurately and efficiently, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the Bullet Express team at Bothwell.

title: 7.5 Tonne Collection and Delivery Driver
description:

Ready to join the company that aims to be the UK’s most sustainable delivery team? At DPD, we aren’t just moving parcels; we’re leading the charge in green logistics and tech-driven delivery. We’re looking for a reliable, tech-savvy 7.5 Tonne Driver to join our team. If you want a role with a clear routine, and a company that actually invests in your future, let’s talk.

DPD UK is a member of Geopost who are a market leader in parcel delivery and e-commerce solutions, providing a broad range of delivery and innovative services for customers worldwide.

The Perks

- Pay: £17.61 per hour + enhanced overtime rates.
- Contract Type: Permanent / 40 Hours per week
- Days of Work: Monday to Friday
- Shift Pattern: Start window 07.00 - 8.30am
- Stability & Growth: We promote from within. This isn’t just a job; it’s a career path.

Job Description

The Role

We’re looking for someone to take the wheel and own a designated local route. You aren’t just moving boxes; you’re the final boss of the delivery game, ensuring every parcel hits its destination with 10/10 service. With around 40 - 50 stops a day, you’ll be the ultimate problem-solver, navigating your community and making life easier for our customers. Your role is vital in providing a service that genuinely makes a difference to our customers.

The Role Breakdown

- Drive the Vibe: Get behind the wheel of a 7.5 Tonne vehicle. You’ll be cruising local routes, keeping it safe, professional, and efficient.
- Master the Tech: No paper maps here. You’ll use our industry-leading Saturn handheld devices. It’s basically your mission control for tracking progress, managing deliveries, and staying ahead of the game.
- The Main Character Energy: You’re the friendly face our customers see every day. Whether it’s a quick "hello" or a helpful drop-off, your energy defines the DPD experience.
- The Hustle: You’ll be loading and unloading parcels, using high-end gear like sack barrows and hand trucks to handle the heavy lifting safely. Think of it as a paid workout while you're on the move.
If you’re someone who loves autonomy, stays tech-savvy, and enjoys being out in the real world rather than stuck behind a screen, this is your lane.

Qualifications

What You Bring

- The Essentials: A valid 7.5 Tonne (C1) licence and DQC/CPC accreditation.
- Experience: Ideally 6 months recent driving experience handling 7.5 Tonne vehicles.
- Vibe: You’re professional, approachable, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- Fitness: You’re physically active and comfortable with the lifting involved in the job.
- Values: You care about doing a good job and treat customers and colleagues with respect.

description:
We’re one of the world’s leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 10,000 people and serve over 120 million customers in 26 languages.

We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of growth opportunities, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our global worldwide.

Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, featuring more than 1.38 million In-Play sporting events a year. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe (750,000), we handle over 6 million HTTP requests daily and process more than 1.5 million bets per hour at peak.

Job Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will enhance system reliability, observability and performance through a strong engineering approach and assist with incident resolution and best practices.

You will have strong software engineering skills, approaching system reliability and observability as a software problem — protecting, providing for, and progressing the performance and availability of our critical systems.

Using your engineering expertise, you will implement solutions that enhance reliability, including service instrumentation with OpenTelemetry and improved logging practices.

You will leverage AI tools and LLM platforms in your daily work to reduce toil, drive autonomous operations, and optimise system health, while engineering automation and tooling for effective service management.

Collaboration is key, working across multiple functions to embed reliability and observability best practices throughout the software development life cycle. Your contributions will ensure our systems meet user demands and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

This role is eligible for inclusion in the Company's hybrid working from home policy.

Qualifications

- Excellent knowledge of programming languages including Python, Golang and JavaScript.
- Knowledge and experience of modern software development techniques and lifecycles.
- Excellent knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including the creation and management of effective Service Level Indicators (SLI's) and Service Level Objectives (SLO's) for reliability and customer satisfaction.
- Knowledge of contemporary observability tools, techniques and best practice including Splunk, New Relic, Grafana and PagerDuty.
- Proficiency in shell scripting for automation and system management tasks.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation and orchestration tools such as Ansible and Terraform.
- Prior experience working in a large scale, 24/7 enterprise where system uptime and stability is of paramount importance to the business.
- An AI-native engineering approach, with hands-on experience using LLM platforms and coding assistants to improve productivity and quality, and the ability to integrate AI-driven telemetry for advanced observability, predictive insights and root-cause analysis.

Additional Information

- Developing and maintaining tools that facilitate effective management of our systems, ensuring they are operationally efficient and resilient.
- Working with automation and orchestration platforms to automate manual activity and reduce toil.
- Writing and contributing to code that enhances the reliability and observability of services, including telemetry, operational APIs and tooling.
- Building sophisticated dashboards using a range of telemetry data and dash boarding technologies like Grafana, Splunk and New Relic.
- Actively participating in live incident resolution and post-mortem analysis, providing effective remediation strategies to improve overall system health and prevent future issues.
- Driving initiatives to enhance system reliability and observability, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.
- Maintaining and administering existing monitoring and analytic toolsets.
- Mentoring colleagues in use of new technologies or practices.
- Working with IT Operations to provide and support the use of critical tooling that will enable increasing levels of value to the Business.

Apply today to join us and build what’s next!

You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. title: Lead Infrastructure & Systems Engineer
description:
Lead Infrastructure & Systems Engineer

Location: Edgbaston, Hybrid (Office and Remote Working)
Hours: Full-Time, 37.5 Hours per week, 08:00 - 16:00
Salary: Competitive

About Medinet & Healthharmonie

Medinet and its subsidiary Healthharmonie deliver a range of community healthcare services across multiple sites. Our IT team supports both organisations across all technology functions, bringing together infrastructure, systems, and end-user support under a single unified function. As the team grows and our service footprint matures, we are creating a new senior technical role to sit at the heart of the infrastructure function: a Lead Infrastructure & Systems Engineer who acts as the primary point of technical escalation for the team and leads on the ongoing development of our systems and platforms.

Role Purpose

To serve as the principal technical escalation point for the IT infrastructure team, handling the most complex incidents and requests before they reach the IT Infrastructure Manager. Alongside reactive support, this role leads the ongoing development of our Freshservice ITSM instance, drives minor infrastructure improvements, and takes on delegated technical work from the IT Infrastructure Manager — with the explicit goal of freeing senior management capacity for strategy, team development, and organisational planning. This is not a people management role, but someone with a natural inclination to share knowledge and bring others along will thrive here.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Escalation & Team Support

- Act as the primary technical escalation point for the infrastructure team — the definitive next step before issues reach the IT Infrastructure Manager
- Take ownership of the most complex, ambiguous, or high-impact incidents across the estate, driving them through to resolution
- Carry out detailed root-cause analysis on recurring or systemic issues and implement lasting fixes across the environment
- Provide authoritative technical guidance to the infrastructure team, helping colleagues develop their skills through hands-on collaboration rather than formal instruction

Platform Development & Delegated Work

- Lead the ongoing development and continuous improvement of the Freshservice ITSM platform — building workflows, automations, forms, SLA rules, and reporting to support the team's operational needs
- Deliver minor infrastructure updates and improvements as delegated by the IT Infrastructure Manager, including configuration changes, service upgrades, and platform enhancements
- Own technical documentation for the infrastructure estate — ensuring network diagrams, runbooks, configuration records, and architecture notes are accurate and maintained
- Contribute to infrastructure projects alongside the team, particularly where senior technical input is needed to de-risk delivery

Infrastructure, Cloud & Security

- Administer and develop the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 estate — Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Azure Virtual Desktop
- Manage and optimise network infrastructure across sites — switches, firewalls, VPN, Wi-Fi, and internet connectivity — with a strong focus on resilience and proactive monitoring
- Lead on security posture improvements including patch management, vulnerability remediation, identity governance, and security alerting

Process & Collaboration

- Participate in the onboarding of new 1st line engineers where technical depth is needed, and be a reliable reference point for the 1st line team on complex escalations
- Work closely with the IT Infrastructure Manager to identify areas for automation, efficiency improvement, and platform development across the team's toolset
- Ensure all work is delivered in line with change management processes, data protection requirements, and IT security policy

Essential Requirements

- Demonstrable experience at 3rd line infrastructure level, with a strong track record of resolving complex, multi-system incidents
- Deep working knowledge of Microsoft Azure — including Entra ID, Intune, Azure AD, Conditional Access, and Azure Virtual Desktop
- Strong Microsoft 365 administration skills — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and licensing
- Solid, hands-on networking experience — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewall rule management, and VPN
- Experience developing or administering an ITSM platform — building workflows, automations, forms, and reporting (Freshservice, ServiceNow, or similar)
- Comfortable working autonomously on technical problems with minimal direction, and equally comfortable documenting and communicating findings clearly
- Strong diagnostic skills and a methodical, structured approach to problem-solving
- Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to colleagues at varying levels of experience

Desirable / Advantageous

- Microsoft AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) or AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert)
- Microsoft AZ-800 (Administering Windows Server Hybrid Core Infrastructure)
- Experience with Freshservice specifically — including workflow automations, API integrations, and custom reporting
- PowerShell or other scripting experience for automation of routine infrastructure tasks
- Experience with Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN or similar enterprise firewall platforms
- Exposure to healthcare or NHS IT environments
- Familiarity with endpoint management at scale using Intune or similar MDM platforms
- Experience of mentoring or coaching junior or mid-level engineers (formal or informal)

Our Commitment

This role is designed for a technically exceptional engineer who wants to operate at the cutting edge of a growing infrastructure team — someone who finds as much satisfaction in developing a platform or solving a thorny architectural problem as in resolving a complex incident. You will have genuine autonomy, direct influence on how the team works, and a clear line of sight to the IT Infrastructure Manager. Management responsibility is not part of this role, but you will be a technical anchor for the team and your contribution will be felt across everything the infrastructure function does. We welcome applications from candidates who may not meet every desirable criterion but can demonstrate exceptional technical depth and a genuine drive to develop both themselves and those around them.

Why Join Us?

By joining Medinet Group, you'll become part of the infrastructure that enables outstanding patient care across the UK. Your work will directly support clinicians and operational teams in delivering safe, efficient and effective healthcare services.

In return, we offer:

- The opportunity to support critical healthcare systems.
- A collaborative and supportive IT team environment.
- Exposure to a wide range of clinical technologies and digital health platforms.
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.
- A growing organisation focused on innovation and continuous improvement.
- The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both colleagues and patients.

Equal Opportunities

Medinet Group is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Applications are welcomed from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other protected characteristic.

title: Management Accountant
description:
The Role

Reporting to the Financial Controller, this role plays a key part in preparing the monthly management accounts across our UK and US trading entities. The role is based in our Harrogate office, working alongside our finance team, and is hybrid with 3 days a week in the office.

This is an opportunity to build your career within a well-established, high-performing finance function. It's well suited to someone looking to broaden their commercial exposure. You'll take ownership of sales, margin and stock reporting, lead on standard cost and purchase price variance analysis, and business partner closely with FP&A and the wider business.

You'll be joining a team with a positive, can-do culture. We live by our "Be a Good Egg" value, bringing honesty, kindness and a willingness to roll up our sleeves and support each other, even on the busiest days.

Why NEOM Wellbeing?

We're a B Corp on a mission to supercharge the wellbeing of our communities and our planet with 100% natural fragrances, and we've been named one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. Our benefits include a monthly product allowance, a generous staff discount, enhanced healthcare, extra wellbeing days, your birthday off, volunteering time and enhanced family leave.

We're an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Key Responsibilities & Objectives

Management Accounts & Reporting

- Assist in the production of the monthly management accounts with a focus on completing Sales Reporting and Margin Analysis to required deadlines, and explaining the outputs clearly to non-finance colleagues
- Prepare information for inclusion in the monthly Management Accounts Pack
- Take direct accountability for the integrity of all sales and COGS transactions, ensuring that cash received across our multiple sales channels is accurately recorded and fully reconciled
- Support the Commercial Finance function through ad hoc sales and margin reporting
- Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations with ownership for query resolution

Stock & Cost Accounting

- Take ownership of all stock accounting, proactively identifying and driving efficiencies and process improvements
- Develop and maintain cost accounting, preparing meaningful analysis to compare standard costs to actual production costs and investigating PPV (Purchase Price Variances) identified
- Maintain systematically held selling prices and customer discounts in the ERP, including wholesale discounts against RRP

Systems & Process Improvement

- Proactively identify, develop and deploy system improvements that reduce manual interaction within the accounting function and improve the timeliness of reporting available to the business, working closely with the Financial Controller to bring these to life
- Develop or adapt systems and processes to support improved ways of working and additional analysis

Key Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

- Act as liaison with the Operations team to ensure stock holdings are reported accurately, physical stock takes are executed, and periodic reconciliations are completed
- Business partner with Commercial Finance and the wider business to support commercial decision-making
- Support the Financial Controller in the provision of information required for annual and interim audits

Requirements

Essential

- Part/Qualified accountant
- Experience of an ERP accounting software system
- A level of IT literacy that enables you to analyse and interrogate data using Excel
- Excellent communicator able to develop relationships with both external and internal clients
- Ability to identify and implement continuous process improvement
- Eligible to work in the UK

Desirable

- Experience of stock monitoring, including stock counts and reconciliations
- Experience of standard cost accounting
- Experience of Sage X3 (ERP)
- Some audit-related experience at a standard level, such as process walkthroughs or pulling samples
- Confident business partner, able to collaborate effectively with Commercial Finance and colleagues across the business

Benefits

- TIME TO CHILL - 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- BIRTHDAY TREAT - Extra day off on your birthday
- WELLBEING DAYS - take some time to recharge and reset
- NEOM GOODIES - A free NEOM product each month, plus staff discount for you to enjoy
- HEALTH CARE - Cash back plans, outpatient cover, GP consultations, therapies and mental health support
- DO GOOD, FEEL GOOD - Time off for you to volunteer, plus support for personal fundraising efforts

title: Software Engineer - Integration
description:
Description

THE ROLE

At Debenhams Group, we are on a journey of transformation, revitalising our brand, culture, and connection with colleagues and customers alike. In a fast-changing retail environment, effective and authentic communication is vital to building trust, aligning our teams, and amplifying the impact of our work across internal and external audiences.

We are looking to hire an experienced Software Engineer to join the integrations team.

This role will be based out of our central Manchester office.

What You'll Be Doing

- You’ll work across a serverless, event-driven architecture on AWS, contributing to services that ingest, enrich, and distribute millions of product records across our brands and e-commerce partners.
- Building and extending serverless data pipelines using AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and Step Functions
- Developing and maintaining GraphQL APIs via AWS AppSync
- Integrating with third-party e-commerce platforms and marketplace APIs
- Managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform and AWS CDK
- Supporting AI-driven product enrichment work using AWS Bedrock
- Writing well-tested TypeScript across a microservices monorepo, with some Python
- where needed

Essential

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- Solid TypeScript / Node.js experience in a production environment
- Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services (Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, S3, DynamoDB)
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code, using Terraform and/or AWS CDK
- Comfort working in an event-driven, microservices architecture
- Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL stores (DynamoDB)
- Experience writing unit and integration tests (we use Jest)
- Working knowledge of CI/CD practices

Nice To Have

- Experience with AWS AppSync or GraphQL API development
- Python scripting in a data or pipeline context
- Knowledge of data pipeline patterns or ETL/ELT workflows
- Exposure to AWS Athena or data warehousing concepts
- Experience with e-commerce, marketplace or product data integrations

WORKING WITH US

At Debenhams Group we thrive on change, innovation, and pace. Every challenge is an opportunity, and every day is a chance to push boundaries. If you’re someone who embraces the unknown, thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment, and is ready to shape the future of retail, you’ll love it here. We want visionaries, disruptors, and doers—people who bring fresh thinking, relentless energy, and the drive to make an impact.

WHY JOIN US

Our mission is to create a workplace where everyone is respected, individual differences are valued, and people can be themselves at work — without exception.

2025 was a year of significant change for the Group. 2026 is about bold moves, real results and unstoppable momentum. If that excites you, you belong at Debenhams Group.

Our Benefits Include (subject To Level And Eligibility)

- Highly competitive bonus scheme, company pension, share schemes, private medical cover and life assurance
- Access to an on-site gym and free weekly Pilates, yoga and fitness classes
- Discount across all brands
- Comprehensive wellbeing package
- Dog-friendly offices (in selected locations)
- Ongoing learning and development with strong internal progression

title: Capital Project Manager
description:
Would you like a career like no other? If so… JoinUs

South Wales Police brings together thousands of people with the same aim – to keep South Wales safe.

We want to be the best at understanding and responding to our community’s needs. To do this we need the very best candidates from a wide range of backgrounds to apply to become part of our policing family.

We are looking for someone to #JoinUs as a Capital Delivery Manager in our Estates Department, could you be who we are looking for?

About The Team/Department You Will Be Joining

The Estates department looks after all the buildings in South Wales Police. The Capital team sits within Estates and manages all the new builds and refurbishments. These builds can range from a divisional head quarters to a new Custody Suite.

You would be joining a team based at South Wales Police Headquarters in Bridgend, however the post holder would be required to travel to and work from different locations within the force operating area. This is a full-time position, operating 5 days per week, Monday-Friday.The role operates on a hybrid working basis, combining office-based working with the flexibility to work from home, subject to operational requirements

About The Role And Your Key Responsibilities

The role is to deliver a significant capital build programme, which will include the construction of major buildings within the South Wales Police Area.

What skills and experience do we need you to bring to the role:

For this role the successful candidate would be highly motivated to deliver a fast-paced construction programme of works, have previous experience of managing multiple complex construction projects along with managing a team and the budget.

Please note, if you are an internal candidate and subject to an ongoing PSD investigation, your appointment or placement in the role may be delayed pending an outcome. Whether the role is held open will be considered on a case-by-case basis

There are numerous benefits to working for South Wales Police, from learning and development opportunities to schemes which aim to improve your lifestyle and wellbeing, as well as generous Local Government Pension Scheme / Police Pension Schemes, paid annual leave, flexible working and family friendly policies and many more, click here for more information.

First time applying for a role with South Wales Police? Be sure to read our application gudiance for some hints and tips around the application form and what to expect, click here for more information. Please note the successful candidate must be willing to undergo vetting to the required level.

As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons. However, as Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic candidates are currently underrepresented within the Force, we would particularly welcome applications from ethnically diverse candidates.

To support the ambition of a diverse workforce, South Wales Place is able to offer a Guaranteed Interview Scheme (GIS). The GIS is available for people living with a disability or identify as ethnically diverse.

If you are an applicant who is living with a disability or from an ethnically diverse background (Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic) and would like to be considered under the GIS, you must meet the essential minimum criteria for the role as outlined in the advert and role profile. You should take time to evidence that you meet each of the essential criteria in your application form and/or personal statement and CV.

The successful Candidate must be willing to undergo vetting to MV/SC Vetting.

title: Engineering Operator Technician
description:
Seniority Level:

Benefits: Employer Pension contribution of up to 8%, Private Medical Insurance, Product Allowance and much more!

Key Experience and Qualifications:

Essential:

- Recognised apprenticeship, NVQ3 or equivalent electrical qualification
- ONC or equivalent
- Experience in a multi-disciplined industrial engineering function
- Basic PLC capabilities and network configuration expertise

Desirable:

- Experience of working within an FMCG environment
- HNC or equivalent
- Experience working with Siemens or Allen-Bradley PLC’s
- IEE 17th Edition

Primary purpose and function of position:

Reporting to the First Line Manager in the Utilities Department the role of an Electrical Technician is a multi-skilled position. The main purpose of this position is to carry out planned and reactive maintenance in support of a high-speed packaging line, production or utilities areas. The role is vital for the efficiency, quality and cost of the plant. An Electrical Technician will look to improve the reliability and safety of the plant and production processes.

This job description and the job title Electrical Technician is not necessarily descriptive of all duties and does not restrict flexibility. You may be required, from time to time, to carry out tasks in addition to or instead of your normal duties, either for the brewery or for AB InBev, provided that they are reasonable and within your capabilities.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

Working for the Utilities department you will work in a team consisting of multi skilled Technicians. You be responsible for carrying out planned and reactive maintenance support across utilities equipment such as water treatment, pumping systems, boilers, NH3 and CO2 equipment.

Accountabilities:

Duties include:

Electrical maintenance, including

- Carry out planned preventative maintenance
- PLC controlled systems - Siemens S7 PLC's or suitable PLC experience.
- Fault finding, single and three phase supplies
- Machinery fault diagnosis and repairs
- Instrument calibration
- 17th edition qualification
- Use of Plant Optimisation tools to ensure sustainability of high departmental standards, Hygiene and PDCA
- Undertake, drive and support maintenance and improvement activities
- Share best practice across shifts with respect to maintenance and CIL
- Review and develop safety and maintenance procedures (SWI)
- Record all maintenance activities within maintenance management system (SAP)
- Liaise with suppliers of OEM’s for the provision of spares/services
- Maintenance prioritisation and planning
- Support the development and maintenance of a high performance, flexible and “can do” culture
- Analyse machines to improve performance
- Identify critical spares for designated machines
- Refurbish spares as required
- Complete some work at heights, confined space & as a lone worker
- Project work
- Carry out quality inspections on jobs
- Liaise with & assist client departments and customers
- Control maintenance tools, stores and equipment
- Monitor and control maintenance costs
- Write, review & update maintenance SOP’s, OPL’s & job tasks.
- Work in a safe manner following all company policies and procedures
- Ensure all safety systems are in working order

Key skills, knowledge and Competencies

- Proactive & self-managed engineer who is professional and has a can do attitude
- Good communication skills and above all take pride in the work they are completing
- On occasions you will be expected to work with external contractors
- Understanding Continuous Improvements, HACCP and Food Safety protocols.
- Undertake activities to support VPO compliance and sustainability
- Comply with health, safety and hygiene policies and practices at all times and ensure standards are maintained
- Positive “can do” attitude
- Committed to a high performance and CI environment
- Support a “Learning Organisation” environment
- Analysis of numerical information and good IT literacy
- Ability to make decisions and challenge
- High levels of team working
- Hygiene will be of the utmost importance and a good understanding of Quality testing and microbiology would be useful.
- Ability to work under own initiative and prioritise workload effectively
- Ability to work as part of a team, interacting effectively with a variety of departments and individuals
- Strong organisation skills with a structured and systematic approach, adhering to deadlines, able to work on own initiative and prioritise workload effectively.

We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.

Unique culture

We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company’s long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication.

Brands everyone loves

We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.

Growth opportunities

Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. In an environment where commitment to excellence pays off, our people are able to deepen their impact and create a long-lasting legacy.

Brewing the world’s most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work.

That’s Who We Are: Come and OWN IT.

title: Project Manager
description:
- Job Title: Project Manager
- Location: Glasgow
- Work Pattern: Hybrid
- Salary/Rate Banding: up to £75,000 depending on experience

Role Summary:

The Project Manager is responsible to Senior Project Manager and has a key role throughout the project lifecycle.

Role Tasks:

- Project management of preparation, delivery and commissioning phases of infrastructure works.
- Provide project management capability to the project and establish and deliver project specific objectives.
- Use and promote appropriate leadership styles to gain and maintain the trust, confidence, commitment and collaboration of team members and stakeholders throughout the project ensuring continued momentum.
- Manage the contract to maintain a productive working relationship with industry partners and suppliers, monitoring their performance in terms of quality, time, cost and reliability. Identify and manage emerging issues to avoid programme delays or cost escalation.
- Manage financial performance of projects to control expenditure against approved project budgets and provide accurate financial reporting and forecasting.
- Participate in, and generate evidence for, project assurance and gateway reviews at key stages to evaluate progress, compliance and probability of delivery to provide confidence to senior management, customers and key stakeholders Manage the project team in line with a High Performing Team ethos.
- Be accountable for complying with all agreed processes and operating procedures and particularly those which are detailed under key infrastructure process.
- Close contracts, once the goods and/or services have been delivered and accepted, ensuring that all financial arrangements have been honoured, all contract changes have been accounted for, and any necessary maintenance contracts have been agreed.
- Monitor the performance of technical support providers and supply chain in terms of the quality, timeliness and reliability of goods and/or services against agreed contractual obligations.
- Review and critique the schedule of major phases or tranches, milestones and review points for the project, sufficient to inform the direction of work and the monitoring of progress.
- Establish and agree an overall budget for project, based on the business case.
- Be responsible for the development of a cash flow forecast and set up arrangements for the drawdown of funds, refining budget allocations and cost management processes, implementing the change control process where relevant and appropriate.
- Be responsible for the provision of financial information and for the upgrade of internal systems on forecast, profiles and estimates to complete.
- Have a sound knowledge of risk process and management.
- Make recommendations based on impact assessments about whether to approve, reject or defer changes, or to request further information.

Experience:

Essential:

- Available to work on site and be able to obtain Security Clearance.
- Hands on construction background, as opposed to consultant background, with building services experience.
- Experience delivering infrastructure works.
- Sound commercial knowledge and understanding of the cost and value of packages as well as construction delivery experience, must be able to question and challenge CE’s.
- Hands on experience of managing delivery using NEC4 contracts including management of change and stakeholder management.
- IT skills.

Desirable:

- Experience of managing projects in complex live operational environment, ability to follow due process in a regulated facility.
- Experience of working in collaborative environment.
- Flexibility and adaptability to fast changing needs.
- Knowledge and understanding of Gant charts, especially critical path analysis.
- Experience using CEMAR or similar Construction contract management software.

If you can demonstrate experience in approximately 60% of the roles and responsibilities outlined, we would still encourage you to apply.

We recognise that the right candidate may not meet every requirement and can bring transferable skills and behaviours, with the potential to

develop further in the role.

Why us?

Employee Staff Benefits:

- 8.5% Pension Contribution & Life Assurance
- Private Medical Scheme*
- Employee Share Scheme
- Salary Sacrifice Schemes: Electrical Vehicles, Technology and Cycle to Work
- 18 Weeks Full Maternity Pay* (+21w SMP)
- 25 days holiday (increasing to 28 days after 5 years’ service, 31 days after 10 years’

service)

- Option to buy, sell and carry over up to 5 days annual leave per year
- In partnership with trade unions
- Personal Development & Further Education Support
- Long Service & Recognition Awards
- Free Employee Assistance Programme
- After 1 year of service.

NUVIA UK - a subsidiary of VINCI construction - is an international company that operates across highly regulated sectors including Civil Nuclear and has a strong presence and history of delivery at nuclear sites in the UK and internationally.

NUVIA UK is a performance-driven company that is committed to the development of its people within a culture of safety, innovation, and excellence.

title: Customer Service Assistant
description:

Through its AI-driven platform, Propel evaluates customers in a more comprehensive way than traditional credit scores can. The right candidate will be someone who wants to make a difference to people, you would be good at listening and won't feel the need to pass judgment. Desirable:

- Call centre experience
- Salesforce background

- Competitive salary
- Pension
- 20 days holidays, increasing by 1 day per year (up to 30)
- Growth and opportunity – we pride ourselves on promoting from within

- A culture that values innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

Fostering an inclusive culture helps each of us to benefit from a wider range of these different perspectives, experiences and skills. We believe that this creates a happier, more productive working environment for us all.

title: DevOps Development Engineer
description:
DevOps Development Engineer:

- Build and automate cloud infrastructure that supports meaningful application modernisation
- Develop your cloud engineering expertise in a collaborative Agile delivery team
- Hybrid 80% homeworking and 20% from Stratford upon Avon

About the role:

At NFU Mutual, you’ll join an Agile cloud engineering team that builds infrastructure solutions in response to business demand. Working from designs created by cloud specialists, you’ll turn agreed designs into working solutions and help modernise applications that have moved from on premises infrastructure to the cloud.

You’ll configure, develop, test and integrate cloud infrastructure, working with colleagues across technical, application and project teams. You’ll contribute through agile methodologies, strengthen automation, and help improve resilience, security and cost efficiency.

You’ll also interpret solution designs, support detailed technical design, apply new tools and approaches, document the handover of platform components into business as usual operations and help resolve live technical incidents and system problems.

Beyond the day to day technical delivery, you'll be joining a supportive team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced cloud specialists, deepen your engineering expertise and play a meaningful role in NFU Mutual's cloud modernisation journey. Whether you're building on existing Azure experience or bringing transferable knowledge from another cloud platform, you'll be supported to develop your skills and grow your impact over time.

This is a permanent, full time role based in Stratford upon Avon, with 80% homeworking and 20% office based working.

This role is based in our Tiddington Head Office, just outside Stratford-Upon-Avon. However, we understand how important a positive work-life balance is, so to help you give your best, we offer great facilities when you want to be in an office environment and support to work up to 80% of your hours from home.

About you:

You’re a hands on cloud engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and turning designs into reliable working solutions. You bring an analytical approach, close attention to detail and the confidence to challenge established thinking constructively. With a strong learning mindset, you adapt as priorities change, take ownership of your contribution and work effectively within a technical team while supporting customers.

To join NFU Mutual, you’ll also bring:

- Hands on experience of cloud platform operations and implementation, with Microsoft Azure preferred and transferable experience of Amazon Web Services or a comparable cloud platform welcomed
- Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Bicep, Ansible or similar technologies, supported by automation and scripting capability in PowerShell
- Experience of continuous integration and delivery pipelines, including Azure DevOps and Git, together with relevant software development experience
- Experience of DevOps and Agile delivery, with awareness of ITIL practices
- Knowledge of Windows, networking and identity services, including TCP/IP, DNS and Entra ID; experience of Docker, Kubernetes, Python, Linux, Jenkins, Microsoft SQL Server or database projects is desirable

At NFU Mutual, we support an inclusive workplace and value all the differences that make us unique. We celebrate the creativity and innovation that comes from diverse perspectives and experiences and share a common vision of doing the right thing for our customers and employees.

We recognise that some candidates may experience barriers during the recruitment process. So, we encourage candidates to discuss any adjustments or accommodations they need to be the best they can be throughout our recruitment process.

We're proud to be a Disability Confident Employer, a Race at Work and Women in Finance Charter signatory and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, ethnicity, disability, neurodiversity, gender, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, or socioeconomic background.

Benefits and Rewards:

When you join our team, you can expect a supportive culture and an attractive range of rewards and benefits including:

- Salary Up to £60,000 depending on experience
- Annual bonus (up to 17.5% of salary)
- Contributory pension scheme, up to 20%, including your 8% contribution
- 25 days annual leave + bank holidays + buy/sell/save holiday trading scheme
- A Family Friendly policy that helps you balance your work and family responsibilities
- Access to savings at High Street brands, travel and supermarkets
- £20 contribution to a monthly gym membership – subject to T&Cs
- Health and wellbeing plan - cashback for dentist, opticians, physio and more
- Access to voluntary benefits, including health assessments, private medical insurance and dental insurance
- Employee Volunteering - volunteer in the community for one day each year
- Unlimited access to Refer a Friend £500 bonus scheme
- Life Assurance cover of 4 x salary
- Employee discounts of 15% on a range of NFU Mutual insurance policies.
- Salary sacrifice employee car scheme - subject to eligibility

Working at NFU Mutual:

We’re one of the UK’s leading general insurance and financial services organisations, and for over 110 years we’ve put our customers at the heart of everything we do. Our people are just as important to us, so we’re proud to be recognised as “a great place to work”.

Our Gallup Exceptional Workplace 2026 award was not only awarded with Distinction, but it also marked us as the first UK based company to earn a Gallup Exceptional Workplace award for eleven consecutive years. We’ve also been consistently recognised by Glassdoor. We appeared in the Glassdoor Best Places to Work UK list in 2023, 2024 and 2026 — and in 2026, we were the highest ranked insurance business in the UK, highlighting our strong employee experience and the positive feedback our people share on the platform.

Additionally, we were named in the LinkedIn Top Companies 2026 list of “Best midsize employers to grow your career in the UK”, and we’ve been certified as a UK Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026.

We offer a supportive and empowering culture where people are inspired to perform, given opportunities to grow, and recognised and rewarded for their contribution. Our people are proud to work for a company that respects them and their communities, and they trust us to be financially sustainable—so we’re successful now and in the future.
