title: Senior Airflow/ Cloud Engineer (Workload Automation)
description:
Position Overview

Job Title Senior Airflow/ Cloud Engineer (Workload Automation)

Location Birmingham

Corporate Title Assistant Vice President

Service Automation provides an integrated set of management tools for IT professionals to programmatically provision and automate the operational maintenance of their hybrid application environment. It focuses on the following key capabilities:

Technology Operations Automation.

Provisioning and Configuration

Workload Automation

Orchestration Development

This software engineering position is specifically focused within Workload Automation and is responsible for availability, latency, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, automation, emergency response, and capacity planning for the centralized platforms of Control-M, Automic, Airflow as well as Google services Cloud Composer, Workflows and Scheduler which are utilized across the Bank for workload automation/job scheduling/batch job management. This position will complement someone with a software engineering mindset, who is proficient coding with Python, has experience with API integration and orchestration, ServiceNow integration and Ansible yaml development to proactively build and implement services for Control-M, Automic and Google Cloud Composer automation.

Working as an engineer you will bridge the gap between development and operations. Further, you will architect, design and develop new features as well as expand and support existing features. You are expected to learn new technologies based on what we already deploy while also learning new technologies that will enhance our offerings.

What We’ll Offer You

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

- Hybrid Working - we understand that employee expectations and preferences are changing. We have implemented a model that enables eligible employees to work remotely for a part of their working time and reach a working pattern that works for them
- Competitive salary and non-contributory pension
- 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase additional days
- Life Assurance and Private Healthcare for you and your family
- A range of flexible benefits including Retail Discounts, a Bike4Work scheme and Gym benefits
- The opportunity to support a wide ranging CSR programme + 2 days’ volunteering leave per year

Your Key Responsibilities

- Develop solutions using Python, Kubernetes, Cloud services and API integrations
- Build and orchestrate REST APIs across Airflow, Google Cloud Platform, Control-M and Automic
- Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate provisioning, configuration, and management of infrastructure

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant – Morley, Leeds (Hybrid)

About us
Kodiak Financial is an accountancy practice based in Morley, Leeds. We look after around 600 sole traders and limited companies across the UK. The practice has doubled in size over the last year, and we plan to keep growing at that pace, both organically and by taking on client books from other firms.
Most of the accounts and returns are already prepared by the team before they reach review. A full-time client co-ordinator handles onboarding & administration and payroll runs separately.

The role
At the moment every file comes to the owner for review and sign-off. At our current size that has become the bottleneck, and it's the main reason we're hiring.
You'll take over the review of year-end accounts, tax returns and VAT returns. The preparation is largely done by the time a file reaches you, so you won't spend your days on bank recs and data entry. Your time will go on checking the work, dealing with the technical points that come up and getting jobs out on time.

What you'll take on in the first year
A lot of how we work needs to be formalised to support the growth, and you'll have a big say in how that's done.

- Implementing a formal review standard, including sign-off rules and clear guidance on what needs to go to the owner and what doesn't
- Keeping the job pipeline in Bright up to date, so we can see at a glance what's in progress, what's waiting on clients and what's overdue
- Improving how we request information from clients, so information is received quicker and fewer queries come back to us mid-job
- Helping new batches of clients come on board smoothly as the practice grows organically and by further acquisition
- Making quarterly MTD for Income Tax submissions part of the normal routine

Day to day

- Reviewing year-end accounts, CT600s, self assessment returns and VAT returns in Xero and Xero Tax
- Signing off work, or sending it back to the preparer with clear notes
- Giving feedback to the preparers so the same issues don't keep coming back
- Handling technical queries on the files you review, including emailing clients where needed
- Keeping on top of VAT and MTD deadlines
- Passing tax planning points and anything unusual to the owner

Who we're looking for
Essential:

- ACCA, ACA, CTA, AAT or ATT qualified, or qualified by experience
- At least 3 years in UK practice, working with sole traders and small limited companies
- Experience reviewing other people's work, not just preparing your own
- A solid working knowledge of corporation tax, self assessment and VAT
- Confident using Xero

Useful but not essential:

- Xero Tax and Bright Manager
- Hands-on experience of MTD for Income Tax

You'll get on well here if you like improving the way things are done and want a real say in how a growing business is run. If you'd prefer a large firm where every procedure is already set in stone, this probably isn't the right fit.

Package and progression

- Salary of £42,000 to £50,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working at our office in Morley, Leeds
- 37.5 hours a week, Monday to Friday
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- CPD and professional subscriptions paid

We're growing quickly and the ideal candidate would transition into a Client Manager role. As Client Manager you'd look after client relationships, report directly to the owner and have real input into how the practice is run and where it goes next.

Interview process and how to apply

- An initial interview on Google Meets
- An in-person interview at our Morley office, including a short practical exercise
- A decision shortly afterwards

To apply, send us your CV with a few lines about a process you've improved at a previous practice.

This role is open to UK-based candidates only.

title: Lead Power Systems Engineer Earthing
description:
Lead Electrical Engineer - Earthing

Hybrid working with one of the following as your primary site:
Derby, Manchester or Warrington
Salary - £60,000-£78,750 dependent on the skills,

We are recruiting a Lead Electrical Engineer - Earthing

The Electrical Systems team is responsible for delivering safe, resilient and technically robust electrical infrastructure across the power station. Earthing and lightning protection systems are fundamental to ensuring plant safety, regulatory compliance and system integrity. This includes the design, verification and substantiation of systems that protect both people and equipment, ensuring a consistent and compliant approach across the station.

About the Role:

As a Lead Electrical Engineer - Earthing, you will provide technical expertise across the design and development lifecycle of earthing and lightning protection systems. You will lead system architecture, sub system design, equipment specification and the selection of components necessary to realise the final verified design of the SMR power station.

You will work across engineering teams electrical, civil, systems, safety and project functions to ensure earthing systems are integrated effectively, compliant with UK and international standards and aligned with overall plant architecture.

You will act as a responsible designer and intelligent customer, ensuring quality, consistency and technical rigour throughout the project lifecycle.

You will support design reviews, risk assessments, strategic planning, and technical governance activities. You may also mentor less experienced engineers and support engagement with suppliers, customers, regulators and external stakeholders.

We'll Need You To:

Provide technical leadership for earthing and lightning protection systems

Assess and substantiate designs to ensure compliance with UK and international standards

Develop system architecture, specifications, design documentation and component selections

Support designers by offering technical guidance and design review input

Lead or contribute to technical reviews, ensuring quality is maintained through project gates

Identify risks and develop mitigations during system design and integration

Support capacity planning, long term strategy and team development

Work across power station engineering teams to deliver standardised, commoditised approaches to system design

Represent electrical engineering in working groups, supplier engagements, customer discussions and regulatory dialogue

Manage or oversee supply chain partners delivering work packages

Coach and mentor less experienced engineers across the electrical discipline

Key Skills Required:

We know there's no such thing as the 'perfect' candidate. If you meet around 75% of the criteria below, we'd love to hear from you:

Experience across the electrical system lifecycle in a regulated industry (nuclear preferred but not essential)

Strong knowledge and experience in earthing and lightning protection system design, assessment, verification, installation, commissioning and maintenance

Knowledge of relevant earthing and lightning protection codes and standards for the UK and Europe

Experience developing earthing and lightning protection systems in nuclear or high integrity environments

Knowledge of systems engineering methodologies, including MBSE tools such as Capella, DOORS or Polarion

Proven ability to manage contract partners delivering technical work packages

Understanding of commercial availability and cost considerations for materials

Practical field experience in earthing or lightning protection design or installation

Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to present complex
information to technical and non technical audiences

Degree in electrical engineering or related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience)

We welcome applicants from a wide range of regulated sectors including nuclear, defence, aerospace, rail and energy.

Salary and Package:

The salary band for this will be between £60,000-£78,750 dependent on the skills, values and knowledge you bring. There may be some flexibility with the starting salary in exceptional cases, and, in due course, the role may be developed further.

Benefits include:

Bonus - Performance related target opportunity 12.5%
Benefits Cash Allowance £2,200 per annum for a bespoke package
Pension - 12% employer and 6% employee contributions
Holidays - 28 days (+ public holidays) with the ability to buy or sell up to 4 days
Private Medical Insurance - BUPA single cover
Life Assurance - 6x pensionable pay
Home Office Support - £250 one off payment for new starters

Due to the safety regulations within the nuclear industry, applicants will be required to participate in additional screening. These are:

Obtaining Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance
Satisfactory completion of a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check
Satisfactory completion of a basic financial probity check

title: Trainee Web Developer
description:
Trainee Web Developer - No Experience Required

Are you looking to kick-start a new career as a web developer?

We are recruiting for companies who are looking to employ our Coding Traineeship graduates to keep up with their growth. The best part is you will not need any previous experience as full training will be provided. You will also have the reassurance of a job guarantee within 20 miles of your location upon completion.
Whether you are working full time, part-time or unemployed, this package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you.

The traineeship is completed in 4 easy steps, you can be placed into your first role in as little as 3-6 months:
Step 1 - Introduction to Development - Complete a selection of professional and industry recognised coding courses covering HTML5, CSS3, Javascript and Python. The training is delivered via multimedia rich video tutorials, presentations and quizzes, through a portal that you study from home. These courses will give you the basic understanding of the front end programming languages.
Step 2 - Full-Stack Development - You will be studying a wide range of, mostly back-end programming languages and skills that will qualify you as a fully-fledged developer. Step 2 is heavily focused on the practical element of learning. With our courses, you will practice the skills as you learn them, through our inbuilt mini-project labs.
Step 3 - Two real-world projects - Once you have completed your training you will be assigned 2 real-world projects by your tutor. The projects are the most important part of the Traineeship as it will showcase to employers your practical applications of the coding languages you learnt earlier in the Traineeship. The projects take on real-world scenarios for you to solve and will simulate similar projects that you will encounter when working as a future Developer.
Step 4 - Portfolio Website - Now that you have completed the projects its time to showcase them on your own portfolio website. You will be creating a simplistic yet stylish website where you will be able to showcase to potential employers a snapshot of your level of ability as a Full-Stack developer. This will include the coding languages you are proficient in, links to the two real-world projects you completed, Github work you accumulated during your studies and any other relevant information.
Your Web Developer Role
Once you have completed all of the mandatory training, which includes the online courses, practical projects and building your own portfolio, we will place you into a Web Development/Software Development role, where you will be guaranteed a great starting salary. We have partnered with a number of large organisations strategically located throughout the UK, providing a nationwide reach of jobs for our candidates.
At a one off cost of £1499, or 13 interest free monthly instalments of £130, this represents a great opportunity to start a rewarding career in IT and have a real career ladder to start climbing. If you are not offered a role at the end of the training we will refund 100% of your course fees.

Read through the information? Passionate about starting a career in coding? Apply now and one of our friendly advisors will be in touch.
Keywords:
Coding, programming, web developer, software developer, app developer, Trainee, PHP, HTML, SQL, CSS3, Java, Javascript, Python, C#, Trainee Web Developer

title: Support Worker Driver
description:

description:
Apprentice Chef
From £27,989 per year
Catering with impact.

Get skills, get qualified, get confident.
You Belong Here.

title: Store Manager
description:
Overview
Store Manager Here at Costa Coffee, we want to inspire the world to love great coffee. Were all about embracing passion, energy and teamwork to serve memorable moments for every one of our customers. And youll be leading from the front, taking your store to new heights with your experience, resourcefulness and wonderful team. Its going to be a thrilling ride. A bit about the role Everything and we mean everything is yours. The store, stock, standards, team, labour, customers and coffee, coffee, coffee. Its all yours to own and grow. So go ahead and make it your own.
What's involved?

- Creating the perfect space for customers to kick back with our coffee
- Drumming up fresh ideas that meet customers ever-changing wants and needs
- Taking ownership of all controllable costs through effective management of stock, labour, training, and reward and recognition
- Inspiring your team to get buzzed about the business
- Training and developing your team to reach their full potential
A bit about you
A passion for coffee and people is just the start of what were looking for. What else makes a great Store Manager?

- Experience in leading a store team and inspiring them to strive for excellence.
- A commercial mind with the ability to think ahead and see the bigger picture, maximizing every sales opportunity
- A brand ambassador who ensures attention to brand standards
- An ambitious character who wants to be part of our growth journey
- Ability to thrive under pressure and execute at pace
- Experience of managing, coaching and developing team members they could be our future leaders
What we can offer
We're really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded with great perks and benefits:

- £TBC
- 45-hour per week contract
- 28 days' holiday, inclusive of bank holidays
- Staff discount, plus free drinks while you're on shift
- Access to over 5,000 local and national discounts through the Lifestyle Card
- Bespoke training and development tailored to your career aspirations, including Barista, Brand Standards, Compliance, Food Safety Level 2, and Leadership & Management training
- Company pension scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), providing confidential support whenever you need it
- Opportunities to make a positive impact in your local community through volunteering and community initiatives with the Costa Foundation
- Recognition and reward programmes, including work anniversary hampers, Store of the Month, Customer Feedback Awards, and Achievement Awards
And if this isn't enough, you'll also enjoy some fundraising for our Costa Foundation, helping children in coffee-growing communities gain access to safe and quality education. A bit about us
At the heart of Costa Coffee are our values. We believe in Passion, Warmth, Trust and Courage. Were the No. 1 coffee brand in the UK for the 16th year in a row. Here, youll be part of a genuine, passionate and warm team that shares a love for coffee and a desire to deliver great experiences to our customers, communities and people.At Costa Coffee, we celebrate inclusion and equality and believe everyone should bring their true self to work. We advocate collaboration and transparency. And embrace differences in all that we do.

*This role is for a store owned by one of our franchise partners, their hiring process, salary and benefits may vary from those within a wholly owned Costa store advert.

title: Registered Manager
description:
We are seeking a proactive and professional Registered Manager to lead the operational management of a specialist registered care home located in Witham, Essex. The service has been developed to meet the needs of people who have a learning disability and/or physical disability support needs, including mobility issues, epilepsy and dysphagia.
The service supports 18 people in three detached bungalows. The accommodation has been carefully designed to meet the 24-hour needs of individuals with a range of needs and special requirements.
As the Registered Manager you will ensure that the service remains of the highest quality, meeting all CQC and contract requirements and that this is demonstrated through comprehensive quality and contract monitoring processes.
You will ensure that the care and support delivered is truly person centred and provided in accordance with agreed care plans. Your role will include responsibility for:

- Recruitment and selection of staff matched to needs of service users
- Management and deployment of staff to meet the needs of service users
- Ensuring continuous, reliable and consistent service delivery at all times
- Performance management
- Compliance with CQC & commissioner expectations and standards
- Contract management and achievement of planned outcomes
- Effective prevention and management of incidents
- Staff support, supervision, coaching and training
- Team building and management
- Excellent customer care to all stakeholders
- Prompt reporting of repairs and property management issues
You must have at least three years prior experience of supporting people with a learning disability and at least two years supervisory/management experience.
We welcome the opportunity to have a chat about the role so please contact Laura Newcombe, Area Manager on or email
Vacancy Reference Number: 96062
Applications for this role must be submitted via the Creative Support website using the above vacancy reference number
Benefits of working with Creative Support include a probationary bonus, pension contributions, 33 days Annual Leave and company paid enhanced DBS.
We are a passionate, inclusive, and anti-racist organization – Stonewall Diversity Champion, Disability Confident Employer who have recently received Investors in People Gold awarded.

description:
Job DescriptionWe now have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Operational and Regulatory Technology department for an award-winning investment platform, offering a collaborative team working environment, training and excellent career progression.

- Agile methodologies and a passion for continuous improvement and building a high-performance engineering team
- Guide and mentor the team to design and deliver high quality products
- Consider architectural and non-functional requirements and work with the team to deliver

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
- Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
- Casual dress code
- Friendly, supportive team environment

For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

title: Manager/Senior Manager
description:
Accounts & Tax Manager / Senior Manager

Brighton · £50,000 to £80,000 · Full-time · A genuine route to Director and equity
About the firm

One of the longest-standing independent chartered firms in Brighton, with a friendly, partner-led feel and a client base that runs from retail and construction to property, legal and healthcare. Established and well-run, cloud-led on the software side, but small enough that the partners know every client and every member of the team.

You'd take on a substantial and varied portfolio, mainly accounts and tax, as the main point of contact for your clients. Maybe you're a manager or assistant manager ready to step up, or a senior manager who wants somewhere the next move is real. The key thing: you want to work towards directorship, and in time, equity.

- Salary of £50,000 to £80,000, depending on your level and experience
- A clear, realistic path to director and a genuine equity opportunity
- A varied portfolio you can properly get your teeth into
- A settled, friendly team in a central Brighton office
- A firm where good work gets noticed and progression actually happens

title: Community IV Nurse
description:

The RoleWe are looking for an experienced and motivated Bank Community IV Nurse to join our community nursing service, working approximately 20-30 hours per week on a flexible basis.
You will provide high-quality, patient-centred intravenous therapy and specialist nursing care to patients in their own homes and community settings.
Supporting patients throughout their treatment journey, you will deliver prescribed IV therapies, undertake clinical assessments and monitoring, and provide education and support to patients, families and carers. You will help patients feel confident managing their treatment while ensuring care is delivered safely and in accordance with clinical standards.
Working closely with pharmacists, consultants, specialist nurses and other healthcare professionals, you will play an important role in enabling patients to receive specialist treatment safely outside of the hospital environment.
As a bank nurse, you will have the opportunity to work flexibly while maintaining your clinical skills and delivering meaningful one-to-one patient care in the community.
Key Responsibilities
- Deliver safe and effective IV therapies in patients' homes and community settings in accordance with clinical guidelines, Service Operating Procedures and prescribed treatment plans.

- Administer prescribed intravenous medications and therapies safely and effectively.

- Undertake patient assessments and provide appropriate monitoring throughout treatment.

- Undertake home and community visits for therapy initiation, administration and follow-up.

- Provide education, training and ongoing support to patients, families and carers.

- Promote patient confidence, independence and adherence to prescribed therapy.

- Provide appropriate care and management of vascular access devices in line with clinical and infection prevention standards.

- Recognise changes in a patient's condition and escalate clinical concerns appropriately.

- Identify, document and report adverse events and incidents in accordance with relevant procedures.

- Maintain accurate, timely and comprehensive clinical documentation.

- Ensure clinical equipment is maintained appropriately and medicines and associated supplies are handled safely.

- Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary healthcare teams to support continuity of patient care.

- Organise and prioritise allocated patient visits effectively.

- Adhere to safeguarding, infection prevention, medicines management, clinical governance and regulatory requirements.

- Maintain professional registration and take responsibility for ongoing Continuing Professional Development (CPD).

What We're Looking ForEssential
- Registered Nurse with current NMC or NMBI registration.

- Minimum of 1 year post-registration nursing experience.

- Full UK or Irish driving licence.

- Strong clinical assessment and communication skills.

- Ability to work confidently and independently in patients' homes.

- Good organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to recognise clinical deterioration and escalate concerns appropriately.

- Confident using digital systems for clinical documentation and communication.

- Enhanced DBS (or equivalent) and satisfactory medical clearance.

- Ability to work approximately 20-30 hours per week, with flexibility according to patient and service requirements.

Desirable
- Previous experience in IV therapy, infusion services or community nursing.

- Experience with vascular access devices and IV medication administration.

- Experience within oncology, gastroenterology, infectious diseases, nutrition support, homecare or other specialist therapies.

- Experience caring for patients receiving complex or long-term therapies in their own homes.

- Relevant degree, specialist nursing qualification or post-registration clinical qualification.

What's on Offer
- Bank position with approximately 20-30 hours per week.

- Flexible working opportunities to fit around other commitments.

- Competitive bank rate.

- Community-based role offering autonomy and variety.

- Opportunity to maintain and develop specialist IV and community nursing skills.

- Ongoing professional development and relevant clinical training.

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
Maintenance Engineer
Location: Birmingham – Walkers Chocolates HQ
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Contract: Full-time, Permanent
Department: Engineering
Reports to: Maintenance Manager
The Opportunity
Are you an experienced Maintenance Engineer looking for your next opportunity within a fast-paced manufacturing environment
We are looking for a hands-on Maintenance Engineer to join the engineering team at Walkers Chocolates HQ in Birmingham, responsible for keeping manufacturing machinery, equipment and site facilities operating safely, reliably and efficiently.
This is a varied role combining planned preventative maintenance, reactive breakdown response, fault finding and continuous improvement, with a real focus on reducing downtime, improving equipment reliability and supporting production performance.
A Day in the Life
As a Maintenance Engineer, you'll work closely with production and engineering teams to keep equipment operating at optimum performance. You'll respond to breakdowns, diagnose faults and carry out effective repairs, while also delivering planned maintenance and identifying opportunities to prevent recurring failures. You'll contribute to continuous improvement projects, support changeovers and start-ups, maintain accurate engineering records and help ensure all engineering activities meet the required safety, quality and food safety standards.
What You'll Do
• Carry out planned preventative maintenance to maximise equipment reliability and production uptime.
• Respond to breakdowns, diagnose faults, identify root causes and implement effective repairs.
• Analyse recurring equipment failures and contribute to corrective actions and structured problem solving.
• Support continuous improvement, Kaizen, defect elimination and equipment performance projects.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records, defect logs and engineering documentation.
• Support production during changeovers, start-ups and operational improvements.
• Work in accordance with GMP, food safety, quality, legality and product authenticity requirements.
• Maintain engineering tools, equipment and work areas in line with 5S standards.
• Build strong working relationships with production teams and escalate significant downtime or recurring issues where required.
What You'll Bring
• A recognised Electrical and/or Mechanical Engineering qualification, or equivalent practical experience.
• Hands-on experience within a maintenance engineering environment.
• Strong electrical and/or mechanical fault-finding and breakdown response skills.
• Experience carrying out both preventative and reactive maintenance.
• The ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation.
• Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
• Good computer literacy and experience using maintenance systems.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• The flexibility to work within a fast-paced manufacturing environment and support operational requirements.
Desirable Experience
• Multi-skilled engineering capability across electrical and mechanical disciplines.
• Experience with high-speed packaging or manufacturing machinery.
• PLC fault-finding and diagnostic experience.
• Previous experience within FMCG or food manufacturing.
• Knowledge of BDA analysis, PPM systems and continuous improvement methodologies.
• GMP and food manufacturing compliance experience.
What Success Looks Like
You'll play a key role in improving equipment availability, reducing downtime and supporting reliable production. Success will be measured through effective preventative maintenance, improved breakdown response and MTTR, reduced equipment-related quality issues, successful changeovers and a strong contribution to safe and efficient operations.
The Environment
This is a site-based manufacturing position, working around production machinery and engineering equipment. The role involves regular standing, walking, bending and manual handling, with PPE required in designated areas. You will be expected to work in accordance with all health, safety, food safety and quality requirements.
If you're a proactive Maintenance Engineer with strong fault-finding skills and a passion for keeping manufacturing operations running at their best, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to take the next step in your engineering career.
No agencies please.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Maintenance Engineer to support the reliability and recovery of narrow-aisle high-bay cranes and associated conveyor systems within a busy manufacturing and warehouse environment.
The Maintenance Engineer will manage planned preventative maintenance, respond to breakdowns and carry out mechanical work including drive, bearing, gearing and roller-system repairs, alongside electrical repairs, installations and equipment upgrades.
Working closely with warehouse supervisors and management, the Maintenance Engineer will help minimise downtime, meet agreed service levels and maintain accurate PPM activity. The position also involves inverter and control-system programming, with PLC knowledge such as Siemens highly desirable.

DUTIES
Your duties as the Maintenance Engineer include:

- Crane Maintenance and Overhauls: Service, maintain and overhaul high-bay cranes, including drives, bearings, gearing and roller systems
- Breakdown Response: Attend equipment breakdowns within agreed SLAs, diagnose faults and restore operation efficiently
- Electrical Repairs and Installations: Complete electrical repairs, new installations and equipment upgrades to required industry standards
- Controls and Inverters: Change and programme inverters and other control systems
- Planned Preventative Maintenance: Keep PPM activity complete, accurate and up to date
- Operational Support: Work closely with warehouse supervisors and management to deliver the agreed level of service and minimise customer delays

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
ESSENTIAL

- Previous electrical and mechanical maintenance experience
- City & Guilds Level 2 or 3 NVQ Diploma or Extended Diploma in Mechanical Manufacturing Engineering (or equivalent)
- Strong mechanical capability with supporting electrical knowledge
- Excellent technical knowledge and fault-finding ability
- Ability to prioritise workloads, plan effectively and work under pressure to deadlines
- Good computer literacy and understanding of warehouse management systems
- Good problem-solving skills with a practical and creative approach
- Strong time-management, communication and team-working skills
- Ability to work at height within high-bay ASRS crane systems
DESIRABLE

- Experience within warehouse, retail, FMCG or a similar operational environment
- Experience with ASRS systems, automated cranes or overhead cranes
- PLC experience, including Siemens

title: Service Engineer
description:
Service Engineer

Salary: Competitive

Location: Bromsgrove

Benefits: 25 days holiday per annum (FTE), plus bank holidays, increasing with service; Pension Scheme; wide training opportunities; all the latest software, tools and equipment

Are you a talented Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Service Engineer, looking for your next challenge with an employer that cares deeply for its employees, provides excellent training opportunities, and has a history of long serving employees?

What could you learn?

We have our own, bespoke City and Guilds accredited training centre. Last year, we delivered training to 117 engineers on service and maintenance, commissioning, brazing, refrigeration, water chillers, and more.

We believe strongly in providing training for our employees and courses are constantly reviewed and developed, allowing us to stay up to date with current technology and ways of working.

What you'll be doing

As a Service Engineer your goal is simple: to help our clients and deliver an outstanding service. Diagnosing, fault-finding, and fixing problems is the name of the game.

Our client sites include a wide range of industrial and commercial premises such as food processing, offices, pharmaceuticals, domestic, and many more. This branch does predominantly air conditioning, plus some refrigeration on varying scales.

We hold the highest accreditations with the best-known brands such as Danfoss, Mitsubishi, Daikin, Panasonic and Fujitsu. This gives our engineers access to the latest manufacturers' training and technical support.

You will have your own, high spec, fully racked van to travel to sites, and your own tablet for receiving your jobs, completing service sheets, and more.

It's a busy, sometimes pressurised job, which is the nature of our industry. But you have a supportive team and many highly skilled, experienced colleagues to call on and to learn from.

What's in it for you?

- A generous basic wage plus paid travel time, overtime, and standby rates.
- Excellent training opportunities.
- 25 days holiday per annum, plus bank holidays, increasing with service.
- Pension Scheme.
- Working hours are 40 hours per week, plus overtime.
- Engineers take turns to be on standby for out-of-hours calls and are paid a standby allowance plus overtime if they are called out.

What do you need to have?

- Demonstrable knowledge and experience as a mobile air conditioning service engineer.
- You need to hold Refrigerant handling C&G2079 or equivalent and a full UK driving Licence.
- An industry-specific training qualification, at NVQ2 level, would be an added advantage.

Due to the safeguarding requirements of our customers, many of whom are schools or hospitals, we complete confidential criminal record checks on all roles that attend customer sites. If you are successful, you will be required to complete an advanced DBS check. We strictly follow the DBS code of practice and comply with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. If you have a criminal record, this will not necessarily preclude you from working for us.

NEXT STEPS

If you're ready to join our team, simply click apply and complete the short application process.

We are an Equal Opportunities Employer. We encourage applicants from every background to apply for our vacancies. If you've got what it takes, then we want to hear from you!

For more information on what it is like to work for us, visit our Careers page on our website.

- Familiarity with plumbing, pipework and practical installation work

- Good understanding of electrics

title: STORE MANAGER
description:
Store Manager
Join us at Clarks, where we’ve been creating quality footwear for over 200 years. We’re looking for an inspiring Store Manager to lead one of our UK stores, deliver an exceptional shopping experience, and drive results through your team.
About the role
To manage a Clarks store in line with the business objectives. To lead and motivate the store team in order to maximise sales and profit, delivering set targets and KPIs. Responsible for the day to day running of the store, focussing on opportunities to enhance the consumer experience through delivery of the highest retail standards and team behaviours.
What you’ll do
• Lead and motivate the team to achieve targets and deliver the required consumer experience.
• Manage controllable costs and efficiencies to proactively improve profitability.
• Responsible for the management of the sales floor during trading hours.
• Regularly review commercial opportunities and consumer feedback to improve sales and take appropriate action.
• Lead implementation of the trading plan, including visual merchandising, to ensure the store and team are ready for all trading periods.
• Plan staffing levels against trading plan and manage rotas.
• Ensure all employment changes and relevant forms are completed to ensure team members are paid accurately and on time, including ensuring capability of management team to deliver.
• Recruit, develop and train a high performing and highly engaged team.
• Manage Health and Safety procedures in store including ensuring all team members understand their responsibilities.
• Manage all Employee Relations issues (including underperformance issues) fairly and in accordance with Company Policies and Procedures.
• Regularly review own performance and maintain a personal development plan.
• Manage cash, stock and security procedures to Company standards, including ensuring all team members understand their responsibilities.
• Ensure store compliance with all company and legal requirements, including visual merchandising guidelines, PCI, data protection, right to work, etc.
• Drive the implementation and delivery of key/new initiatives within store to achieve the objectives.
• Ensures the store administration processes are carried out effectively, with audit targets achieved.
• Ensures the effective management of the stock flow process to maximise sales and minimise losses
Key Outputs/Results:
• Store to achieve required performance standards on KPIs such as sales, multi-sales, conversion and consumer satisfaction.
• Store P & L is monitored monthly and, in conjunction with the Area Sales Manager, actions are taken to minimise controllable costs in order to achieve budgeted contribution.
• Floor control is delivered consistently, ensuring all consumers have a great brand experience.
• Reports and data provided are used to drive sales growth in-store to achieve budget.
• All trading periods (including Sale and BTS) are effectively planned in advance and executed correctly to maximise sales.
• Team availability is matched to sales and/or footfall to ensure it matches consumer demand.
• All HR documentation (including payroll) is completed correctly and sent on time to the relevant department to ensure correct payment of team members.
• All Company recruitment tools are used effectively to recruit all team members to ensure fair and legal recruitment of individuals with the correct skill set.
• All team members are trained to deliver product knowledge through the appropriate company selling models.
• All Health and Safety training, checks and record keeping are completed on time and correctly ensuring compliance with Company Policies and relevant legislation.
• All employee issues are dealt with in a timely fashion ensuring compliance with Company Policies and relevant legislation, communicating with HR, where appropriate, to seek advice and guidance.
• Maintain an up-to-date development plan and complete all performance review documentation before and after formal reviews, taking action accordingly.
• All security, cash, stock and administration procedures are followed.
• Record keeping and training for all team members are completed on time and correctly to ensure compliance with Company Policies.
• All relevant compliance of Company Policies and legal requirements are achieved and trained to team members where relevant.
• All team members receive regular communication of Company strategy and new initiatives.
• All team members are trained on Company Strategy and new initiatives, where relevant, and monitoring of implementation undertaken.
• Store Audits are prepared and successfully completed with company minimum standards achieved in stock accuracy, odds, financial variance and administration as detailed in Company Policies and training.
What we’re looking for
You’re a confident, hands-on leader with proven retail management experience and a track record of achieving targets. You know how to motivate a team, communicate clearly, and make sound commercial decisions. You’re organised, adaptable, and able to balance delivering results with creating a welcoming environment for customers and colleagues alike.
You’ll bring
Essential Knowledge:
• Stock Management
• Visual Merchandising
• Consumer Experience
• Managing Budgets
• Recruitment and Training

Technical Skills:
• IT proficient - able to use a range of systems to manage in-store activity
• Planning and Prioritising
• Commerciality
• Motivating and Leading a Team
• Well-developed Communication Skills

Successful Experience:
• Significant experience in retail management including leading a team, delivering consumer experience and managing store budgets.
• Delivering or exceeding sales and targets.
• Significant leadership experience including managing direct and indirect reports, coaching, giving feedback and developing team members.
• Managing staffing levels to sales.
Why join us?
At Clarks, you’ll be part of a brand with heritage, craftsmanship, and style at its core. We offer great training, career progression, and the chance to make your mark in a global business.
About Clarks
Two brothers, a small town, and shoes that changed the world. Based in Somerset, England, Clarks has redefined shoemaking since its foundation in 1825, when James and Cyrus Clark made a slipper from sheepskin off-cuts and forever transformed the future of footwear.
Sparking

title: Customer Service and Sales Advisor
description:
Customer Service and Sales Advisor
Location: Coventry, CV5 – Meriden Business Park (fully on site)
Salary: £26,436.68 basic, plus commission (£29.5k OTE)
We are recruiting a Customer Service and Sales Advisor for a well-established experiences business in Coventry. If you are already good on the phone and you would rather sell something people are genuinely pleased to buy, this is worth a look.
This is a Customer Service and Sales Advisor role where every call is an inbound one from someone who already wants what you are offering – a spa day, a spa break, a treatment for a birthday or an anniversary. No cold calling. Your job is to listen properly, work out what they are actually after, and guide them to the right booking.
This Customer Service and Sales Advisor role is a Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:30pm role. Add one Saturday in three (9:00am–5:00pm) and that is your week – no evenings, no Sundays.
It is based at Meriden Business Park, just off the A45 and minutes from the M42, with free on-site parking.
What you will be doing
- Handling inbound calls and live chat enquiries about spa days, spa breaks and treatments
- Listening for what the customer really wants – relaxation, a celebration, a gift
- Giving confident, impartial advice across a large range of venues and packages
- Converting enquiries into confirmed bookings
- Managing amendments and cancellations properly and calmly
- Keeping every booking accurate in the CRM
What we are looking for
- Solid experience in a phone-based customer service or sales advisor role – contact centre, call centre, reservations, bookings, retentions or membership sales
- Warm and calm on the phone, and good at building trust quickly
- Comfortable guiding someone to a decision without hard selling
- Commercially minded – you enjoy hitting a target, rather than dread it
- Accurate with systems and detail when the queue is busy
- Available Monday to Friday 9:00–5:30, plus one Saturday in three
Spa, salon, beauty, wellness, hospitality, travel or leisure experience is a real advantage.
What you will get
- £26,436.68 basic salary, plus commission on top (£29.5k OTE)
- Birthday leave
- Agent rates and 50% off selected spa experiences
- Familiarisation spa visits – you get to try what you are selling
- Free on-site parking
- Free gym membership
- Workplace pension
- Dress-down environment, team socials, and a team people actually stay in
Being straight with youThis role is five days a week on site – there is no hybrid or remote option. The one Saturday in three is part of the job. It is a sales role as well as a service one: there are targets and there is commission attached to them. If you want pure admin away from a phone, this is not it.
If that all sounds fine, you will probably like it here a lot.
Apply Now.

title: Graduate Maintenance and Manufacturing Engineer
description:
This could be the ideal role for you if you're an engineering graduate who enjoys fixing things, working on projects, and thinking of ways that things can be done better.
The business manufactures a range of items that make up part of large buildings, for example sports stadiums.
A range of machines are used in the manufacturing process. Your role will be the first line of defence for these machines; fixing breakdowns, making repairs, and generally maintaining them.
But there is a lot more to it: around 40% of your time will be working on a wide range of projects.
And you’ll also be looking at how processes can be improved. For example, if there was a fault in a machine, working out why it happened and thinking of ways to prevent it happening again.
It’s a small team, and you’ll be working with experienced colleagues, and learning from them. But you’ll also have a lot of independence to get on with things.
40 hrs a week either 8am-5pm or 7am-4pm
You should have an Engineering degree. Manufacturing would be ideal, but some others are ok (Mechanical or Electrical focused) if you can demonstrate interest in this area. And you’ll need to enjoy fixing things.
You won’t be sat at your desk all the time, you’ll be out and about on the floor. There will be some heavy work involved, and at times you will get dirty.

Why Greencore?

Following the combination with Bakkavor in January 2026, we're one of the UK's leading creators of convenience food, driven by a simple purpose: to make everyday taste better.

What you'll be doing

As a Product Developer, your role will be to develop new, and modify existing products, in line with written briefs, customer expectations and financial targets to create products of sustainable and repeatable quality and sustainable cost.

In this role you will be required to:

- Develop new and existing recipes into commercially viable products, benchmarking regularly to gain awareness of the market for a competitive advantage.
- Create recipes alongside the chefs, input recipes onto the recipe management system and review the accuracy of all recipes inputted by the product technologist and chefs to ensure they meet cost, weight and nutritional requirements.
- Ensure the viability of new raw ingredients from an operational, technical and product development perspective to bring innovation and challenge to existing Greencore policies and practices.
- Complete and/or review and approve all relevant documentation (feasibility forms, customer submission forms, concept to process handovers etc.) to ensure accuracy of information shared internally and externally.
- Put all products through the feasibility process; working with the commercial, operations, technical and purchasing teams to solve any issues to ensure concepts are repeatable, sustainable and scalable.
- Compile product costing information and adapt recipes to balance food quality with achievement of commercial brief targets within customer brand standards.
- Present benchmarking, existing (EPD) and new products (NPD) at internal and customer presentations, passionately demonstrate good market and food trends awareness, to achieve product approval.
- Follow the critical path time lines as directed, escalating incomplete tasks and deficiencies in testing, to ensure that mitigating action can be taken to prevent delays in product acceptance and launch.
- Assist the process team with the scale up production trials, as required, to ensure production quality matches the kitchen quality signed off by the customer.
- Provide leadership and direct to ensure that across the team people are kept safe, engaged, focused, developed an delivery to their potential
There will be regular travel required in this role and therefore a full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle is required.

What we're looking for

At Greencore we put our people at the core. We celebrate their differences and help everyone to be themselves at work. Together we make every day taste better.

- Proven experience in food product development
- Analytical; comfortable with producing and reviewing costings
- Proficient in all elements of product development from concept to launch
- Proven track record of successfully validating products and producing high quality documentation
- Confident in presenting to all levels within the business and directly to customers
- Experience in people management
If this sounds like you, join us and grow with Greencore, and be a part of driving our future success.

What you'll get in return

* Competitive salary and job-related benefits
* Holidays
* Competitive matched pension contributions
* Life insurance up to 4x salary
* Company share save scheme
* Greencore Qualifications
* Exclusive Greencore employee discount platform
* Access to a full Wellbeing Centre platform
* Enhanced parental leave and menopause policies

Throughout your time at Greencore, you will be supported with on the job training and development opportunities to further your career.

We reserve the right to close the advert ahead of the specified closing date.

Greencore and its recruitment partners never charge candidates any fees at any stage of the hiring process. Any request for payment relating to a job opportunity should be considered fraudulent.

title: Store Manager
description:
As a Store Manager in your local Store, we want to use your product knowledge, ability to engage with customers and your team management to help drive your store’s performance.
You’ll still have the chance to be on the shop floor and help our customers to find Sleep wellness with the right sleep products, but we also want you to lead and inspire your team of Consultants. title: Store Manager
description:
Overview
Store ManagerAt Costa Coffee by Sim Trava, we want to inspire the world to love great coffee, just as much as our partner, Costa Coffee.Sim Trava is a family run business on the hunt for hardworking, ambitious, happy, and loyal people to join our team, if that sounds like you, youre probably just what were looking for.We want to recruit people that are proud to work for us, because a happy team equals happy customers. We know that our people are the most important part of our business, so we strive to create a working environment.A bit about the roleAt Sim Trava we treat our managers as business owners, this is your business. That means the stock, standards, team, labour, and customers Its all yours to own and grow. So go ahead and make it your own.
What's involved?

- Taking ownership of all controllable costs through effective management of stock, labour, cash, and training. Making sure to celebrate success along the way.
- Inspiring your team to feel valued and get involved in making the store the best it can be.
- Manage the store KPI report, Costa Check and Listen and Learn then look for trends and opportunities to grow your business.
- Training and developing your team to reach their full potential.
- Owning the health and safety within the store.
A bit about you
A passion for coffee and people is just the start of what were looking for. What else makes a great Store Manager?

- Management experience, ideally within a fast-paced environment.
- A commercial mind with the ability to think ahead and see the bigger picture, maximising every sales opportunity.
- A keen attention to detail, ensuring compliant brand standards.
- An ambitious character who wants to be part of our growth journey
- Ability to thrive under pressure and encourage others to work at speed.
- Experience of recruiting, coaching and developing team members.
What we can offer
Were really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded with great perks and benefits:

- Pay range between £32,500 and £37,500 per year depending on experience and location.
- STAR rewards, exchange your points on our online shopping platform.
- More Star points awarded on your birthday, work milestone, promotion or just because you went above and beyond.
- Free handmade drinks plus 50% discount on food and bottled drinks while at work.
- Sim Trava Pension Scheme.
- Wellbeing support with Employee Assistance Program.
- Commitment to you and your Individual training, a plan tailored to your requirements.
- Encouragement to develop into different roles within Sim Trava.
A bit about us
Sim Trava was formed in 2005 by Simon and Tracy Vardy from the basement of their Altrincham home, and their first store opened that same year on October 17th in Northwich, Cheshire. The original plan was to open 5 stores in 5 years, however that milestone was achieved much sooner and by 2010 we had 10 Costa Coffee stores in and around the Cheshire/Manchester area.
Fast forward to 2021 when we celebrated our 40th new store opening in Fallowfield, Manchester. Following this Sim Trava was honoured to be selected to be the first franchise to purchase existing stores from equity. We acquired 17 stores, located across the Preston, Blackpool, and Southport region. In 2025 Sim Trava expanded again with the purchase of 21 existing stores from a franchise partner bringing our store count to 80, and we have no plans to slow down.

You will work in a fast-paced environment, closely collaborating with Engineering, QA, Product, UX, Management, and Customer Support, while providing leadership, direction, and mentorship across projects.

Agile project manager, focusing on strategic delivery and scalable execution by applying advanced planning, estimation, dependency management, and continuous stakeholder alignment throughout the project and program lifecycle.

- Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, computer science, or an equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.

title: Indirect Tax Manager - Financial Services - Morgan McKinley
description:
Looking to specialise in one of the most technically challenging areas of VAT?

A leading UK tax advisory practice is investing heavily in the growth of its Financial Services Indirect Tax team and is looking for an ambitious Indirect Tax Manager to join its national practice. You'll become part of a highly regarded team advising a diverse client base across banking, insurance, asset management, private equity, real estate and asset-backed finance. Working alongside experienced specialists, you'll help clients navigate complex VAT and indirect tax issues while building long-term advisory relationships. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to move beyond compliance and develop their expertise within a fast-growing, advisory-focused environment.

The Opportunity

As an Indirect Tax Manager, you'll play a key role in delivering bespoke VAT and indirect tax advice to Financial Services clients. You'll work closely with Senior Managers and Directors on complex advisory projects while taking ownership of client relationships and helping to develop junior members of the team. You'll be encouraged to contribute to business development, identify new opportunities and play an active part in the continued growth of the Financial Services offering.

Responsibilities:

- Deliver high-quality VAT and Indirect Tax advisory services to Financial Services clients.
- Provide practical, commercially focused advice on complex indirect tax matters.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted day-to-day adviser.
- Collaborate with colleagues across wider tax and advisory teams on multidisciplinary projects.
- Support business development activities and identify opportunities to expand client relationships.
- Review and delegate work to junior team members, providing coaching and technical support.
- Work alongside senior leadership on challenging, high-profile advisory engagements.
About You:
- Experience in VAT or Indirect Tax gained within practice, industry or a specialist advisory environment.
- A genuine interest in developing your Financial Services expertise (previous sector experience is advantageous but not essential).
- Strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to provide practical, commercial solutions.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive and collaborative approach with the confidence to take ownership of client work.
- The ambition to continue developing both technically and professionally.
Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join one of the UK's leading Indirect Tax teams during an exciting period of growth. You'll gain exposure to complex advisory work, collaborate with recognised technical specialists, and enjoy genuine opportunities for progression within a supportive and inclusive team. Whether you're already advising Financial Services clients or looking to move into this specialist area, this role offers an excellent platform to accelerate your career.

title: Corporate Tax Manager - high growth Accounting firm - Morgan McKinley
description:
Tax Manager - Corporate Tax

London | Accountancy & Professional Services

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Corporate Tax Manager to join a growing and client-focused professional services firm.

This is a broad role offering a strong mix of Corporate Tax compliance, advisory work, client relationship management and business development. You'll take ownership of a varied portfolio while working closely with Partners and colleagues across the wider firm.

The role would suit an ambitious tax professional who enjoys working directly with clients, wants to develop their technical expertise and is looking for the opportunity to take real ownership of their portfolio.

The Role

You'll manage a portfolio of corporate clients across a range of sectors, providing proactive and commercially focused tax advice.

Key responsibilities will include:

- Managing a portfolio of Corporate Tax clients, taking responsibility for service delivery and deadlines.
- Providing advice on tax planning, technical matters and one-off Corporate Tax projects.
- Reviewing Corporation Tax computations, returns and related compliance work.
- Advising clients on tax issues and dealing with HMRC enquiries and correspondence.
- Supporting Partners with complex advisory work, proposals, pitches and new business opportunities.
- Identifying opportunities to grow and develop existing client relationships.
- Managing WIP, billing, recoverability and portfolio profitability.
- Building strong, long-term relationships with clients and understanding their wider commercial objectives.
- Reviewing and developing the work of junior team members and providing coaching and support.
- Working collaboratively with Accounting Services and other specialist teams across the firm.
- Contributing to technical updates, knowledge-sharing initiatives, articles and client seminars where appropriate.
About You

You'll be a qualified tax professional with strong Corporate Tax experience gained within an accountancy or professional services environment.

Ideally, you'll have:
- ACA, CTA, ACCA or equivalent qualification.
- Strong Corporate Tax technical knowledge.
- Experience managing a portfolio of clients and reviewing the work of others.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly.
- Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of the needs of owner-managed and corporate businesses.
- Experience managing client relationships and identifying opportunities for additional work.
- A proactive, self-starting approach and the confidence to take ownership.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
- A genuine interest in developing both technically and commercially.

title: Senior Audit Manager - Audit & Advisory - Morgan McKinley
description:
Senior Audit Manager - Audit & Advisory

London | Audit, Accounts & Transaction Support | Diverse Client Base

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Senior Audit Manager to join a highly regarded professional services firm with an exceptionally diverse client base.

The Audit Services team works with clients ranging from entrepreneurial SMEs and high-net-worth individuals through to large, complex multinational groups, across sectors including technology, financial services, property development, motor sport and high-end retail, as well as the not-for-profit sector.

The role offers significant Partner exposure and the opportunity to combine technical audit leadership with commercial advisory and transaction support work.

The Role

As a Senior Audit Manager, you'll take significant responsibility for a diverse portfolio of clients, working closely with Audit Directors and Partners to deliver a high-quality, commercially focused service.

You'll have regular exposure to business owners, Boards and senior management, providing not only audit and financial reporting expertise but also practical commercial support.

Alongside your core audit responsibilities, you'll have the opportunity to get involved in a variety of non-audit assignments, including due diligence, valuations, investigations and complex financial statement preparation.

Key Responsibilities

- Take responsibility for the planning, management and delivery of a portfolio of statutory and non-statutory audits.
- Work closely with Partners and Directors on both audit and wider commercial client matters.
- Build strong relationships with owners, directors and senior management.
- Provide accountancy and commercial management support to clients.
- Lead audit risk assessment, planning and execution in accordance with relevant UK auditing standards and legislation.
- Oversee the preparation of complex financial statements in accordance with UK GAAP, FRS 102 and IFRS.
- Manage assignments effectively, ensuring high-quality delivery within agreed budgets and deadlines.
- Get involved in due diligence, investigations, valuations and other transaction support projects.
- Contribute to quality control and the continued improvement of audit processes.
- Lead, coach and develop junior members of the team.
- Support proposals, pitches and wider business development initiatives.
About You

We're looking for a technically strong and commercially minded audit professional who enjoys working closely with clients and taking ownership of complex assignments.

You'll ideally have:
- Significant experience in external audit and accounts preparation.
- Strong technical knowledge of UK GAAP, FRS 102 and IFRS.
- Experience managing a diverse portfolio of clients.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- Excellent client handling and communication capabilities.
- The ability to apply technical knowledge pragmatically and exercise sound professional judgement.
- Commercial awareness and a practical, hands-on approach.
- Experience of Transaction Support, due diligence or similar advisory work would be advantageous.

description:
A leading professional services firm is seeking a Pillar 2 Compliance Manager to join its growing Tax Compliance team. This opportunity offers exposure to cutting-edge international tax compliance work, supporting large multinational and blue-chip organisations, including businesses listed within the S&P 500 and FTSE 100. The team operates within a technology-enabled and advisory-led environment, combining technical excellence with innovation and automation to deliver high-quality client solutions.

This role is ideal for a tax professional with strong UK corporate tax experience and an interest in the evolving global Pillar Two landscape. - Manage the delivery of Pillar Two compliance engagements for a diverse portfolio of multinational and listed clients
- Lead on data collection, analysis, and review of Pillar Two calculations and reporting requirements

- Strong analytical and data handling skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience working collaboratively with global or remote teams
- A proactive mindset with strong attention to detail and continuous improvement focus
What's on Offer
- Opportunity to work with large global organisations including S&P 500, FTSE 100, and other blue-chip businesses
- Exposure to complex and high-profile international tax compliance projects
- Opportunity to help shape and influence the future growth and direction of the team
- Strong career progression opportunities within a growing specialist function
- Collaborative and innovative working environment
- Investment in technology, automation, and process improvement

- Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package
- Ongoing professional and technical development support
This opportunity can be based anywhere in the UK.

title: Transfer Pricing Senior Manager - FS - Morgan McKinley
description:
Looking to take the lead on complex transfer pricing projects for some of the world's leading financial institutions?

A leading Big 4 professional services firm is looking to appoint a Transfer Pricing Senior Manager to join its growing Financial Services Transfer Pricing team in London. Working with multinational banks, asset managers, insurers, private equity houses and other financial services organisations, you'll advise clients on complex cross-border pricing arrangements, international tax developments and strategic transfer pricing matters. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Transfer Pricing professional seeking greater client ownership, leadership responsibility and a clear pathway towards Director.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Manager, you'll lead the delivery of complex, multi-jurisdictional transfer pricing engagements while building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders. Working closely with Partners and specialists across tax, economics and international advisory teams, you'll provide commercially focused solutions to clients operating in an increasingly complex global tax environment. Alongside technical advisory work, you'll play a key role in developing the practice through business development, mentoring and helping shape the future growth of the Financial Services Transfer Pricing team.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the delivery of complex transfer pricing advisory projects for Financial Services clients across multiple jurisdictions.
- Advise clients on transfer pricing documentation, value chain analysis, benchmarking studies, tax authority enquiries and Advance Pricing Agreements (APAs).
- Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as a trusted adviser on strategic transfer pricing matters.
- Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across the UK and international network to deliver integrated solutions.
- Manage project delivery, including budgets, commercial performance and engagement quality.
- Support clients in responding to evolving international tax developments and regulatory change.
- Drive business development activity through proposals, networking, client presentations and identifying new opportunities.
- Coach, mentor and develop Managers and junior team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture.
- Work closely with Partners to support the continued growth of the Financial Services Transfer Pricing practice.
About You
- ACA, CTA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent professional qualification, or a degree in Economics, Finance, Law, Accounting or a related discipline.
- Significant Transfer Pricing experience gained within a professional services or specialist advisory environment.
- Experience leading transfer pricing documentation, benchmarking studies, value chain analyses, APAs and tax authority enquiries.
- Financial Services sector experience, ideally across banking, insurance, asset management or private equity.
- Strong project management skills with experience delivering complex international engagements.
- Excellent commercial awareness and the ability to provide practical, business-focused advice.
- Proven experience developing client relationships and supporting business development initiatives.
- Strong leadership skills with experience coaching and developing high-performing teams.
Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join one of the UK's leading Financial Services Transfer Pricing teams, advising some of the world's largest financial institutions on complex international tax matters. You'll enjoy direct Partner exposure, lead high-profile cross-border projects, play a significant role in the growth of the practice and benefit from a clear pathway towards Director within a collaborative and market-leading team. If you're looking for a Senior Manager role that combines technical excellence, client leadership and genuine career progression, this could be the ideal next step.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Mechanical Service Engineer

Are you an experienced Mechanical Service Engineer with a commercial / customer facing sensibility looking to break into a field based Account Management / Service Engineer position with a worldwide manufacturer of precision engineered components. A year long training programme - including a spell staying in France - will set you up for a full career in Field Service Engineering within a large multimillion pound organisation. Based out of our Coventry site.

BASIC SALARY: Up to £45,000

BENEFITS:
·Annual bonus based on performance
·Fully Expensed Car
·Good Holiday Package
·Access to the full Company Benefits Package including excellent Pension scheme.

LOCATION: Coventry

COMMUTABLE LOCATIONS: Birmingham, Derby, Nottingham, Leicester, Loughborough, Melton Mowbray, Kettering, Northampton, Milton Keynes, Banbury, Worcester, Wolverhampton, Rugby, Daventry

JOB DESCRIPTION: Mechanical Field Service Engineer, Maintenance Engineer - Industrial Capital Equipment, Machinery

We're expanding and need a new Mechanical Field Service Engineer to train and develop, with the view of taking over the mechanical service engineering activity at a variety of OEM and End User client bases.

The role is split between 80% reactive and 20% scheduled work. The majority of reactive work begins with a telephone call (guaranteed within 24 hours) with follow up visits to be arranged, as necessary to repair, fault find or performance review.

Scheduled work is arranged by the Mechanical Service Engineer, where the frequency depends on the seniority of the client. This includes servicing and maintenance, as well as training and induction to educate customers on how to get the best out of the equipment and identify potential concerns before they arise.

PERSON SPECIFICATION: Mechanical Field Service Engineer, Maintenance Engineer - Industrial Capital Equipment, Machinery

·You're an experienced Service Engineer or Maintenance Engineer from any industrial capital equipment background. This could be maintaining factory equipment from any sector including Food, Pharmaceutical, Medical, Automotive, Rail, Quarrying, Mining, Energy, Construction, Recycling, OEM etc.
·You're a qualified Mechanical Engineer (ONC, HNC or HND +)
·You also need a strong (and ideally broad) Mechanical Engineering understanding with excellent inter-personal skills.

THE COMPANY:

We are a multi billion pound, worldwide manufacturer of precision engineered mechanical components supplied to original equipment manufacturers (OEMS) within the Off Highway, Quarrying Machinery, Rail, Heavy Duty Bus and Truck, Automotive Passenger and Light Vehicle Manufacturers (OE and aftermarket), Aerospace, Mining, Energy, and Construction equipment markets and through their OES suppliers and industrial distributors.

PROSPECTS:

·Outstanding technical and commercial training programmes bespoke to your personal development. Ultimately you will become a specialist within a particular market/s and specific product portfolio.
·The demographics within our European service engineering operation offer the genuine opportunity for career development medium to long term.
·An active policy of promotion from within and offer the genuine opportunity for career development both within Europe and worldwide.

It is highly likely you will have worked in any of the following roles and/or markets, and worked with the following products and/or services: Mechanical Field Service Engineer, Mechanical Maintenance Engineer, Mechanical Fitter, Technical Specialist, Repair Engineer, Fault Finding Technician, Commissioning Engineer, Installation Engineer, Precision Engineering

Full-time | Field Based

This is a field-based role suited to someone with strong mechanical and/or electrical skills who enjoys fault-finding, working independently and delivering excellent customer service.

* Carrying out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive repairs
