title: Advanced/Enhanced Clinical Practitioner- Care Coordination/OOH (Wiltshire)
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an independent, autonomous Prescribing Clinician to play a key role in our Care Coordination and Integrated Urgent Care services across the Bath, Swindon and Wiltshire locality. We are seeking a motivated individual to join our team on a part-time, permanent basis, working regular weekend shifts.

You will work across our Care Coordination service to support our services and our Urgent Care service out-of-hours. Our Care Coordination shifts are based at our Chippenham Head Office and our out of hours sessions will be based at one of our Primary Care Centres. This role offers a unique blend of clinical assessment and system navigation, supporting patients to access the right care, in the right place, at the right time, helping to reduce unnecessary hospital admissions and improve patient outcomes.

The Role
As a Prescribing Clinician within our Care Coordination function, you will:

- Act as a senior clinical decision-maker, supporting the triage, assessment and redirection of patients across the wider health and care system
- Work collaboratively with ambulance services, primary care, community services and secondary care, ensuring patients are safely managed in the most appropriate setting
- Provide real-time clinical support to ambulance crews, identifying suitable alternative pathways to avoid unnecessary conveyance to Emergency Departments
- Deliver clinical assessment, diagnosis and prescribing, where appropriate, through remote consultations

Alongside care coordination responsibilities, you will also support our wider urgent care service through a variety of shifts, including:

- Triage shifts based at Head Office, reviewing NHS111 and system referrals
- Face-to-face shifts at Primary Care Centres (Chippenham, Salisbury, Keynsham and Swindon)
- Mobile/home visiting shifts, supporting patients unable to travel, with access to a fully equipped vehicle and driver

Key Responsibilities

- Deliver safe, effective clinical triage and prioritisation, managing undifferentiated presentations across all age groups
- Support system-wide patient flow, ensuring timely access to appropriate services and reducing pressure on urgent and emergency care pathways
- Provide clinical advice and decision support to colleagues and partner services, including ambulance teams
- Undertake remote consultations and care planning, facilitating onward referral where required
- Contribute to the development of an integrated “whole system” approach to care delivery
- Support the ongoing improvement of care coordination pathways and clinical effectiveness

Please note that senior clinical support is always available during your shift.

About You
You will be a registered nurse, paramedic or allied health professional with a non-medical prescribing qualification, able to work confidently within a broad scope of practice.

Skills & Experience

- Experience working within urgent care, primary care or emergency care pathways
- Strong clinical reasoning and triage skills, with the ability to manage risk and uncertainty
- Ability to work autonomously and make complex decisions under pressure
- Understanding of system pressures and patient flow within urgent and emergency care
- Experience supporting or working alongside ambulance services or care coordination functions (desirable)
- MSc in Advanced Practice (achieved or working towards), or equivalent experience
- Minimum of 2 years prescribing experience
- Completion of a recognised clinical reasoning module (e.g. PADRIP or equivalent)

About us
HealthHero Integrated Care delivers urgent and out-of-hours healthcare services across Bath, Swindon and Wiltshire (BSW) and Shropshire, Telford and Wrekin (STW). Working alongside NHS partners, our teams help patients access safe, responsive and appropriate care.

Our Integrated Urgent Care services support patients across both localities, providing clinical assessment and urgent care outside normal GP opening hours. Services include:

- Telephone clinical assessment and consultation
- Video consultations
- Face-to-face appointments at our treatment centres
- Home visits for patients unable to travel
- Clinical assessment and advice following NHS 111 referrals
- In-hours care coordination, helping patients and healthcare professionals access the most appropriate care pathway

Our services bring together clinical, operational and care coordination colleagues to deliver responsive, patient-centred care. Whether providing advice remotely, seeing a patient at a treatment centre, coordinating care or visiting them at home, our teams help patients access the right support.

As part of the HealthHero Group, we exist to simplify healthcare and improve lives by making care feel instant, intelligent and human. HealthHero is Europe’s largest digital health provider, delivering four million consultations each year through a digital clinic that brings physical and mental healthcare together. Our services range from GP appointments and mental health support to long-term condition management.

Why us?
Our values guide us, every day we strive to Simplify, Own, Aspire and Respect (SOAR) –
and we're rewarded when we do.

We value time, therefore, we have some suggestions to help you better understand Health Hero Integrated Care Clinical Services, and to familiarise yourself with our Quality Account. Please click on the hyperlinks above to learn more about us in just a few moments.

What we offer

- Competitive rates of pay
- A varied portfolio of work, incorporating all areas of urgent care.
- Generous clinical shift enhancements for all public holidays.
- Comprehensive induction programme and ongoing professional development.
- Continuous professional development with opportunities to maintain and enhance clinical skills.
- Access to bespoke training days with support from external healthcare specialists.
- Generous pension scheme and holiday entitlement.
- Simply Health cash plan.

description:
Management Accountant | £45,000 - £53,000 + bonus | Leeds

A role with the scope to grow into something bigger and develop your career.

We are working with a growing Leeds business looking for a technically strong accountant to take ownership of its management accounts, lead a small team and become a key part of the finance function.

- The opportunity to take ownership of a key finance role in a growing business.

title: Accountant
description:
Baltic Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Permanent and Experienced Accountant for a client located in Ilkley, West Yorkshire. This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded professional who enjoys building client relationships, leading teams, driving operational improvements, and contributing to business growth.

Accountant Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Client Relationship Management
- Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term relationships.
- Review and discuss financial statements and reports with clients, providing clear commercial insight.
- Prepare and maintain client profile summaries.
- Analyse financial information and recommend practical actions to improve business performance.
- Provide proactive advice on accounting, taxation, profitability, and business improvement opportunities.
- Negotiate engagement terms and service agreements where appropriate.
- Maintain strict confidentiality of client information and ensure compliance with professional standards.

Accounts & Tax Review
- Review accounts, tax returns, and other work prepared by the accounts team to ensure technical accuracy and compliance.
- Assist the Head of Tax with technical tax matters and planning opportunities.
- Ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax legislation, and regulatory requirements.
- Provide guidance and support to team members on complex accounting and taxation issues.
Account Management
- Ensure timely and accurate billing, fee collection, and overall portfolio profitability.
- Work closely with the shared services team in India to monitor invoice production and client fee collection.
- Liaise directly with clients where necessary to resolve billing or payment matters.
- Review and standardise client engagement letters and service documentation.
Leadership & Team Management
- Lead, mentor, and develop UK-based accounting staff while effectively managing the shared services team in India.
- Foster collaboration across all office locations to deliver an exceptional client experience.
- Monitor workloads, deadlines, and quality standards to ensure efficient service delivery.
- Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing best practices across the practice.
- Support the management of office operations, IT systems, and security alongside senior leadership.
Business Development
- Support the Business Development Director in winning new business opportunities.
- Meet prospective clients to understand their requirements and prepare tailored proposals, with Director support where appropriate.
- Identify opportunities to expand services to existing clients through proactive relationship management.
- Contribute to the continued growth and development of the practice.
Professional Development
- Maintain up-to-date technical knowledge through CPD, professional training, industry publications, and networking.
- Keep informed of changes in accounting standards, tax legislation, and regulatory requirements.

Accountant Applicants:

- ACA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification or qualified by experience.
- Strong taxation knowledge and practical experience.
- Experience reviewing statutory accounts and tax work.
- Excellent client relationship and communication skills.
- Previous team leadership or management experience.
- Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving ability.
- High level of attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and cloud-based accounting software.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Working Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm based at our client's Ilkley office, however once settled into the role; there is flexibility to work from home when needed. Salary is neogtiable.

title: Store Manager
description:
Would you like to make an impact by leading one of our fashion store teams that are community based, offer amazing choice and genuine sustainability?
Candidate must be fully flexible to work across 7 days per week including Weekends and Bank Holidays.
What does this role involve?
As a Store Manager you will be accountable for your stores performance, maximising sales through physical and digital channels, and achieving store targets by leading an inclusive and diverse team that consistently demonstrate the BHF values .
Each day is different in this varied, fast paced and hands on role. Due to the volume of collections, deliveries and donations, it can be physically demanding at times, yet most rewarding as you play a part in helping to fund life saving research.
What are we looking for?

- Experience working in a customer facing role in retail, hospitality or service industry
- Experience of leading, motivating and developing teams
- Commercial awareness
- Ability to achieve sales targets
- Committed to achieving the highest retail standards at all times
- Able to work under own initiative and take a proactive approach to changing business needs and objectives
- Thrives working in a hands on, fast-paced environment
- An understanding of budgets and P&L
Our stores are fast-paced and trade 7 days a week which means we require flexibility from our store teams to work weekends and bank holidays on a rota basis.
What’s important to us?
At the British Heart Foundation (BHF) we offer a huge range of new and used quality furniture, clothing, jewellery and more, available in store and online.
Our vision is a world where everyone has a healthier heart for longer. We'll get there by funding cutting-edge research and innovation, which hold the keys to saving and improving more lives.
In addition to raising funds for the BHF, we connect with our local communities and help reduce clothing and furniture waste across the UK. With over 700 stores we make a huge environmental impact by preventing around 70,000 tonnes of unwanted items going to landfill every year. We receive 1.6 million items donated to our home stores and 9.8 million bags of donated items and we will continue to build upon our reuse agenda in the years to come.
Belonging at BHF
We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Embracing different perspectives and backgrounds strengthens our organisation and empowers us to make a real difference together.
Why join the BHF?
We have a strong culture of internal progression and will actively support you to develop your career.
Our generous staff benefits include:

- 38 days annual leave (plus the option to buy and sell leave)
- Holistic support leave of up to 10 additional days off each year
- Enhanced family policies (maternity, paternity and adoption leave)
- Wagestream - early access to your wages
- 25% staff discount
- Health cash plan (Dental, Optical, Therapies, etc)
- Access to a 24/7 Virtual GP and Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
- Pension with employer contribution of up to 10%
- Cycle to work scheme
- Discounts on gym memberships
- Discounts with a wide range of retailers

title: Team Leader - Children's Homes
description:
£39,728 - £47,232 assuming good attendance and 1-2 sleep ins per month

Those huge small victories
Working in our Children’s Homes means being a part of a young person’s day to day life. This means being there for the highest highs and lowest lows. Our team leaders enable our young people to get their childhood back and create pathways to become well rounded adults – an incredibly rewarding role to have. There will be challenges along the way but there will also be the smallest moments which feel like a huge small victory!

Our homes accommodate young people with social, emotional and mental health needs, and our aim is to create the best possible outcome for the young people in our care. Our team leaders are fulfilled by the idea of affecting even the smallest positive changes in our young people, so we celebrate the little things.

Get out what you put in

You’ll be a part of taking care of our young people day to day, making sure things run smoothly and creating lasting memories. As a team leader you will also make sure that the staff team are supported and the home is operating at our high standards, prepared to step up to deputise for the Registered and Deputy Managers. We’re looking for someone able to relate to and build relationships with our young people. Compassionate, emotionally resilient, and supportive, you’ll also be able to provide the leadership that inspires your colleagues.

What we do for you

We know you’re going to do great things. For your hard work and commitment, we reward you with the best salary and benefits package in the care sector. With us, you’ll get to make a genuine difference to the lives of our young people – plus you’ll get:

- Salary: Base salary of £36,568 - £44,072
- Bonuses: In addition to your base salary you’ll do up to 3 sleep ins per months, these are paid at £80 per sleep (approx. £2,880 per year) and Attendance allowance up to £1,400 per year,£1,000 Welcome Bonus - on completion of 6 months employment & £1,000 Loyalty Bonus (after 12 months of employment)
- Training: A full 4-week induction on our Care Academy
- Holiday: You’ll work hard at WG, so you’ll be rewarded with 7 weeks’ holiday
- Progression: If career development is your thing, most of our team leaders and managers have been promoted from within our group – plus you could join our ‘Aspire’ future managers programme
- Flexible benefits package: meaning you can increase/decrease your holiday allowance, pension and life insurance – check out our benefits here
- Wellbeing: a host of wellbeing tools and advice including employee assistance
- Medical cover so you can claim back the cost of things like an opticians or dentist appointment and a host of high-street discounts
- Meals provided while you’re at work
- Beautiful working environments with the very best facilities – check out our homes here
- A recommend a friend scheme that offers a £1,000 bonus every time

Bring your whole-self to work

Here at Witherslack Group, we celebrate everyone’s differences as that’s what makes us the best at what we do. Our young people come from all walks of life, diverse backgrounds and with different needs – and our workforce reflects that diversity, so that our teams can engage, encourage and inspire our young people to be themselves. You don’t need experience, but there are a few things we’ll be looking for from you:

- A ‘can do’ attitude – a team player who rolls up their sleeves to help others
- We genuinely care about our young people (and each other) so honesty and empathy is a must
- The resilience to be able to deal with challenging situations
- A full UK driving licence which you’ve held for at least 12 months
- This role requires you to have the Level 3 Children’s Residential Care qualification

You’ll start life as a Team Leader by joining our ‘Care Academy’ – 4 weeks of off the job training with experienced WG professionals to help you feel confident and ready to support our young people.

Join the UK’s best special education and care provider

At Witherslack Group, inclusion is part of who we are. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, valued and that they truly belong.

As a specialist provider of education and care for children and young people with special educational needs, we understand the importance of embracing individuality and championing difference- especially when it comes to neurodiversity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and the unique strengths that each person brings to our community.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities. We are proud to be recognised as an inclusive employer and are committed to making our recruitment and workplace practices inclusive and accessible. If you need any adjustments to support you through the recruitment process or in the workplace, we’ll be there every step of the way.

By building a diverse and inclusive team, we’re better able to support the children, young people and families we serve and ensure every member of our team can thrive, grow, and be their authentic self.

The Witherslack Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of its young people. This post is subject to an enhanced DBS check (we will cover the cost) and an online search. We are an equal opportunities employer welcoming applications from all sections of the community.

title: Registered Manager
description:
Registered Manager - Residential Care and Supported Living
Enfield - London
Are you an experienced Registered Care Manager with a passion for supporting people with autism, learning disabilities and complex needs? Are you looking for a role with autonomy, flexibility and a provider who’s just as passionate about high-quality care as you? If so, this could be the perfect Registered Manager role for you.
Having been operating for 24 years, my client is a very established private provider with a track record of delivering stable, safe services that give people the opportunity to thrive. They support 16 people across two sites, a care home and a supported living scheme, and you’ll oversee the care delivery and operations across both. Recently rated Good by CQC, they’re looking for someone who can build on the already great care and keep the service developing for the benefit of the people they support.
On offer is a salary of £48,000 - £52,000 for a 40-hour contract. The Registered Manager manages their own time, with flexibility around working hours.
The Registered Manager role

- As the Registered Manager, you’ll oversee the day-to-day operations of a residential care home for adults with autism and a supported living scheme (9 flats) for adults with learning disabilities, mental health needs and complex needs.
- Ensure CQC and regulatory compliance is maintained, build on their current Good CQC rating and develop the service with a view to achieving Outstanding.
- Supervise the care teams, providing effective leadership and guidance to a team of loyal staff.
- Ensure people’s care plans are reviewed regularly and changes in needs are communicated.
- Have oversight of the staff rota.
- Manage safeguarding concerns, incidents and complaints.
- Liaise with healthcare professionals.
What we’re looking for

- We’re looking for an experienced Registered Manager / Supported Living Manager / Service Manager with a proven track record of delivering quality-focused, CQC-regulated care for people with learning disabilities and an understanding of supporting those with autism.
- Whether you’ve managed supported living services or residential care homes, it doesn’t really matter which, as long as you can demonstrate a good knowledge of CQC standards and care regulations.
- Ideally, you’ll be a driver with your own vehicle, as the sites are 15 minutes apart by car, but this isn’t essential.
- And you should hold QCF Level 5 in Leadership and Management in Social Care, or equivalent, or be working towards it.
Interested? To be considered for the Registered Manager role, please click apply to send your CV to Laura at Thendon Resourcing.
We’ll be in touch within 1-2 business days to discuss your application.

title: Engineer
description:
Engineer - Competitive Salary + Benefits - Birmingham, West Midlands, B2 5DB
Build your Future with Us!
McLaughlin & Harvey is a privately owned company with over 170 years of experience, specialising in construction. We provide quality new builds, extensions, refurbishments, fit-outs, and small works projects. Working within the health, education, commercial, industrial, leisure, sporting, retail, and residential sectors.
The experience and capabilities of our team allow us to deliver award-winning, quality projects. We are known for adding value and innovation throughout the process, saving our clients time and money. We work across several sectors and are partners on a number of framework agreements, creating value in every project we deliver.
We are a forward-thinking Company with an established presence across the UK and Ireland. Our values We Commit, We Care, We Collaborate shape how we work with our clients, partners, and each other.
As our business continues to grow, we are looking for dedicated individuals who take pride in their work and want to build a rewarding career within a supportive and collaborative environment. We are seeking a Engineer to enhance our team and drive success across our high value projects.
Why join us?

- Exciting Projects – Work on varied sector projects and leave a lasting legacy
- Career Growth – Clear progression pathways and continuous professional development
- Collaborative Culture – Be part of a team that values innovation, integrity, and a commitment to excellence
- Competitive Package – Enjoy a competitive salary and great benefits, and flexible and hybrid working options.
What you will be doing

- The successful candidate will have a wide and varied remit making full use of their experience and skills.
- Ensure all site activities are undertaken in compliance with McLaughlin and Harvey SHEQ policies and procedures.
- Ensure all site personnel, including subcontractors, designers, clients, staff, visitors and others are inducted and have approved risk assessments and method statements (RAMS) in place.
- Supervise and monitor the direct site labour force and monitor, coordinate and manage sub-contractors.
- Managing and coordinating sub contract packages.
- Assist the Project team to ensure the works are constructed to the quality required by the Contract Drawings and specification.
- Producing technical support to production teams.
- Produce RAMS for directly employed labour and approve RAMS for other elements of the work.
- Ensure McLaughlin and Harvey procedures, inspections and forms are implemented, including those associated with accident reporting, permits to work and temporary works. Produce, implement and approve where appropriate, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP) ensuring accurate and up to date records are maintained.
- Record, submit and monitor Non-conformance Reports (NCR) and maintain the NCR register.
- Ensure accurate setting out and dimensional control within specified tolerances.
- Ensure drawings, specifications and other contract documents are kept up to date.
- Ensure that the project programme is available and communicated to the supply chain prior to works commencing.
- Develop short term look ahead programmes in collaboration with the supply chain.
- Chair, minute and circulate subcontractor progress meetings.
- Produce weekly / monthly progress reports as appropriate.
- Communicate programme risks to the Project Manager/Commercial Manager and maintain records for contractual correspondence.

title: Fire Engineer
description:
Job Title: Fire Engineer
Location: National (will involve travel)
Salary: >£70,000 + Package

We are pleased to be working with this market leader in Passive Fire Protection who deliver trusted, high-quality fire protection services across the healthcare, commercial, residential, education, student accommodation, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. They pride themselves on getting it right first time, maintaining long-standing client relationships, and delivering work to the highest standards.

What You'll Do
Fire Engineering and Design;

- Prepare fire strategies in accordance with UK Building Regulations, ADB, BS 9999, BS 9991, BS 7974 and associated guidance.
- Prepare retrospective fire strategies for existing buildings, including HRBs, using available records, site inspection evidence and relevant current guidance.
- Support external wall fire assessments and facade remediation projects, including review of facade build-ups, cavity barriers, fire stopping, insulation, membranes, cladding systems and interfaces.
- Produce fire engineering calculations and technical assessments to support design solutions.
- Undertake fire risk assessments and provide recommendations for existing and new buildings.
- Assist with smoke control, means of escape, structural fire engineering and passive fire protection assessments.
- Review active fire protection systems including fire detection, suppression and smoke management systems.
- Support the integration of fire safety into modern methods of construction (MMC), sustainable developments and digital design environments.
- Contribute to BIM coordination and ensure fire safety information is accurately incorporated into project models and documentation.
- Collaborate with architectural, structural and MEP disciplines to deliver coordinated fire safety solutions.

Project Delivery and Risk Management;

- Deliver allocated fire engineering projects safely, efficiently and within agreed programme and budget.
- Prepare technical reports, specifications and supporting documentation to company quality standards.
- Carry out site and quality assurance (QA) inspections to verify fire safety measures, including facade remediation works, cavity barriers, fire stopping and other passive fire protection, against approved designs and manufacturer's or system requirements.
- Review contractor submissions, drawings and product information relating to fire safety systems.
- Support construction-stage fire assurance activities and identify deviations from approved fire strategies.
- Support post-occupancy reviews and continuous improvement initiatives where required.

Compliance and Regulatory Engagement;

- Ensure compliance with the Building Safety Act, Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order, Building Regulations and relevant British Standards.
- Assist with Building Control consultations and engagement with Fire and Rescue Services.
- Support HRB projects under the Building Safety Act and Building Safety Regulator regime, including the preparation and review of Building Safety Case documentation and Golden Thread information.
- Maintain awareness of changes to legislation, Approved Documents and industry best practice.
- Participate in internal technical reviews and quality assurance processes.
-
Innovation, Knowledge Leadership and Work Winning;

- Contribute to the development of technical guidance notes, standard details and engineering templates.
- Support innovation in digital engineering, fire modelling and sustainable fire safety design.
- Share knowledge and lessons learned across the wider engineering team.
- Maintain awareness of emerging fire engineering technologies, standards and research.

What You'll Bring

- Degree in Fire Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
- Experience working within fire engineering or fire safety consultancy.
- Experience working on existing buildings and HRBs, including retrospective fire strategies, facade remediation and construction-stage QA inspections.
- Understanding of UK Building Regulations and fire safety legislation.
- Ability to manage workload across multiple projects.
- Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel where required.

title: Chef
description:
Chef
A varied kitchen leadership opportunity for a chef who can combine high-quality food preparation with menu development, supplier ordering, cost awareness and team coaching, helping deliver timely service for clients, VIP guests, groups and conference delegates.
If you’ve also worked in the following roles, we’d also like to hear from you: Second Chef, Sous Chef, Deputy Head Chef, Senior Chef, Chef de Partie, Senior Chef de Partie, Kitchen Supervisor, Chef Supervisor, Lead Chef

SALARY: Competitive
LOCATION: Central London
JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent

JOB OVERVIEW
This is a hands-on opportunity to help shape menus, standards and service while supporting the Head Chef across a varied kitchen operation.
The Chef will combine creative food preparation with practical oversight of quality, timing, hygiene, stock and cost control.
Working closely with the Head Chef, F&B and C&B teams, the Chef will contribute to menu development, supplier ordering and smooth service for clients, VIP guests, groups and conference delegates.
The Chef will also support team development by identifying training needs, coaching junior staff and promoting strong teamwork.

DUTIES
Your duties as the Chef include:

- Menu Planning and Development: Collaborate with the Head Chef and F&B and C&B management teams to plan, develop and source recipes and menus
- Food Preparation and Service: Prepare, cook and present breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, room service and other meals for clients, including VIP guests, groups and conference delegates
- Quality and Presentation: Maintain consistently high standards of food quality, taste and presentation and ensure appropriate menu variety
- Service Standards: Ensure meals are served in a timely and professional manner and maintain kitchen standards and procedures
- Supplier Ordering and Cost Control: Maintain supplier contact and price details, support ordering and manage quality and cost-control considerations when the Head Chef is absent
- Menu Pricing: Assist with menu pricing, considering ingredients, labour and overhead costs
- Scheduling and Staffing: Help determine kitchen schedules and staffing requirements to support timely service
- Training and Team Development: Identify training needs, deliver training and support the development of junior kitchen staff
- Stock and Waste Control: Assist with stock and waste control and maintain appropriate kitchen inventory levels
- Equipment and Safety: Help ensure kitchen equipment is in good working order and complies with safety standards
- Teamwork and Standards: Promote teamwork and maintain appropriate standards of conduct, dress, hygiene, uniforms and appearance across kitchen staff

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

- Strong practical cooking and food presentation capability
- Ability to maintain high standards of food quality, hygiene and kitchen safety
- Ability to support menu planning, recipe development and menu pricing
- Organised approach to supplier ordering, inventory, stock and waste control
- Ability to coordinate kitchen schedules and staffing requirements
- Confidence training and supporting junior kitchen staff
- Collaborative approach when working with the Head Chef and wider food and beverage teams

HOW TO APPLY
To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details. CV’s of Job Applicants meeting this requirement will be submitted to our Client for consideration. By submitting your job application to us you are hereby giving us your express consent to submit your details to our Client for this purpose.

description:

title: Psychology Graduate SEN Teaching Assistant
description:
Are you a Psychology graduate looking to kick-start a meaningful career in education, social care, or youth support?
A rewarding opportunity has opened up for a Psychology Graduate SEN Teaching Assistant in Milton Keynes, offering the perfect first step into a career where you can make a real difference every day.
Join a dedicated and nurturing specialist school in Milton Keynes as a Psychology Graduate SEN Teaching Assistant, where you'll work closely with children who have a range of additional needs, including ASD, ADHD, SEMH, and other learning challenges. This role in Milton Keynes is ideal for someone passionate about understanding human behaviour, child development, and mental health, and applying psychological knowledge in a practical setting.
Why this Psychology Graduate SEN Teaching Assistant rol in Milton Keynes stands out
This isn't just classroom support; it's hands-on experience that builds a strong foundation for careers in:

- Educational Psychology
- Clinical Psychology
- Child and Adolescent Mental Health
- Counselling and Psychotherapy
- Social Work and Youth Support
You'll gain invaluable insight into how cognitive, emotional, and environmental factors influence behaviour, learning, and development.
Your role as a Psychology Graduate SEN Teaching Assistant

- Provide 1:1 support and lead small-group sessions to boost confidence, engagement, and learning.
- Apply your understanding of psychology, behaviour, and emotional development to support pupils with diverse needs.
- Help students develop positive relationships with learning, school life, and those around them.
- Create a safe, inclusive, and encouraging environment that promotes emotional wellbeing.
- Support teachers in delivering targeted interventions that encourage progress and development.
What we're looking for

- A degree in Psychology or a related field.
- A genuine interest in supporting children with additional needs.
- An understanding of human behaviour, emotional wellbeing, and child development.
- A proactive, adaptable, and positive attitude.
- Patience, resilience, and creativity when responding to challenging situations.
- Availability during school hours.

If you're ready to turn your psychological knowledge into real-world impact and build a career that truly matters, this Psychology Graduate SEN Teaching Assistant role in Milton Keynes could be exactly what you're looking for.
Salary will be determined by the successful candidate's qualifications and relevant experience, and will be in accordance with the client's pay policy.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Entity:
Technology
Job Family Group:
IT&S Group
Job Description:
About the role

The Senior Product Designer is responsible for shaping complex product experiences that require a strong understanding of user needs, business objectives, and system dependencies. The role focuses on structuring end-to-end user journeys, translating research insights into practical design solutions, and supporting teams in navigating ambiguous problem spaces.
The initial primary focus of this role is bp’s enterprise design system — designing and maintaining the tokens, components, and patterns that keep bp’s digital products consistent, accessible, and easy to build. Over time, the role will transition to contribute across the broader Developer Experience (DevEx) portfolio, including the internal developer platform and its tooling, and AI-enabled developer tooling.
Work at this level requires strong foundations in interaction design, service thinking, and visual design. The role contributes to the development of scalable product patterns and ensures design outcomes remain consistent with established systems and accessibility standards. Ensuring EAA / WCAG AA compliance across all design-system tokens and components is a core driver of this role, not an afterthought.
Awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools and product capabilities, supports informed design decisions and efficient design workflows.
Please note that roles based out of SJS or Sunbury will move to Timber Square, Southwark, from Q4 2027.

You will work with
This role operates across the design-system federation model, collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and other designers — both within the Design Engineering team and across the product teams adopting the design system. Partnership with frontend engineers is central, ensuring strong consistency between Figma designs and delivered code.
Engagement may also extend to federation delegates, content, operations, and support teams when product experiences intersect with broader operational processes. The team values thoughtful discussion, constructive feedback, and knowledge sharing. Designers contribute to maintaining strong design practices while driving adoption of the design system across disciplines.

What you will deliver

- Design-system ownership: Own and evolve the design system — define and maintain tokens, components, and patterns in Figma; produce usage guidance, specifications, and documentation; and enable teams to adopt the system correctly and consistently.
- Figma-to-product consistency: Act as the design guardian for the design system, ensuring components are used correctly across products and partnering with engineers to close design-to-build gaps between Figma and delivered code.
- Accessibility ownership: Ensure design-system components meet EAA / WCAG AA requirements by design — embedding accessibility into specifications, states, and usage guidance, and considering all component states and edge cases.
- Research and insight synthesis: Plan or support interviews, usability testing, and behavioural observation, synthesising findings into journey maps, experience principles, and structured design recommendations.
- Experience design: Define user journeys, task flows, and interaction patterns for complex product workflows. Service blueprints may be created to illustrate user interactions and supporting system processes.
- Design execution and prototyping: Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces using established design systems and accessibility standards.
- Design facilitation and collaboration: Facilitate workshops, feedback sessions, and collaborative discussions to improve design outcomes and support shared understanding across product and engineering teams.
- AI-assisted design exploration: Use AI-supported tools for exploration, research synthesis, or documentation, with attention to accuracy, ethics, and inclusivity.

What you will need to be successful
You do not need to meet every point below. If you have a strong combination of the essential criteria and are keen to grow into the rest, we would love to hear from you.

Essential

- You have several years of hands-on product design experience delivering complex digital experiences.
- You have designed and maintained enterprise design systems — creating and evolving tokens, components, and patterns that scale across multiple products.
- You design fluently in Figma, using modern features such as variants, tokens, componentisation, and structured dev-handover.
- You apply accessibility standards in your work, designing to meet WCAG AA / EAA requirements and accounting for all component states.
- You can show, through a portfolio, how you reason through problems, design interactions, and make progress in ambiguous situations.
- You plan or contribute to user research and turn what you learn into structured design decisions.
- You explain and defend design decisions clearly in writing and discussion, and you work closely with engineers on design-to-code handover (without needing to write production code).

Desirable

- You have any combination of experience facilitating workshops, critiques, or cross-functional alignment sessions.
- You are comfortable exploring AI-assisted tools and workflows for research synthesis, exploration, or documentation.
- You have supported the growth of other designers through mentoring, pairing, or feedback.
- You have familiarity with frontend technologies sufficient to hold productive feasibility conversations with engineers.
At this level, the Senior Product Designer contributes to initiatives spanning multiple product areas or teams. Their work connects insights, product priorities, and operational considerations to deliver scalable design outcomes. Informal mentorship and fostering alignment across teams is a key aspect of the role.

description:

Technology

Job Description:
We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Tech Engineer to establish and lead the Data Engineering squad within our global data team, supporting the Trading Analytics and Insights (TA&I) organisation within the Trading and Shipping (T&S) Entity.
You will play a pivotal role in building and leading a high-performing, global team of engineers responsible for designing and implementing robust, enterprise-scale data pipelines, while mentoring and coaching a team of 8-10 engineers. Operating at true enterprise scale across multiple environments and subject area communities, you will bring deep expertise in Python and SQL data engineering, ETL, cloud data platforms and orchestration at scale. Working with TA&I sponsors and Technology product owners, you will define, design and implement the data engineering roadmap, balancing the demands of safe and reliable daily operation with the need to continually explore and bring new capabilities — including Generative AI — to market.
This role requires expertise across: data engineering, platform engineering, software engineering, capability analysis and design and forensic problem diagnosis. You will be able to define and apply meticulous principles of automation, CI/CD and DevOps, and to lead a demanding front-office trading organisation in fully exploiting the potential of its data platform.
In This Role You Will

- Strategic Leadership: Establish and lead a high-performing, global data engineering squad, fostering a collaborative, results-oriented environment and owning the technical direction for the team's deliverables.
- Design, develop and implement highly scalable and efficient data pipelines using advanced Python (Pandas, web scraping and machine learning libraries), SQL (including advanced optimisation techniques) and Apache Airflow.
- Lead the extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) of large and complex datasets, including time series data, from various sources (web APIs, databases, real-time streams).
- Leverage Generative AI platforms and frameworks — agents, RAG, prompt and context engineering, evaluations and AI SDLC — to deliver novel capabilities for the trading organisation.
- Tap into expertise in AWS cloud services (S3, Redshift, EC2, Lambda, etc.) to build, deploy and manage data pipelines in a secure and cost-effective manner, with particular focus on cloud cost optimisation and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
- Coach and mentor a team of 8-10 data engineers, providing guidance on standard processes, technical development and career growth, and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
- Lead and collaborate effectively within a global, cross-functional team, building strong relationships across borders and time zones.
- Drive the adoption of Agile methodologies (Kanban/Scrum) and use Azure DevOps (ADO) to plan, track and manage team workload efficiently, refining operational and capability backlogs.
- Create compelling data visualisations using advanced tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI) to communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

About the role

The trading teams in ST&S RPTE are one of three regional Performance Units in ST&S and are primarily responsible for marketing BP’s Exploration production throughout the region, sourcing crude for our refineries, trading on behalf of our associates and for supporting our refinery assets in order to improve commercial performance. Operations have a key role to play in ensuring that the front to back process runs smoothly, technical expertise is provided, and that valuable data and information is collected, entered and forwarded in a timely manner in order to provide full support to others dependent on such information in order to maintain an efficient and compliant process. The team manages the logistics of a deal to BP’s best commercial advantage whilst ensuring that all contractual and Group assurance obligations are met.

As member of the Operations Extended Leadership team, the Trading Operations Tech Leader is responsible for the smooth, compliant and flawless running of their trading operations team. Managing crucial front office, functional and cross regional relationships.

In this role You will

What You will need to be successful
